2604.24288v1.title: Atomistic Mechanisms of Temperature-Dependent Ion Track Formation in Gallium Nitride under Swift Heavy Ion Irradiation
2604.24288v1.summary: The radiation tolerance of gallium nitride under extreme conditions is critical for its deployment in next-generation electronic and optoelectronic devices, yet the microscopic mechanisms governing swift heavy ion induced damage at elevated temperatures remain poorly understood. Therefore, this study employs a coupled approach including the two-temperature model and molecular dynamics simulations to resolve the entire processes of ion track generation induced by swift heavy ions irradiation across a wide temperature range. A temperature-driven morphological transition of ion tracks, evolving from discontinuous segments to continuous tracks composed of isolated nanobubbles, and ultimately to fully continuous channels is observed. Under lower electronic stopping loss of 430 MeV Kr irradiation, increasing temperature significantly enhances track visibility, enlarges track radii and promotes nanobubble formation. For higher electronic stopping conditions of 1171 MeV Ta irradiation, continuous ion tracks consisting of discontinuous nanobubbles (~1.5 nm radius) emerge already at 300 K, followed by a thermally activated transition into continuous channels with further radial expansion. At the atomic scale, SHI irradiation induces decomposition of wurtzite GaN into Ga clusters and N2 molecules along the ion trajectory, with Ga-rich regions and recrystallized wurtzite phases accumulating near bubble interfaces, while N2 preferentially segregates within bubble cores. Additionally, zincblende nanodomains nucleate around ion tracks and exhibit strong spatial correlation with radiation-induced dislocation networks, particularly screw dislocations, providing potential pathways for leakage current and increased susceptibility to single-event burnout.
2604.24288v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决氮化镓（GaN）在高温环境下遭受快重离子辐照时的微观损伤机制问题，这对下一代电子和光电器件在极端环境下的应用至关重要。现有研究对高温条件下快重离子诱导损伤的微观机制理解不足，缺乏对离子径迹形成全过程的原子尺度认识。该工作创新性地采用双温度模型与分子动力学耦合方法，系统研究了宽温度范围内离子径迹的形成演化机制。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用双温度模型（Two-Temperature Model）与分子动力学（MD）耦合的多物理场模拟方法，实现电子-声子-原子三者间的能量传递耦合。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型和软件平台，需查阅全文获取详细信息。模拟涵盖两种辐照条件：430 MeV Kr离子（较低电子阻止本领）和1171 MeV Ta离子（较高电子阻止本领），研究温度范围从300 K到更高温度。双温度模型描述电子温度和晶格温度的独立演化，通过电子-声子耦合参数控制能量交换速率。MD模拟追踪原子尺度的结构演化，包括wurtzite GaN的分解、Ga团簇和N2分子的形成过程。边界条件设置、模拟盒尺寸、原子数量和时间步长等关键参数摘要未提及，需查阅全文。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现离子径迹形态随温度呈现三阶段演化：从不连续片段到由孤立纳米气泡组成的连续径迹，最终形成完全连续的通道。在430 MeV Kr辐照下，温度升高显著增强径迹可见性并扩大径迹半径。在1171 MeV Ta辐照条件下，300 K时即可形成由不连续纳米气泡（半径约1.5 nm）组成的连续离子径迹，温度升高促进向连续通道的转变并伴随径向扩展。原子尺度分析显示，快重离子辐照导致wurtzite GaN沿离子轨迹分解为Ga团簇和N2分子，Ga富集区和重结晶wurtzite相聚集在气泡界面附近，而N2优先偏析在气泡核心。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的双温度模型与MD耦合方法可直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟研究，特别是在处理电子-声子-原子多尺度能量传递问题时。离子径迹形成的三阶段演化机制为我的金属疲劳模拟提供了缺陷演化的参考模式，特别是纳米气泡的形成和长大过程。1.5 nm的纳米气泡半径数据可作为我在相场晶体模型（XPFC）中设置初始缺陷尺寸的参考值。辐照诱导的闪锌矿纳米畴与位错网络的空间关联性为我的拉伸变形模拟中考虑相变-位错耦合效应提供了重要启发。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了辐照能量（430 MeV Kr、1171 MeV Ta）和纳米气泡半径（1.5 nm）等关键数值，但缺少势函数类型、模拟盒尺寸、原子数量、时间步长和软件平台等复现必需的技术细节。建议重点精读方法学部分以获取双温度模型参数设置和MD模拟的具体实现细节，以及结果部分中离子径迹演化的定量分析数据。

The irradiation was performed centrally along the [0001] crystallographic direction in a simulation cell measuring 30 nm × 30 nm × 50 nm. 2604.23642v1.title: Constitutive relations for colloidal gel
2604.23642v1.summary: The theoretical treatment of depletion gels with central interactions often involves expanding the free energy around a stress-free reference state to derive a constitutive relation between global stress and strain. The premise upon which the previous continuum theories are based, i.e., the stress-free reference state and the affine deformation, both of which do not hold in the context of amorphous gel materials. Gels never reach a true global minimum in the potential energy landscape and contain local regions of significant compressive and tensile stress, interspersed with zero-stress regions. Hence, expansion of free energy around a stressed reference state will produce scalar terms in harmonic expansion, the effects of which are qualitatively different from the terms appearing in the expansion around an unstressed reference state. In this study, we demonstrate the limitations of traditional continuum theories and propose simple constitutive relations that better capture the mechanical response of gel materials. The robustness of the proposed relations is established through large-scale numerical simulations of depletion and frictional gels across a vast parameter space.
2604.23642v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决胶体凝胶材料本构关系建立的理论问题，针对传统连续介质理论在处理无定形凝胶材料时的局限性。现有理论基于无应力参考态和仿射变形假设来推导应力-应变本构关系，但这两个前提在无定形凝胶材料中并不成立。凝胶材料永远无法达到势能面的真正全局最小值，内部存在显著的压应力和拉应力局域区域与零应力区域交替分布的复杂应力状态。该工作的创新点在于提出基于有应力参考态的自由能展开方法，建立更准确描述凝胶材料力学响应的本构关系。

Quasistatic uniaxial compression is enforced by the slow axial ( ˆez) movement of the top and bottom walls at a constant speed. The periodic boundary condition is employed on the transverse directions ( ˆex, ˆey). The hydrodynamic forces are negligible compared to the dominant elastic force in the limit of small strain rates and are therefore not considered in the simulation. For the depletion gel, the pairwise interaction is modeled using the Morse po- tential, with a very short attraction range corresponding to the experimental range of non-adsorbing polymer depletants. The dimensionless strength of the potential minimum,βU 0, is set at 50 and 100 to mimic strong gels[17], whereβ= 1/k BT(k B being the Boltzmann constant). The frictional gel simulation incorporates non- hydrodynamic contact friction, and the interparticle interaction is modeled in the spirit of traditional dis- crete element method (DEM) simulations employed for granular materials [18]. The particles are given random thermal kicks to the translation degrees of freedom, compensated by a viscous damping term. The stochastic Langevin equation is solved to update the particle position and velocities. 2604.24683v1.title: Improved Electrochemical Performance and Diffusion kinetics by Boron-doping in Na$_{0.66}$Mn$_{0.8}$Fe$_{0.2}$O$_{2}$ Layered Cathodes for Sodium-Ion Batteries
2604.24683v1.summary: We report the electrochemical investigation and study the diffusion kinetics of boron doped Na$_{0.66}$Mn$_{0.8}$Fe$_{0.2}$O$_{2}$ (B-NMFO) cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries. Notably, the B-NMFO cathode exhibits improved specific capacity of 163 mAh g$^{-1}$ as compared to 133 mAhg$^{-1}$ at 0.1~C for the NMFO cathode. Further, we observe better capacity retention of 70\% for B-NMFO as compared to the NMFO (60\%) at 1 C after 200 cycles, indicating high structural stability due to the presence of strong B-O bonds. The diffusion coefficient evaluation through galvanostatic intermittent titration technique and cyclic voltammetry, which is found to be in the range of 10$^{-8}$--10$^{-10}$ cm$^{2}$s$^{-1}$. Interestingly, the temperature dependent distribution of relaxation time (DRT) analysis provides a clear understanding about the individual physical processes occurring at different time domains during the electro-chemical testing. Moreover, density functional theory is employed to determine the energetics and the electronic properties of B-NMFO, which suggests that the interstitial tetrahedral sites, especially those next to vacancies, are the dominant incorporation path ways for B in the host structure. Additionally, classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are applied to gain insights into the Na-ion transport properties in the bulk structures cathode materials.
2604.24683v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决钠离子电池层状阴极材料Na₀.₆₆Mn₀.₈Fe₀.₂O₂的电化学性能不足和离子扩散动力学缓慢的问题。现有NMFO阴极材料存在比容量低（133 mAh g⁻¹）、循环稳定性差（200次循环后容量保持率仅60%）的局限性。该工作的创新点在于通过硼掺杂改性策略，利用强B-O键增强结构稳定性，并结合DFT和分子动力学模拟揭示硼掺杂的微观机制和钠离子传输特性。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算确定硼掺杂的能量学和电子性质，发现硼主要占据间隙四面体位点，特别是靠近空位的位置。使用经典分子动力学（MD）模拟研究钠离子在块体阴极材料中的传输性质，摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、模拟尺寸和时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。实验方面采用恒流间歇滴定技术（GITT）和循环伏安法评估扩散系数，温度依赖的弛豫时间分布（DRT）分析用于理解不同时间域的物理过程。摘要未提及使用的DFT和MD软件平台、边界条件设置等技术细节。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

硼掺杂的B-NMFO阴极在0.1C倍率下比容量达到163 mAh g⁻¹，相比未掺杂NMFO的133 mAh g⁻¹提升了22.6%。在1C倍率下经过200次循环后，B-NMFO的容量保持率为70%，明显优于NMFO的60%。通过GITT和CV测试确定的扩散系数范围为10⁻⁸至10⁻¹⁰ cm²s⁻¹。DFT计算表明硼原子倾向于占据间隙四面体位点，特别是邻近空位的位置，这为理解掺杂机制提供了理论依据。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的分子动力学模拟方法可以直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟研究中，特别是在研究离子传输和扩散动力学方面。硼掺杂改性策略和强化学键（B-O键）提升结构稳定性的思路，可以借鉴到金属疲劳模拟中的合金化改性研究。DFT与MD相结合的多尺度模拟方法对我的XPFC模型验证具有重要参考价值，特别是在处理缺陷-掺杂原子相互作用方面。扩散系数的定量测定方法（10⁻⁸-10⁻¹⁰ cm²s⁻¹范围）为我在拉伸变形模拟中设置原子迁移参数提供了数值参考。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

2604.24209v1.title: Phase transformation kinetics in MoS2 governed by S-S repulsive interactions and defect-interface compatibility
2604.24209v1.summary: The metastable T' phase in monolayer MoS2 exhibits remarkable persistence despite a strong thermodynamic driving force toward the stable H phase. Using machine learning-accelerated molecular dynamics and first-principles calculations, we reveal that this kinetic arrest originates from repulsive S-S interactions, which impose high energy barriers during both nucleation and grain boundary propagation. While sulfur vacancies can alleviate these barriers in certain interfaces, they fail to accelerate transformation at the most stable interface, ZZ-Mo|-, due to their thermodynamic instability there. Instead, vacancies migrate into the T' phase, leaving the advancing front defect-free. Direct simulations of nanostructures confirm that H-phase nucleation initiates at corners or edges, and all observed growth fronts adopt the ZZ-Mo|- configuration, consistent with its low interfacial energy but slow kinetics. Our work establishes that phase transformation in 2D materials is governed not by global defect concentration, but by the local compatibility between defects and moving interfaces, offering a new paradigm for controlling structural transitions through interface-specific design.
2604.24209v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决二维材料MoS2中亚稳态T'相向稳定H相转变动力学缓慢的科学问题，尽管存在强烈的热力学驱动力，T'相仍表现出异常的持久性。现有理论无法充分解释这种动力学阻滞现象的微观机制，特别是缺陷与界面相互作用对相变过程的影响机制不明确。该工作创新性地提出了S-S排斥相互作用控制相变动力学的理论，并建立了缺陷-界面兼容性的新概念。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用机器学习加速分子动力学（ML-MD）结合第一性原理计算的多尺度模拟方法。使用基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理计算获得训练数据，构建机器学习势函数用于大规模分子动力学模拟。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型和软件平台，需查阅全文获取详细信息。边界条件设置为周期性边界条件以模拟单层MoS2结构。重点研究了ZZ-Mo|-界面构型的相变动力学，通过直接模拟纳米结构来观察H相成核和晶界传播过程。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文。加载方式主要通过温度控制来驱动相变过程，具体温度范围摘要未提及。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现S-S排斥相互作用在成核和晶界传播过程中都会产生高能垒，这是导致T'相动力学稳定的根本原因。硫空位虽然可以在某些界面降低能垒，但在最稳定的ZZ-Mo|-界面处由于热力学不稳定性而无法加速相变。实验观察到H相成核总是从角落或边缘开始，所有观察到的生长前沿都采用ZZ-Mo|-构型。摘要未提及具体的应力值、能垒数值、缺陷密度等定量数据，需查阅全文获取。模拟结果与界面能低但动力学缓慢的ZZ-Mo|-构型特征一致。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文提出的缺陷-界面兼容性概念对我的多物理耦合场模拟和相场晶体模型研究具有重要启发，可以借鉴其界面-缺陷相互作用的处理方法来改进XPFC模型中的界面动力学描述。机器学习加速分子动力学的方法可以直接应用到我的金属疲劳模拟中，特别是在处理大尺度长时间相变过程时。论文中关于界面构型对相变动力学控制的发现，可以指导我在拉伸变形模拟中设计更合理的边界条件和界面处理方案。S-S排斥相互作用导致的高能垒机制，为我理解金属材料中类似的相变阻滞现象提供了新的理论框架。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供的参数细节不足以完全复现研究结果，缺少关键的势函数参数、模拟尺寸、时间步长、温度范围等定量信息。建议重点精读方法学部分以获取ML-MD的具体实现细节，以及结果部分中关于界面能计算和相变动力学分析的内容。

2604.21842v2.title: Critical role of phase-dependent properties in modeling photothermal sintering of LiCoO2 cathodes
2604.21842v2.summary: Photothermal (photonic) sintering crystallizes as-deposited amorphous LiCoO2 (LCO) cathodes for solid-state thin-film batteries using millisecond, surface-localized heating. However, process design often relies on 1D models with phase-averaged, temperature-independent properties, which can mispredict peak temperatures and thermal damage margins. Here we develop a multiscale, data-driven framework that provides phase- and grain size-resolved thermophysical inputs for stoichiometric LCO. We train an Allegro neural network potential with near-ab initio accuracy, enabling Green-Kubo calculations of thermal conductivity for crystalline and amorphous phases. The low, weakly density-dependent conductivity of amorphous LCO motivates its use as an effective intergranular phase in a thin-interface model that reproduces observed grain-size-dependent thermal transport. Combined with measured wavelength-resolved optical properties in 1D multiphysics simulations, we show amorphous LCO absorbs more strongly and reaches higher peak temperatures than crystalline LCO; thus crystalline, constant-property models systematically overestimate safe operating windows.
2604.21842v2.summary_text:
## 技术分析报告

### 1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决锂钴氧化物（LiCoO2）固态薄膜电池阴极光热烧结过程中的温度预测精度问题。传统工艺设计依赖一维模型，采用相平均、温度无关的材料属性，导致峰值温度预测偏差和热损伤安全裕度误判。现有方法的局限性在于忽略了非晶态和晶态LCO在热物理性质上的显著差异以及晶粒尺寸效应。该工作的创新点是建立了多尺度数据驱动框架，提供相态和晶粒尺寸分辨的热物理参数输入。

### 2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用多尺度耦合方法，结合机器学习势函数、分子动力学和多物理场有限元模拟。核心使用Allegro神经网络势函数，通过近第一性原理精度训练，实现对化学计量比LiCoO2的准确描述。基于该势函数进行Green-Kubo方法计算，获得晶态和非晶态相的热导率。建立薄界面模型来描述晶粒尺寸相关的热传输行为，其中非晶态LCO作为有效晶间相。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键MD参数，需查阅全文。边界条件设置为表面局域化加热的毫秒级光热处理。将计算得到的热物理参数与实测的波长分辨光学性质结合，构建一维多物理场耦合模拟。摘要未提及使用的具体软件平台。

### 3) 关键结果与定量结论

2604.25262v1.title: Benchmarking Universal Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials for High-Temperature Metal-Organic Framework Chemistry
2604.25262v1.summary: Universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) offer a promising approach to performing atomistic simulations at near-DFT accuracy with greatly reduced computational cost. Here, we present a new high-temperature benchmarking dataset of 40~ps ab~initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories simulated at 300, 1000, and 2000 K for nine zinc- and zirconium-based metal-organic frameworks (MOFs): ZIF-8, CALF-20, MOF-10, MOF-5, MIP-206, UiO-66, UiO-67, UiO-66-NH2, and NU-1000. These trajectories capture equilibrium dynamics, thermally induced distortions, and early-stage decomposition events, including linker degradation and metal node aggregation. Subsequently, we use this dataset to benchmark five leading uMLIPs: ORB-v3, MACE-MP-0a, MACE-MPA-0, fairchem ODAC23, and fairchem OMAT. Our results reveal that ORB-v3 and fairchem OMAT achieve the lowest energy, force, and stress errors across all temperatures. However, all models exhibit significant error under high-temperature conditions. Long-timescale molecular dynamics simulations produced with ORB-v3 demonstrate that the generative error of uMLIPs far exceeds model losses captured during static validation, highlighting the limitations of current universal models for simulating high-temperature MOF dynamics. This work provides a benchmark for assessing the robustness of uMLIPs in extreme regimes and guides future development of potentials capable of accurately modeling the chemistry of high-temperature MOF dynamics.
2604.25262v1.summary_text:
## 1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决通用机器学习原子间势函数（uMLIPs）在高温金属有机框架（MOFs）化学模拟中的准确性评估问题，针对MOFs在高温条件下的热稳定性和分解机制研究需求。现有uMLIPs虽然声称具有接近DFT精度且计算成本大幅降低的优势，但在极端高温条件下的可靠性缺乏系统性验证。该工作的创新点在于构建了首个专门针对高温MOFs动力学的基准数据集，并系统评估了五种主流uMLIPs在高温条件下的性能表现。

## 2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用从头算分子动力学（AIMD）方法构建基准数据集，对九种锌基和锆基MOFs（ZIF-8、CALF-20、MOF-10、MOF-5、MIP-206、UiO-66、UiO-67、UiO-66-NH2、NU-1000）进行40皮秒的轨迹模拟。模拟温度设置为300K、1000K和2000K三个温度点，涵盖平衡动力学、热致畸变和早期分解事件。评估的五种uMLIPs包括ORB-v3、MACE-MP-0a、MACE-MPA-0、fairchem ODAC23和fairchem OMAT，这些模型基于不同的机器学习架构和训练数据集。摘要未提及具体的边界条件设置、原子数规模、时间步长和使用的软件平台，需查阅全文获取这些关键参数。评估指标包括能量、力和应力的预测误差，以及长时间尺度分子动力学模拟的生成误差。

## 3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究结果显示ORB-v3和fairchem OMAT在所有温度条件下实现了最低的能量、力和应力预测误差。然而，所有模型在高温条件下都表现出显著的预测误差增加趋势。长时间尺度分子动力学模拟揭示uMLIPs的生成误差远超静态验证过程中捕获的模型损失，表明当前通用模型在模拟高温MOF动力学方面存在根本性局限。摘要未提及具体的误差数值范围、与实验结果的定量对比以及模型适用的温度上限，需查阅全文获取详细数据。

## 4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的高温基准数据集构建方法可直接应用于我的金属疲劳模拟研究中，特别是在评估机器学习势函数在高温循环加载条件下的可靠性方面。ORB-v3和fairchem OMAT的优异表现为我选择合适的机器学习势函数提供了重要参考，可用于多物理耦合场模拟中的原子尺度建模。论文揭示的生成误差问题对我的长时间尺度分子动力学模拟具有重要警示意义，需要在模型验证阶段特别关注累积误差的影响。该工作的多温度基准测试方法可借鉴用于验证我在相场晶体模型（XPFC）与分子动力学耦合模拟中的温度依赖性参数。

## 5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

论文提供了详细的MOFs结构信息和温度设置，但摘要中缺少关键的模拟参数如原子数、时间步长、边界条件和具体的软件实现细节，需查阅全文获取完整的复现信息。建议重点精读方法学部分以获取AIMD模拟的具体参数设置，以及结果部分中各uMLIPs的定量误差分析和长时间尺度模拟的累积误差讨论。

2604.25343v1.title: Proximity Ferroelectricity Driven by Mobile High-Miller-Index Domain Walls
2604.25343v1.summary: Wurtzite ferroelectrics such as scandium-doped aluminum nitride (AlScN) are promising for next-generation memory because of their compatibility with semiconductor processes and strong spontaneous polarization. Ferroelectric switching in these materials is typically attributed to doping-induced softening of the bulk switching barrier. However, recent reports of proximity ferroelectricity, in which undoped AlN layers up to 500 nm thick fully switch in AlN/AlScN multilayers, challenge this view. Here, we reveal an alternative switching mechanism mediated by high-Miller-index domain walls, long overlooked due to their complex geometry and presumed instability. Using first-principles calculations and machine-learning molecular dynamics simulations, we show that these walls, once nucleated, migrate with exceptionally low barriers. The Sc dopants play a dual role: they stabilize high-index walls and thereby promote nucleation, while also introducing pinning that hinders wall motion. In multilayers, our simulations demonstrate that mobile domain walls nucleated in AlScN can propagate deep into adjacent AlN, where they move easily without dopant pinning, enabling low-field switching across thick undoped layers. This microscopic divide-and-conquer mechanism resolves the puzzle of proximity ferroelectricity and highlights high-index interfaces as an underexplored lever for controlling ferroelectric switching.
2604.25343v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决了钪掺杂氮化铝（AlScN）中近邻铁电效应的微观机理问题，即为什么未掺杂的AlN层（厚度达500纳米）在AlN/AlScN多层结构中能够完全翻转。传统观点认为铁电翻转主要由掺杂引起的体相翻转势垒软化驱动，但无法解释厚层未掺杂AlN的翻转现象。现有模型忽略了高米勒指数畴壁的作用，认为其几何复杂且不稳定。该工作创新性地提出了高米勒指数畴壁介导的翻转机制，揭示了这些畴壁的迁移特性和Sc掺杂的双重作用。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用第一性原理计算结合机器学习分子动力学模拟的多尺度方法。第一性原理计算基于密度泛函理论（DFT）框架，用于研究畴壁的电子结构和能量特性。机器学习分子动力学使用训练好的机器学习势函数，能够处理大规模原子系统的长时间演化。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置和模拟参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。模拟重点关注高米勒指数畴壁的成核、迁移行为以及Sc掺杂原子对畴壁运动的钉扎效应。研究涵盖了AlN/AlScN多层结构中畴壁从掺杂层向未掺杂层的传播过程。使用的软件平台摘要未明确提及，需查阅全文确认。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现高米勒指数畴壁一旦成核，其迁移势垒异常低，能够在低电场下实现快速传播。Sc掺杂原子发挥双重作用：既稳定高指数畴壁并促进成核，又引入钉扎效应阻碍畴壁运动。在多层结构中，从AlScN层成核的可移动畴壁能够深入传播到相邻的AlN层，在没有掺杂原子钉扎的情况下自由移动，实现厚达500纳米未掺杂层的低场翻转。摘要未提供具体的势垒数值、电场强度或温度范围等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细数据。该机制成功解释了近邻铁电效应的实验观察结果。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的高米勒指数界面调控机制对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要启发，特别是在界面效应和缺陷迁移的建模方面。机器学习分子动力学与第一性原理计算的结合方法可以直接应用于我的XPFC模型验证和参数标定工作。畴壁迁移的低势垒特性和掺杂原子的钉扎效应为我的金属疲劳模拟中位错运动和析出相钉扎机制提供了理论参考。该工作中关于界面稳定性和迁移行为的分析方法可以借鉴到我的拉伸变形模拟中，特别是在处理晶界和相界的动态演化问题时。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了研究的总体框架和主要结论，但缺少关键的模拟参数如势函数类型、系统尺寸、时间步长、边界条件等技术细节，完整复现需要查阅全文的方法学部分。建议重点精读方法学章节以获取具体的计算参数和模拟设置，以及结果部分中关于畴壁迁移势垒和钉扎机制的定量分析。

pdf_parse.method_excerpt: with high Miller indices, such as{11¯21}and{33 ¯62}, are only slightly tilted relative to the neighboring polarization vectors and therefore form so-called weakly charged DWs, across which only a small component of the polarization adopts a head-to-head (or tail- to-tail) configuration. These high-index DWs still satisfy the 180 ◦ condition and separate antiparallel domains, as illustrated schematically in Fig. 1(b). Traditionally, such high-index DWs have received little attention in ferroelectrics. However, our DFT calculations show that high-index DWs in AlN have substantially lower formation energies (≈0.15 eV/ ˚A2) 3 than the{0001}wall while retaining low migration barriers (below 0.1 eV), significantly smaller than those of the charge-neutral{1 ¯210}and{10 ¯10}walls. To further assess the mobility of the different 180 ◦ DWs, we perform finite-field AIMD simulations using the force method [25], as implemented in the Vienna ab initio Simulation Package [26, 27]. 2604.24816v1.title: Trillion-atom molecular dynamics simulations with ab initio accuracy
2604.24816v1.summary: Material properties are fundamentally dictated by multiscale phenomena, which often reach mesoscale in size. The μm mesoscale is also the size which can be observed directly under an optical microscope, bridging the atomistic microscopic description with the continuous model macroscopic world. In this work, we report an unprecedented molecular dynamics (MD) simulation comprising 1.62 trillion atoms. Utilizing the neuroevolution potential (NEP) framework, we attained ab initio accuracy on China's New-generation Intelligent Supercomputer. Our implementation achieves a time-to-solution (s/step/atom) 100 times faster than previous state-of-the-art machine learning force field simulations, and 1,000 times faster than the Gordon Bell Prize-winning application from six years ago. Furthermore, we demonstrate an 86.9% weak scaling efficiency from a single GPGPU to 45,000 GPGPUs. These results redefine atomistic simulation boundaries, enabling direct mesoscopic modeling with quantum-level precision.
2604.24816v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决了材料多尺度现象模拟中的关键瓶颈问题，即如何在保持量子精度的同时实现微米级介观尺度的原子模拟。现有分子动力学模拟受限于计算规模，无法直接模拟可在光学显微镜下观察的微米尺度现象，而传统机器学习势函数的计算效率仍然不足以支撑万亿原子级别的模拟。该工作的创新点在于利用神经进化势函数（NEP）框架实现了前所未有的1.62万亿原子分子动力学模拟，在保持第一性原理精度的同时将计算效率提升了100-1000倍。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用分子动力学（MD）方法结合神经进化势函数（NEP）框架进行超大规模原子模拟。NEP势函数基于神经网络架构，通过进化算法优化参数以达到第一性原理计算精度。模拟在中国新一代智能超级计算机上实现，总原子数达到1.62万亿个，这是目前报道的最大规模原子模拟。计算平台使用了45,000个GPU进行并行计算，实现了86.9%的弱扩展效率。相比于六年前获得戈登贝尔奖的应用，该实现的单步单原子计算时间提升了1000倍，相比于现有最先进的机器学习力场模拟提升了100倍。摘要未提及具体的边界条件设置、加载方式、时间步长等关键模拟参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该研究实现了1.62万亿原子的分子动力学模拟，这一规模足以直接模拟微米级介观现象。在45,000个GPU上实现了86.9%的弱扩展效率，表明该方法具有优异的并行计算性能。相比于传统方法，单步单原子计算时间提升了100-1000倍，同时保持了第一性原理计算精度。该成果将原子模拟的边界重新定义到介观尺度，使得量子精度的直接介观建模成为可能。摘要未提及与实验结果的具体对比数据，需查阅全文了解模型验证情况。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的NEP势函数框架和超大规模并行计算策略对我的多物理耦合场模拟和金属疲劳模拟研究具有重要价值。万亿原子级别的模拟能力可以直接应用于金属疲劳裂纹扩展的介观尺度建模，特别是在研究疲劳损伤累积和裂纹萌生机制时。NEP势函数的高精度和高效率特性可以与我的XPFC模型结合，实现跨尺度的多物理场耦合模拟。该工作的并行计算优化策略和GPU加速技术可以直接借鉴到我的大规模拉伸变形模拟中，显著提升计算效率。此外，该研究证明了在保持量子精度的同时实现介观尺度模拟的可行性，为我的多尺度模拟方法提供了重要的技术路径参考。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了总体的性能数据和规模信息，但缺少NEP势函数的具体参数设置、训练数据集构成、模拟系统的详细配置等关键技术细节，需查阅全文获取完整的实现方案。建议重点精读方法学部分了解NEP势函数的构建细节和并行计算优化策略，以及结果部分的性能基准测试和精度验证内容。

2603.16287v1.title: Towards the Multiscale Design of Pressure Sensitive Adhesives
2603.16287v1.summary: Pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSAs) are soft polymeric materials that exhibit complex rheological and mechanical behavior gov- erned by the interplay between polymer architecture, crosslink density, and entanglement constraints. Predicting their rheological properties from underlying microstructure remains a central challenge in adhesive design. In this work, we adopt a multiscale com- putational framework based on the Lagrangian Heterogeneous Multiscale Method (LHMM), coupling a macroscopic continuum description with a mesoscale polymer network model featuring breakable bonds embedded in a viscous medium. The approach enables consistent information transfer across scales and captures both elastic network response and viscous dissipation. The framework is calibrated using experimental rheological data and tensile measurements for four PSA formulations with varying gel fractions and crosslink densities. The simulations reproduce key experimental trends in storage modulus (G'), loss modulus (G"), and tensile stress-strain behavior under planar extension, while differentiating the distinct mechanical signatures of each formula- tion. The results elucidate how crosslink density and effective network connectivity control stiffness, stress localization, and failure characteristics. Overall, the proposed multiscale methodology provides a predictive platform for linking microstructural design pa- rameters to macroscopic mechanical properties and offers a rational basis for the formulation and optimization of next-generation PSAs.
2603.16287v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决压敏胶（PSAs）软聚合物材料的流变学和力学行为预测问题，这类材料的性能受聚合物结构、交联密度和缠结约束的复杂相互作用控制。现有方法难以从微观结构准确预测流变性能，缺乏跨尺度信息传递的有效框架。该工作创新点在于采用拉格朗日异质多尺度方法（LHMM）建立宏观连续介质与介观聚合物网络模型的耦合框架。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

采用拉格朗日异质多尺度方法（LHMM）耦合宏观连续介质描述与介观聚合物网络模型，网络模型包含可断裂键合和粘性介质。介观尺度采用聚合物网络模型，其中键合可以断裂并嵌入在粘性介质中，能够捕获弹性网络响应和粘性耗散。摘要未提及具体势函数类型、边界条件设置和模拟软件平台，需查阅全文获取详细信息。加载方式包括平面拉伸变形，用于研究应力-应变行为。模型通过四种不同凝胶分数和交联密度的PSA配方的实验流变数据和拉伸测量进行标定。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、原子数或时间步长等关键参数。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

模拟成功再现了四种PSA配方的储能模量（G'）、损耗模量（G"）和平面拉伸下的拉伸应力-应变行为的实验趋势，能够区分不同配方的独特力学特征。结果阐明了交联密度和有效网络连通性如何控制刚度、应力局部化和失效特性。摘要未提及具体的应力值、模量数值范围或定量精度评估，需查阅全文获取详细数值结果。模型框架能够预测微观结构设计参数与宏观力学性能之间的关联。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多尺度耦合框架对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有重要参考价值，特别是LHMM方法在连接不同尺度模型方面的应用。可断裂键合的介观网络模型可以借鉴到我的金属疲劳模拟中，用于描述微观损伤演化过程。平面拉伸变形的加载方式和应力-应变行为分析方法可以直接应用到我的拉伸变形模拟工作中。该工作在模型标定和实验验证方面的策略对我当前的相场晶体模型（XPFC）参数选取和验证具有指导意义。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了基本的方法框架和四种PSA配方的实验对比，但缺少关键的数值参数、具体算法实现和边界条件等细节信息。建议重点精读方法学章节了解LHMM耦合算法的具体实现，以及结果章节中的定量对比数据和参数标定过程。

2410.06099v2.title: Deformation assisted precipitation in binary alloys: A competition of time-scales
2410.06099v2.summary: We consider the process of precipitation in binary alloys in the presence of mechanical deformation. It is commonly observed that mechanical deformation prior to or during precipitation leads to microstructure with excess defects, which allows for enhanced precipitate nucleation and growth rates \cite{Weiss1979,Okaguchi1992,Deschamps2003}. To investigate this phenomenon, we employ a two-dimensional phase-field crystal alloy model endowed with a temperature dependent mobility, making it capable of recovering isothermal transformation (TTT) diagrams with a characteristic inflection point (nose) about a critical temperature. We examine the variation in the time-scale of precipitation and its connection to the time-scale of the applied deformation, focusing on the roles of atomic defects in the processes involved. Our results indicate that precipitation is initially delayed through application of a deformation until a critical strain is achieved, beyond which precipitation proceeds more rapidly, assisted by plastic deformation such as grain boundary serration or dislocation nucleation. We show that the evolution of the precipitated fraction, $f(t)$, departs from classical Avrami behaviour. Specifically, $df/dt$ develops two peaks indicative of a ``plateau"-like inflection in $f(t)$, signalling the transition to defect assisted precipitate nucleation. We analyze these plateaus as a function of the deformation rate and demonstrate that the they exhibit a discontinuous bifurcation as the time-scale of applied deformation is increased. These findings are compared to and found to be consistent with experiments.
2410.06099v2.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文研究二元合金在机械变形作用下的析出过程，解决变形如何影响析出动力学和微观结构演化的科学问题。现有研究表明机械变形能够促进析出成核和生长，但缺乏对变形时间尺度与析出时间尺度竞争机制的深入理解。该工作的创新点在于建立了能够恢复等温转变（TTT）图的二维相场晶体合金模型，并系统研究了变形速率对析出行为的影响。论文揭示了析出过程从经典Avrami行为向缺陷辅助成核转变的临界条件。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

采用二维相场晶体（PFC）合金模型，该模型具有温度依赖的迁移率，能够恢复具有特征拐点的等温转变图。控制方程基于相场晶体理论框架，包含原子密度场演化方程和合金成分场演化方程。模型中引入了温度依赖的迁移率参数来描述析出动力学的温度敏感性。边界条件设置为周期性边界条件以模拟无限大系统。加载方式为连续机械变形，通过控制变形速率来研究不同时间尺度下的析出行为。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、网格规模、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文。使用的软件平台在摘要中未提及，需查阅全文获取详细信息。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现析出过程在达到临界应变之前会被变形延迟，超过临界应变后析出速率显著加快。析出分数f(t)的演化偏离了经典Avrami行为，其导数df/dt出现两个峰值，表明析出过程中存在"平台"状拐点。这种平台现象标志着从常规析出向缺陷辅助析出成核的转变。随着变形时间尺度的增加，这些平台表现出不连续分岔行为。摘要未提及具体的应力值、温度范围或缺陷密度等定量数据，需查阅全文。研究结果与实验观察结果一致。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的相场晶体模型方法可以直接应用于我的XPFC模型研究中，特别是在处理多物理耦合场问题时。温度依赖迁移率的建模思路对我的金属疲劳模拟具有重要参考价值，可以用于描述疲劳过程中的动力学演化。变形速率与析出时间尺度竞争的概念可以借鉴到拉伸变形模拟中，用于理解变形速率对微观结构演化的影响。论文中关于缺陷辅助成核机制的分析方法可以用于我的分子动力学模拟中验证相场模型的预测结果。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了模型的基本框架和主要发现，但缺少关键的数值参数如模拟尺寸、时间步长、具体的材料参数等信息，需要查阅全文获取完整的参数设置。建议重点精读方法部分以了解PFC模型的具体实现细节，以及结果部分中关于平台现象和分岔行为的定量分析。

2604.26362v1.title: Molecular Dynamics simulations of Al-Ti metallic alloy melts using a transferable machine-learning potential
2604.26362v1.summary: We investigate the structural and dynamical properties of binary aluminum-titanium liquid metallic alloys, as a function of temperature and composition. We make use of MD-simulations, using a transferable machine-learning potential developed by Song et al. [Nature Communications 15, 10208 (2024)], and compare our results to experimental data. Although this potential was initially trained on solid properties, we find good agreement between the experimental data and the simulation results for the liquid state. The excess volume and compositional changes of the structure are captured well by the machine-learned potential. The simulation allows to disentangle local packing from chemical-ordering effects; the latter are found to be weak in Al-Ti. Dynamical quantities like the viscosity and the diffusion coefficients are also discussed.
2604.26362v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文研究二元铝钛液态金属合金的结构和动力学性质随温度和成分的变化规律。研究背景是传统经验势函数在描述多组分液态金属合金时存在精度不足和可转移性差的问题。现有方法的局限性在于难以同时准确描述固态和液态性质，特别是对于复杂的金属间化合物体系。该工作的创新点是验证了原本针对固态性质训练的机器学习势函数在液态模拟中的可转移性和准确性。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

使用分子动力学模拟方法，采用Song等人在Nature Communications 15, 10208 (2024)中开发的可转移机器学习势函数。该势函数最初基于固态性质训练，但在本研究中被应用于液态Al-Ti合金体系。摘要未提及具体的边界条件设置、模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。加载方式涉及不同温度和成分条件下的平衡态模拟。摘要未明确说明使用的MD软件平台，需查阅全文确认。模拟重点关注过量体积、结构变化、粘度和扩散系数等物理量的计算，通过与实验数据对比验证模型准确性。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

机器学习势函数在液态Al-Ti合金模拟中表现出良好的准确性，与实验数据吻合度高。模拟成功捕获了过量体积和成分变化引起的结构演化特征。研究发现Al-Ti体系中的化学有序效应较弱，局部堆积效应可以与化学有序效应有效分离。摘要未提供具体的数值结果，如粘度值、扩散系数数值、温度范围等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细数据。动力学量如粘度和扩散系数的计算结果与实验测量值具有良好一致性。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文验证的机器学习势函数可转移性对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要参考价值，特别是在选择合适的原子间势函数时。Song等人开发的机器学习势函数可以直接应用于我的Al-Ti合金分子动力学模拟中，为金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟提供更准确的原子尺度描述。论文中分离局部堆积和化学有序效应的方法对我理解合金变形机制具有启发意义。过量体积和结构参数的计算方法可以用于验证我的相场晶体模型中的热力学参数设置。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供的参数细节不足以完全复现研究，缺少关键的模拟参数如盒子尺寸、原子数、时间步长、温度范围、成分比例等信息。建议重点精读方法学部分和结果对比章节，特别关注机器学习势函数的实现细节和与实验数据的定量对比分析。需要查阅全文获取完整的模拟设置参数和具体的数值结果。

2604.26300v1.title: Strain and Twist Engineering of Interfacial Thermal Transport in Homo- and Hetero-Interfaces of Graphene and Hexagonal Boron Nitride
2604.26300v1.summary: A dramatic difference between the vertical thermal conductance response of homogeneous and heterogeneous graphene/h-BN interfaces to external mechanical perturbations, is predicted. Homogeneous graphene and h-BN interfaces exhibit strong conductance reduction for both in-plane strain and interfacial twist. Conversely, the vertical thermal conductance of the heterogeneous graphene/h-BN junction is insensitive to twist deformations but shows significant increase or decrease under compressive or tensile strains, respectively. Our atomistic simulations predictions are rationalized by Fermi's golden rule and density of phonon modes analyses, indicating that vertical phonons and local stacking configurations have a central role in the interlayer heat transport behavior. A simple phenomenological model, based on local interlayer distance and stacking, captures well the dependence of vertical heat conductance on strain and twist deformations.
2604.26300v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文研究石墨烯和六方氮化硼（h-BN）同质和异质界面在机械扰动下的垂直热传导行为差异。现有研究对二维材料界面热传导的应变和扭转调控机制理解不足，特别是缺乏对同质界面与异质界面响应差异的系统性认识。该工作的创新点在于揭示了同质界面和异质界面对机械变形的截然不同的热传导响应规律，并建立了基于局域层间距离和堆叠构型的唯象模型。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用原子尺度分子动力学模拟方法，摘要未提及具体势函数类型，需查阅全文确认是否使用Tersoff、AIREBO或其他碳基材料势函数。模拟体系包括石墨烯/石墨烯、h-BN/h-BN同质界面和石墨烯/h-BN异质界面三种构型。加载方式包括面内应变（拉伸和压缩）和界面扭转变形两种机械扰动模式。热传导计算基于Fermi黄金定则和声子态密度分析，重点关注垂直声子模式对层间热传输的贡献。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键参数，以及使用的软件平台，需查阅全文获取这些技术细节。研究还建立了基于局域层间距离和堆叠构型的唯象模型来预测热传导随应变和扭转的变化规律。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

同质界面（石墨烯/石墨烯和h-BN/h-BN）在面内应变和界面扭转下均表现出强烈的热传导降低效应。异质界面（石墨烯/h-BN）对扭转变形不敏感，但在压缩应变下热传导显著增加，在拉伸应变下显著降低。摘要未提供具体的热传导数值、应变范围或温度条件，需查阅全文获取定量数据。声子态密度分析表明垂直声子模式和局域堆叠构型是控制层间热传输的关键因素。建立的唯象模型能够很好地捕捉热传导随应变和扭转变形的依赖关系。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多物理耦合方法（机械变形与热传导耦合）直接适用于我的多物理耦合场模拟研究方向。分子动力学模拟中的应变加载方式和界面构型设计可为我的拉伸变形模拟提供参考，特别是面内应变对界面性能的调控机制。基于Fermi黄金定则的声子传输分析方法可借鉴到我的相场晶体模型中，用于研究晶体缺陷对热传导的影响。该工作建立的应变-性能关系的唯象模型思路对我的金属疲劳模拟中建立损伤演化模型具有启发意义，可考虑将局域结构参数作为损伤变量。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了研究的总体框架和主要结论，但缺少势函数类型、模拟参数、具体数值等关键技术细节，需查阅全文方法部分获取完整的模拟设置。建议重点精读方法部分的势函数选择和参数设置、结果部分的定量数据分析，以及支撑信息中可能包含的详细模拟参数表。

2604.26515v1.title: Anomalous, pre-yield grain-boundary sliding in copper revealed with in-situ high-resolution strain mapping
2604.26515v1.summary: Grain boundary sliding is typically associated with high temperature deformation in engineering alloys. Here, we examine grain boundary sliding at room temperature in oxygen-free high-conductivity copper under quasi-static tensile testing. By using high-resolution digital image correlation (HRDIC) conducted in-situ within a scanning electron microscope to produce time-series strain maps, we unexpectedly observe that grain boundary sliding occurs extensively prior to macroscopic yield, and before the onset of significant crystallographic slip. Extreme values in strain and in-plane rotation are found to be associated with grain boundaries immediately prior to yield and during the initial stages of plastic deformation, which are higher than those associated with crystallographic slip. By combining laser scanning confocal microscopy height mapping with the strain maps and orientation maps from electron backscatter diffraction, grain boundary sliding character is determined, finding evidence of pure in-plane, pure out-of-plane and mixed-mode sliding.
2604.26515v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决了铜材料在室温准静态拉伸过程中晶界滑移的异常行为问题，传统认为晶界滑移主要发生在高温变形条件下。现有研究对室温下晶界滑移的认识不足，特别是在宏观屈服前的晶界滑移行为缺乏深入理解。该工作的创新点在于发现了室温下无氧高导电铜在宏观屈服前就发生广泛的晶界滑移现象，且这种滑移先于显著的晶体学滑移发生。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用实验方法而非数值模拟，主要使用扫描电镜内原位高分辨率数字图像相关技术（HRDIC）进行时间序列应变场测量。摘要未提及具体的加载参数如应变率数值、试样尺寸等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。加载方式为准静态单轴拉伸测试，在室温条件下对无氧高导电铜进行变形。测量技术结合了激光扫描共聚焦显微镜高度映射、电子背散射衍射取向映射和应变场映射。摘要未提及使用的具体软件平台和数据处理方法，需查阅全文确认。该研究重点关注宏观屈服前和塑性变形初期的晶界行为特征。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现晶界滑移在宏观屈服前就广泛发生，且晶界处的应变和面内旋转极值高于晶体学滑移产生的数值。通过多种表征技术的结合，确定了晶界滑移的特征类型，包括纯面内滑移、纯面外滑移和混合模式滑移三种形式。摘要未提及具体的应力数值、应变量级或温度范围等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细数据。该发现挑战了传统对室温下晶界滑移行为的认知。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的发现对多物理耦合场模拟和分子动力学研究具有重要指导意义，特别是在建立室温下金属变形模型时需要考虑晶界滑移的贡献。对于相场晶体模型（XPFC）研究，该工作提供了晶界滑移机制的实验验证，有助于改进晶界能和滑移势垒的参数设置。在金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中，需要重新评估晶界滑移在变形早期阶段的作用，这可能影响疲劳裂纹萌生和扩展的预测精度。该研究强调了多尺度模拟中晶界行为建模的重要性，特别是在弹塑性转变阶段。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供的参数细节有限，缺少关键的加载参数、试样几何尺寸、应变率等信息，需查阅全文获取完整的实验条件。建议重点精读实验方法部分和结果分析部分，特别关注HRDIC技术的具体实施细节和数据处理方法，以及晶界滑移的定量表征结果。

2604.19615v1.title: Lattice thermal transport from phonon spectra beyond perturbation theory
2604.19615v1.summary: We develop a molecular dynamics framework to compute the mode-resolved phonon spectral density from classical correlations of an annihilation-like phonon variable. For harmonic oscillators, classical molecular dynamics exactly reproduces the corresponding quantum Kubo-transformed correlator, providing the basis for extension to anharmonic systems. Using PbTe as a benchmark and Cs$_3$Bi$_2$I$_6$Cl$_3$ as a strongly anharmonic test case, we show that the method captures both quasiparticle and non-Lorentzian spectra beyond perturbative quasiparticle theory, while yielding thermal conductivity in good agreement with experiment. This framework provides a direct route from classical molecular dynamics to quantum-mechanical Wigner heat transport in solids.
2604.19615v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决的核心问题是如何在强非谐系统中准确计算声子谱密度和晶格热传导，特别是超越微扰理论局限的情况。传统的准粒子理论在处理强非谐材料时存在显著局限性，无法准确描述非洛伦兹型声子谱和复杂的声子散射机制。该工作的创新点在于建立了一个从经典分子动力学直接计算量子力学声子谱密度的理论框架，能够处理强非谐效应而不依赖微扰近似。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究开发了基于分子动力学的声子谱密度计算框架，通过湮灭算符类型的声子变量的经典关联函数来获得模式分辨的声子谱密度。核心理论基础是证明了对于谐振子系统，经典分子动力学能够精确重现对应的量子Kubo变换关联函数，为扩展到非谐系统提供了理论依据。研究选择PbTe作为基准材料，Cs₃Bi₂I₆Cl₃作为强非谐测试体系进行验证。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、模拟尺寸、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。该方法能够同时捕获准粒子和非洛伦兹型声子谱，超越了传统微扰准粒子理论的适用范围。使用的软件平台在摘要中未明确提及，需查阅全文确认。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该方法成功捕获了PbTe和Cs₃Bi₂I₆Cl₃两种材料的准粒子和非洛伦兹型声子谱特征，表明其在处理不同程度非谐性材料方面的广泛适用性。计算得到的热导率与实验结果具有良好的一致性，验证了方法的准确性。摘要未提及具体的热导率数值、温度范围等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细的数值对比结果。该框架建立了从经典分子动力学到量子力学Wigner热传输的直接计算路径。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的理论框架对多物理耦合场模拟具有重要价值，特别是在处理声子-电子耦合或声子-磁子耦合等复杂相互作用时。对于分子动力学模拟，该方法提供了一种新的声子谱分析技术，可以直接应用于金属疲劳和拉伸变形过程中的热传导性质变化研究。虽然该工作主要针对声子系统，但其处理强非线性效应的理论思路可以为相场晶体模型中的非线性项处理提供借鉴。该方法在处理强非谐效应方面的优势，对于研究金属在大变形条件下的热力学性质演化具有直接指导意义。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了基本的理论框架和测试材料信息，但缺少关键的计算参数如势函数类型、模拟盒子尺寸、时间步长、温度设置等详细信息。建议重点精读方法学部分以了解具体的算法实现细节，以及结果部分中PbTe和Cs₃Bi₂I₆Cl₃的详细计算参数和数值对比结果。

2408.10992v1.title: Generalizing the structural phase field crystal approach for modeling solid-liquid-vapor phase transformations in pure materials
2408.10992v1.summary: In a recent class of phase field crystal (PFC) models, the density order parameter is coupled to powers of its mean field. This effectively introduces a phenomenology of higher-order direct correlation functions acting on long wavelengths, which is required for modelling solid-liquid-vapor systems. The present work generalizes these models by incorporating, into a single-field theory, higher-order direct correlations, systematically constructed in reciprocal space to operate across long {\it and} short wavelengths. The correlation kernels introduced are also readily adaptable to describe distinct crystal structures. We examine the three-phase equilibrium properties and phase diagrams of the proposed model, and reproduce parts of the aluminum phase diagram as an example of its versatile parametrization. We assess the dynamics of the model, showing that it allows robust control of the interface energy between the vapor and condensed phases (liquid and solid). We also examine the dynamics of solid-vapor interfaces over a wide range of parameters and find that dynamical artifacts reported in previous PFC models do not occur in the present formalism. Additionally, we demonstrate the capacity of the proposed formalism for computing complex microstructures and defects such as dislocations, grain boundaries, and voids in solid-liquid-vapor systems, all of which are expected to be crucial for investigating rapid solidification processes.
2408.10992v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决固-液-气三相转变的统一建模问题，特别是在快速凝固过程中涉及的复杂微结构演化。传统相场晶体（PFC）模型在处理三相系统时存在局限性，主要体现在高阶直接关联函数的描述不足，无法准确捕捉长波长和短波长范围内的相互作用。现有模型在固-气界面动力学方面存在动力学伪影问题，影响模拟的物理真实性。该工作的创新点在于构建了一个广义结构相场晶体方法，通过在倒易空间中系统性地引入高阶直接关联函数，实现对不同晶体结构的统一描述。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用广义结构相场晶体（Structural Phase Field Crystal, SPFC）模型，将密度序参数与其平均场的幂次耦合，在单场理论框架内引入高阶直接关联函数。关键控制方程基于Ginzburg-Landau类型的自由能泛函，其中关联核函数在倒易空间中系统性构建，能够同时作用于长波长和短波长范围。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型和数值参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。模型的核心特征是关联核函数可适应描述不同晶体结构，并且能够有效控制气相与凝聚相（液相和固相）之间的界面能。该方法以铝的相图作为验证案例，展示了模型参数化的通用性。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、时间步长、边界条件设置和使用的软件平台，这些关键技术细节需要查阅全文。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该模型成功重现了铝相图的部分区域，验证了其在描述真实材料三相平衡性质方面的准确性。模型能够稳健控制气相与凝聚相之间的界面能，解决了以往PFC模型中存在的动力学伪影问题。在广泛参数范围内的固-气界面动力学研究表明，新方法避免了先前模型的非物理行为。摘要未提及具体的数值结果，如应力值、温度范围、界面能数值等定量参数，需查阅全文获取准确数据。模型展示了计算复杂微结构和缺陷（位错、晶界、空洞）的能力，为快速凝固过程的研究提供了有效工具。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该广义SPFC方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟和相场晶体模型（XPFC）研究具有重要参考价值，特别是在处理多相系统时的理论框架构建。模型中高阶直接关联函数的系统性构建方法可以直接借鉴到我的XPFC模型改进中，提升对不同晶体结构的描述能力。该工作在界面能控制和动力学伪影消除方面的技术突破，对我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中的界面处理具有直接指导意义。模型对复杂缺陷结构（位错、晶界、空洞）的处理能力，为我在金属变形过程中缺陷演化的模拟提供了新的建模思路和验证基准。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了模型的基本理论框架，但缺少关键的数值参数、具体的自由能泛函形式、关联核函数的数学表达式等复现所需的核心信息。建议重点精读理论方法部分以获取完整的数学公式，以及结果与讨论部分中铝相图的具体参数化细节和界面动力学的定量分析。

2604.27342v1.title: Ultrafast Sliding Ferroelectric Switching in Bilayer Hexagonal Boron Nitride Revealed by Deep Learning Molecular Dynamics
2604.27342v1.summary: Sliding ferroelectricity in bilayer hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) offers compelling prospects for next-generation non-volatile memory, yet the atomistic dynamics of electric-field-driven polarization switching remain poorly understood. Here, we present a fully data-driven, coupled atomistic framework that integrates a fine-tuned MACE machine learning potential (MLP) with an equivariant graph convolutional neural network (EGCNN) for real-time Born effective charge (BEC) prediction, enabling large-scale non-equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations of AB-stacked bilayer h-BN under applied electric fields. By implementing a rigorous real-space path-integral polarization formalism combined with a state-constrained Gaussian convolution background extraction procedure, we successfully isolate the intrinsic spontaneous polarization from the dominant dielectric background. Our simulations reveal that coherent single-domain rigid sliding, completing within 5 ps, constitutes a physically viable ultrafast switching mechanism, and reproduces clean ferroelectric hysteresis loops whose shape is qualitatively consistent with experimental observations.
2604.27342v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决双层六方氮化硼（h-BN）中滑动铁电性的原子尺度动力学问题，特别是电场驱动下极化翻转的微观机制。现有方法在处理大尺度非平衡分子动力学模拟时面临计算精度与效率的矛盾，无法准确描述电场作用下的实时极化响应。该工作创新性地将机器学习势函数与实时Born有效电荷预测相结合，构建了完全数据驱动的耦合原子框架。现有模型缺乏对滑动铁电翻转超快动力学过程的原子级理解，限制了对这类新型非易失性存储器件的设计优化。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用分子动力学方法，核心是集成了精调MACE机器学习势函数与等变图卷积神经网络（EGCNN）的耦合原子框架。MACE势函数经过专门训练用于描述AB堆叠双层h-BN体系，EGCNN网络实现Born有效电荷的实时预测。采用严格的实空间路径积分极化形式结合状态约束高斯卷积背景提取程序，成功分离本征自发极化与主导介电背景。边界条件设置为摘要未提及，需查阅全文。加载方式为施加外电场驱动极化翻转，具体电场强度摘要未提及，需查阅全文。模拟实现了大尺度非平衡分子动力学计算，具体原子数、模拟盒尺寸和时间步长摘要未提及，需查阅全文。使用的软件平台摘要未明确说明，需查阅全文确认。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

模拟揭示相干单畴刚性滑动在5皮秒内完成，构成物理上可行的超快翻转机制。成功重现了与实验观察定性一致的清晰铁电滞回线形状。通过实空间路径积分极化形式成功分离出本征自发极化信号。具体的应力值、电场强度范围、极化强度数值等定量参数摘要未提及，需查阅全文。与已有实验结果的定量对比精度摘要未详细说明，需查阅全文获取具体数值。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的MACE机器学习势函数与EGCNN实时电荷预测的耦合框架可直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟研究，特别是在处理电-力耦合问题时。实空间路径积分极化计算方法和状态约束高斯卷积背景提取技术可借鉴用于我的相场晶体模型中极化场的准确计算。5皮秒超快翻转时间尺度为我的金属疲劳模拟中快速加载条件设计提供参考。机器学习势函数与神经网络的集成思路可启发我在XPFC模型中引入数据驱动方法，提高计算效率和精度。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

These fundamental structures were expanded into 4 × 4 × 1 supercells, yielding 64 atoms for the bilayer structures. To map the potential energy surface and generate diverse training data, the top layer of the AA′ and AB configurations was rigidly translated along the [11̅0 crystallographic direction, covering a full period of stacking transitions. This continuous sliding process generated 300 distinct configurations for both the AA′ and AB sliding pathways. 2604.10743v3.title: EMSpice 3: Full-chip Temperature-Aware Multiphysics Electromigration and IR-Drop Analysis
2604.10743v3.summary: This paper presents EMSpice~3, a full-chip multiphysics framework for coupled electromigration (EM), thermomigration (TM), and IR-drop analysis of practical power-grid (P/G) networks. The framework is, to our knowledge, the first EM-IR analysis flow that jointly incorporates Joule heating and practical spatial thermal profiles for full-chip P/G network designs. It operates on extracted power-grid netlists and combines an immortality check, transient EM/TM stress evolution, void-induced resistance updates, repeated IR-drop recomputation, and optional Monte Carlo lifetime prediction. To make chip-level EM analysis tractable, the framework integrates an extended rational Krylov subspace method into the transient solver, achieving $1.18\times$--$1.50\times$ speedup with sub-0.05% reported TTF/final-IR metric error relative to the default non-Krylov FDTD analysis across six benchmark designs. The numerical results reveal that the specific spatial temperature profile can have a more significant impact on P/G network lifetime than the average temperature itself. In the RISC-V core, a higher-average-temperature profile can avoid the 10% IR-drop failure threshold when its hotspots are less aligned with critical current paths, while mapped temperature gradients can move the critical void location and change which resistor branches are degraded. Monte Carlo analysis further shows design-specific variation sensitivity: under 20% variation in EM diffusivity and critical stress, the RISC-V core exhibits about 15.8% TTF coefficient of variation, whereas the ARM Cortex-A logic core exhibits only 0.0058\%. These results show that practical thermal profiles, resistance feedback, and stochastic material variation must be considered jointly for predictive full-chip EM-IR analysis.
2604.10743v3.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决全芯片级电迁移（EM）、热迁移（TM）与IR压降耦合分析的工程问题，针对实际功率网格设计中焦耳热效应和空间温度分布的影响。现有方法缺乏将焦耳热、实际空间热分布与电迁移-IR压降分析联合考虑的完整框架，无法准确预测芯片级功率网格的可靠性。该工作创新点在于首次提出集成焦耳热和实际空间热分布的全芯片EM-IR分析流程，并结合扩展有理Krylov子空间方法提升计算效率。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该框架采用多物理场耦合有限差分时域（FDTD）方法，结合电迁移、热迁移和电阻网络分析。控制方程包括电迁移应力演化方程、热扩散方程和基尔霍夫电路定律的耦合求解。边界条件基于提取的功率网格网表，考虑实际芯片布局的空间温度分布和电流路径。加载方式为稳态和瞬态电流激励，结合焦耳热产生的温度梯度效应。关键参数包括EM扩散系数变化20%、临界应力变化20%的蒙特卡罗分析。该框架集成扩展有理Krylov子空间方法到瞬态求解器中，相比默认FDTD方法实现1.18倍至1.50倍加速，同时保持TTF和最终IR指标误差低于0.05%。使用自研EMSpice 3代码平台进行六个基准设计的验证。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

数值结果表明特定空间温度分布对功率网格寿命的影响比平均温度更显著。在RISC-V核心中，较高平均温度分布在其热点与关键电流路径对齐度较低时可避免10% IR压降失效阈值。蒙特卡罗分析显示设计相关的变异敏感性差异巨大：在20%的EM扩散系数和临界应力变化下，RISC-V核心表现出约15.8%的TTF变异系数，而ARM Cortex-A逻辑核心仅为0.0058%。扩展Krylov方法在六个基准设计中均实现sub-0.05%的精度误差。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多物理场耦合框架对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有直接借鉴价值，特别是其电-热-机械耦合的求解策略。扩展有理Krylov子空间方法可应用于我的相场晶体模型（XPFC）中提升大尺度计算效率，实现类似的1.18-1.50倍加速效果。其空间温度分布对材料性能影响的分析方法可用于我的金属疲劳模拟中考虑温度梯度效应。蒙特卡罗统计分析框架可用于我的拉伸变形模拟中评估材料参数不确定性对结果的影响，特别是其变异系数计算方法。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

论文提供了关键算法框架和性能指标，但缺少具体的材料参数、网格尺寸、时间步长等数值细节，需查阅全文获取完整参数设置。建议重点精读方法论部分的扩展Krylov子空间算法实现和多物理场耦合求解策略，以及结果部分的温度分布影响分析和蒙特卡罗统计方法。

TanFellow, IEEE Abstract—This paper presentsEMSpice 3, a full-chip mul- tiphysics framework for coupled electromigration (EM), ther- momigration (TM), and IR-drop analysis of practical power- grid (P/G) networks. The framework is, to our knowledge, the first EM-IR analysis flow that jointly incorporates Joule heating and practical spatial thermal profiles for full-chip P/G network designs. It operates on extracted power-grid netlists and combines an immortality check, transient EM/TM stress evolution, void-induced resistance updates, repeated IR-drop recomputation, and optional Monte Carlo lifetime prediction. To make chip-level EM analysis tractable, the framework integrates an extended rational Krylov subspace method into the transient solver, achieving1.18×–1.50×speedup with sub-0.05% reported TTF/final-IR metric error relative to the default non-Krylov FDTD analysis across six benchmark designs. The numerical results reveal that the specific spatial temperature profile can have a more significant impact on P/G network lifetime than the average temperature itself. In the RISC-V core, a higher- average-temperature profile can avoid the 10% IR-drop failure threshold when its hotspots are less aligned with critical current paths, while mapped temperature gradients can move the critical void location and change which resistor branches are degraded. 2604.27685v1.title: VibroML: an automated toolkit for high-throughput vibrational analysis and dynamic instability remediation of crystalline materials using machine-learned potentials
2604.27685v1.summary: While machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) accelerate phonon dispersion calculations, merely identifying dynamical instabilities in computationally predicted materials is insufficient; automated pathways to resolve them are required. We introduce VibroML, an open-source Python toolkit driven by foundational MLIPs that shifts the paradigm from stability verification to automated structural remediation. VibroML employs an energy-guided genetic algorithm that vastly outperforms traditional soft-mode following, efficiently navigating the potential energy surface to uncover diverse, dynamically stable polymorphs. As 0 K harmonic stability does not guarantee macroscopic viability, an automated molecular dynamics workflow evaluates finite-temperature structural retention. VibroML also couples with ProtoCSP, our combinatorial structure prediction engine, to stabilize frustrated crystal topologies via targeted alloying, successfully rescuing functional perovskite networks like Cs$_2$KInI$_6$ and KTaSe$_3$. Demonstrating broader applicability, we mined the Alexandria database -- where ~50% of quaternary and 99.5% of quinary elemental combinations lack any structural entries -- to identify thousands of abandoned, high-symmetry stoichiometries. Deploying ProtoCSP's "cold start" retrieval and VibroML's evolutionary search on a sample, we successfully identified dynamically stable low-symmetry candidates. Through integrated structural remediation, thermal validation, and systematic compositional exploration, VibroML enables a comprehensive deep-screening approach, yielding physically sound structural propositions that far surpass standard high-throughput workflows.
2604.27685v1.summary_text:
## 技术分析报告

### 1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决了机器学习势函数在晶体材料声子色散计算中仅能识别动力学不稳定性但无法自动修复的问题。现有方法局限于稳定性验证，缺乏从不稳定结构自动生成稳定多晶型的能力，传统软模跟随方法效率低下。该工作创新点在于开发了基于能量引导遗传算法的自动化结构修复工具包，将范式从稳定性验证转向自动化结构修复。

### 2) 核心方法与模型细节

VibroML工具包采用机器学习势函数驱动的多层次模拟框架，核心包含能量引导遗传算法用于结构优化和分子动力学模拟用于有限温度验证。理论框架基于0K谐振稳定性分析和有限温度动力学稳定性评估的双重验证机制。势函数类型为基础机器学习势函数（摘要未提及具体MLIP类型，需查阅全文）。边界条件设置为周期性边界条件用于晶体结构计算。加载方式包括遗传算法驱动的结构搜索和有限温度分子动力学模拟验证。模拟参数方面，工具包处理了Alexandria数据库中约50%的四元和99.5%的五元组合缺失结构（摘要未提及具体原子数、时间步长等参数，需查阅全文）。软件平台为开源Python工具包VibroML，集成ProtoCSP组合结构预测引擎。

### 3) 关键结果与定量结论

主要发现包括成功修复了Cs₂KInI₆和KTaSe₃等功能钙钛矿网络结构的动力学不稳定性。从Alexandria数据库中识别出数千个被遗弃的高对称化学计量比结构，并成功找到了动力学稳定的低对称候选结构。能量引导遗传算法在效率上显著优于传统软模跟随方法（摘要未提及具体数值对比，需查阅全文）。该方法通过集成结构修复、热验证和系统性组分探索，产生的物理合理结构建议远超标准高通量工作流程。

### 4) 对我研究的直接价值

该工具包的能量引导遗传算法可直接应用于我的金属疲劳模拟中缺陷结构的优化和稳定化。分子动力学有限温度验证流程可借鉴用于我的拉伸变形模拟中温度效应的评估。VibroML的自动化结构修复思路对我的相场晶体模型(XPFC)中不稳定相的处理具有重要启发，特别是在多物理耦合场模拟中处理动力学不稳定性。该工具包的Python开源特性便于与我现有的模拟代码集成，其双重验证机制（0K谐振+有限温度MD）可作为我模型验证的标准流程。

### 5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了工具包的整体框架和典型应用案例，但缺少关键的势函数参数、MD模拟时间步长、温度范围等技术细节，需查阅全文获取完整参数设置。建议重点精读方法学章节了解遗传算法的具体实现和MD验证流程的参数配置，以及结果章节中Cs₂KInI₆和KTaSe₃的具体修复过程。

pdf_parse.method_excerpt: Methods Model selection The core of the VibroML workflow relies on the accuracy of the underlying PES. While the application of foundational MLIPs has been broadly validated for phonon properties 17, early generations of universal models were noted to suffer from systematic phonon frequency underes- timation, or “softening”, due to the biased sampling of near-equilibrium states in their training data41,44. 21 To mitigate this issue and ensure reliable dynamical stability assessments, VibroML integrates the latest iterations of equivariant architectures, specifically MACE-OMAT-0 (medium) 19,45, eSEN-30M-OMA14, and UMA-m-1p1 8. The training data for these models includes comprehen- sive samplings of non-equilibrium configurations from the OMat24 database 46, allowing them to better capture the interatomic force constants and high-frequency modes essential for accurate vibrational analysis. It is important to note that the accuracy of such foundation models is inherently tied to the level of theory of their training data, which for these models is primarily the PBE functional 21. While this may not capture certain complex electronic effects with the highest possible accuracy, it provides an excellent and well-established baseline for structural relaxation and vibrational properties, representing an excellent trade-off between speed and accuracy for the discovery phase. 2604.27910v1.title: Fragment-Constrained Charge Equilibration for Charge-Aware Machine Learning Potentials at Electrochemical Interfaces
2604.27910v1.summary: Predictive simulation of electrochemical interfaces requires atomistic models that capture reactive bond rearrangements, long-range electrostatics, and charge distributions reflecting the electronic distinctness of electrode and electrolyte. Existing charge-aware machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) built on global charge equilibration (QEq) settle electrode and electrolyte at a common electrochemical potential, leaving no room for the interfacial gradient that the double layer requires and admitting spurious charge transfer between electronically disconnected regions. Per-fragment charge equilibration is the established remedy in classical molecular dynamics, but reliance on predefined molecular topology has confined it to non-reactive systems. We lift this restriction by making fragment identification itself a differentiable function of atomic geometry, yielding soft fragment-constrained charge equilibration (Soft-FQEq) -- a solver layer that restores fragment-resolved charge conservation in reactive MLIPs. The layer consumes four scalar MLP readouts from a shared atomic-feature network -- per-atom electronegativity, source charge, short-range energy, and a soft bond connectivity -- and returns equilibrated charges together with per-fragment chemical potentials. We implement Soft-FQEq as an extension of the hippynn framework on a HIP-NN feature network and train it on DFT energies, forces, and DDEC6 charges for IrO2/H2O/Na+/ClO4- interfaces. The trained model recovers a clear electrode-to-electrolyte gradient in the per-atom electrochemical potential. With the same trained weights but the fragment-constrained solver replaced by global QEq at inference, this gradient collapses to an essentially uniform profile, directly showing that the gradient cannot be sustained within global QEq while the fragment formulation recovers it.
2604.27910v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决电化学界面原子尺度模拟中的电荷分布问题，特别是电极-电解质界面的双电层结构建模。现有基于全局电荷平衡（QEq）的机器学习势函数将电极和电解质设定为相同的电化学势，无法描述双电层所需的界面梯度，并导致电子不连通区域间的虚假电荷转移。传统的分子片段电荷平衡方法依赖预定义的分子拓扑结构，仅适用于非反应体系。该工作的创新点是将片段识别转化为原子几何的可微函数，实现了反应性机器学习势函数中的软片段约束电荷平衡（Soft-FQEq）。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该工作基于HIP-NN特征网络开发了Soft-FQEq求解器层，使用hippynn框架实现。模型从共享的原子特征网络输出四个标量MLP读数：每原子电负性、源电荷、短程能量和软键连接性，返回平衡电荷和每片段化学势。训练数据基于DFT计算的IrO2/H2O/Na+/ClO4-界面体系的能量、力和DDEC6电荷。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文。边界条件和加载方式的具体设置在摘要中未详细说明。该方法将片段识别作为原子几何的可微函数，克服了传统方法对预定义分子拓扑的依赖。模型通过软键连接性参数实现动态片段识别，适用于反应性体系的电荷分布计算。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

训练后的模型成功恢复了从电极到电解质的清晰电化学势梯度，这是双电层结构的关键特征。对比实验显示，当使用相同训练权重但在推理时将片段约束求解器替换为全局QEq时，该梯度坍缩为本质上均匀的分布，直接证明了全局QEq无法维持界面梯度而片段约束方法能够恢复该梯度。摘要未提及具体的应力值、温度范围或缺陷密度等定量数值，需查阅全文获取详细的数值结果和与实验数据的对比情况。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的Soft-FQEq方法对多物理耦合场模拟具有重要价值，特别是在处理电化学-力学耦合问题时的电荷分布计算。软片段识别的可微函数方法可以借鉴到相场晶体模型（XPFC）中，用于处理界面处的电荷重分布和电化学势梯度。该方法的片段约束电荷平衡思想可以应用到金属疲劳模拟中的表面氧化和腐蚀建模，以及拉伸变形过程中的电荷转移现象。hippynn框架的实现方式为开发自定义的多物理耦合求解器提供了技术参考，特别是在将机器学习势函数与传统物理模型耦合时的架构设计。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了基本的方法框架和使用的软件平台（hippynn、HIP-NN），但缺少关键的数值参数如模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量、训练数据集规模、超参数设置等复现所需信息。建议重点精读方法部分了解Soft-FQEq算法的具体实现细节，以及结果部分的电化学势梯度分析和与全局QEq的对比验证。

1206.2343v1.title: Multiaxial Kitagawa analysis of A356-T6
1206.2343v1.summary: Experimental Kitagawa analysis has been performed on A356-T6 containing natural and artificial defects. Results are obtained with a load ratio of R = -1 for three different loadings: tension, torsion and combined tension-torsion. The critical defect size determined is 400 \pm 100 \mum in A356-T6 under multiaxial loading. Below this value, the microstructure governs the endurance limit mainly through Secondary Dendrite Arm Spacing (SDAS). Four theoretical approaches are used to simulate the endurance limit characterized by a Kitagawa relationship are compared: Murakami relationships [Y Murakami, Metal Fatigue: Effects of Small Defects and Nonmetallic Inclusions, Elsevier, 2002.], defect-crack equivalency via Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM), the Critical Distance Method (CDM) proposed by Susmel and Taylor [L. Susmel, D. Taylor. Eng. Fract. Mech. 75 (2008) 15.] and the gradient approach proposed by Nadot [Y. Nadot, T. ~Billaudeau. Eng. Fract. Mech. 73 (2006) 1.]. It is shown that the CDM and gradient methods are accurate; however fatigue data for three loading conditions is necessary to allow accurate identification of an endurance limit.
1206.2343v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文研究A356-T6铝合金在多轴载荷下含缺陷材料的疲劳行为，特别是通过Kitagawa分析确定临界缺陷尺寸。A356-T6作为重要的铸造铝合金，在实际应用中不可避免地含有天然和人工缺陷，这些缺陷对疲劳性能有显著影响。现有的疲劳分析方法多基于单轴载荷条件，对多轴载荷下缺陷主导的疲劳行为缺乏系统研究。该工作的创新点在于建立了多轴载荷条件下的Kitagawa关系，并对比了四种理论预测方法的准确性。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用实验与理论相结合的方法，实验部分在载荷比R=-1条件下进行三种不同的加载模式：单轴拉伸、扭转和拉扭复合载荷。试样包含天然缺陷和人工引入的缺陷，通过疲劳试验获得不同缺陷尺寸下的疲劳极限数据。理论分析采用四种方法：Murakami关系式、基于线弹性断裂力学的缺陷-裂纹等效方法、Susmel和Taylor提出的临界距离法（CDM）以及Nadot提出的梯度方法。摘要未提及具体的试样几何尺寸、缺陷尺寸范围、疲劳试验频率等关键参数，需查阅全文。材料的微观结构特征通过二次枝晶臂间距（SDAS）进行表征，这是影响小缺陷疲劳行为的关键微观参数。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究确定A356-T6铝合金在多轴载荷下的临界缺陷尺寸为400±100微米，这是区分缺陷主导和微观结构主导疲劳行为的关键尺寸。当缺陷尺寸小于此临界值时，材料的疲劳极限主要由微观结构控制，特别是二次枝晶臂间距（SDAS）起主导作用。四种理论预测方法的对比显示，临界距离法（CDM）和梯度方法具有较高的预测精度。摘要未提及具体的疲劳极限数值、SDAS的具体尺寸范围以及各理论方法的预测误差，需查阅全文获取定量对比数据。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的临界缺陷尺寸概念（400±100微米）可直接应用于我的金属疲劳模拟工作中，作为多尺度模拟的尺寸分界参数。多轴载荷条件下的Kitagawa关系建立方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要参考价值，特别是在处理复杂应力状态下的疲劳行为时。临界距离法和梯度方法的成功应用为我的相场晶体模型（XPFC）中缺陷演化的临界判据提供了理论基础。二次枝晶臂间距作为微观结构特征参数的重要性，启发我在分子动力学模拟中需要重点关注晶体结构参数对疲劳性能的影响。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了载荷比（R=-1）、临界缺陷尺寸（400±100微米）等关键参数，但缺少试样几何、缺陷制备方法、疲劳试验具体参数等复现所需的详细信息。建议重点精读实验方法部分以获取试验参数设置，以及理论分析部分中四种方法的具体实施细节和预测精度对比结果。

2604.15491v1.title: Electronic Signature of Melting Onset in Polycrystalline Copper at Extreme Conditions
2604.15491v1.summary: Ultrafast melting is fundamentally a structural transition of the ionic lattice, but this rearrangement also reshapes the electronic properties by changing the energy landscape and scattering mechanisms. Although the electrons react almost instantaneously, it is not {\it a priori} clear how much lattice disorder is required for a significant response. Here, we show that the onset of melting already produces a clear electronic signature in polycrystalline copper. Using single-shot terahertz time-domain spectroscopy on thin films excited over a wide range of laser fluences, we infer the transient conductivity during the first picoseconds after excitation. The data, supported by two-temperature molecular-dynamics simulations, show that before melting, electron transport is substantially limited by grain-boundary scattering and that melting strongly suppresses this channel. As melting begins at these interfaces, we observe a transient increase in the conductivity that directly marks the onset of the phase transition. More broadly, these results show that ionic and electronic relaxation stages are closely coupled in nonequilibrium laser-driven matter and that optical measurements can resolve distinct stages of melting.
2604.15491v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文研究多晶铜在极端条件下超快熔化过程中的电子输运特性变化，特别是熔化起始阶段的电子信号特征。现有研究主要关注熔化的结构转变，但对熔化过程中电子性质的实时响应机制缺乏深入理解。该工作的创新点在于通过太赫兹时域光谱技术结合双温分子动力学模拟，首次揭示了多晶铜熔化起始时电导率的瞬态增加现象。研究发现晶界散射在熔化前限制电子输运，而熔化开始时这种散射通道被强烈抑制。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

实验采用单次太赫兹时域光谱技术对薄膜样品进行宽范围激光通量激发，测量激发后第一个皮秒内的瞬态电导率。理论模拟使用双温分子动力学（Two-Temperature Molecular Dynamics）方法，该方法耦合了电子温度和离子温度的演化过程。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、模拟尺寸、原子数量、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。边界条件和加载方式为激光脉冲激发，涉及不同的激光通量范围。摘要未明确提及使用的具体模拟软件平台，需查阅全文确认。模拟重点关注多晶结构中晶界对电子散射的影响以及熔化过程中这种散射机制的变化。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现多晶铜在熔化起始阶段出现电导率的瞬态增加，这直接标志着相变的开始。熔化首先在晶界处开始，导致晶界散射通道被强烈抑制，从而提高了电子输运能力。摘要未提供具体的应力值、温度范围、电导率数值等定量数据，需查阅全文获取。双温分子动力学模拟结果与实验数据相互支持，验证了理论模型的准确性。研究表明离子和电子弛豫阶段在非平衡激光驱动物质中紧密耦合。

该论文的双温分子动力学方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有直接借鉴价值，特别是在处理电子-声子耦合和非平衡态演化方面。多晶结构中晶界散射对电子输运的影响机制可以为我的金属疲劳模拟提供微观物理基础，有助于理解晶界在变形过程中的作用。该研究中关于熔化起始阶段的识别方法可以为我的相变模拟提供新的判据和验证手段。太赫兹光谱与分子动力学模拟的结合方式为我的模型验证提供了新思路，特别是在多尺度模拟的实验验证方面。

2407.17283v1.title: Hybrid-PFC: coupling the phase-field crystal model and its amplitude-equation formulation
2407.17283v1.summary: The phase-field crystal (PFC) model describes crystal structures at diffusive timescales through a periodic, microscopic density field. It has been proposed to model elasticity in crystal growth and encodes most of the phenomenology related to the mechanical properties of crystals like dislocation nucleation and motion, grain boundaries, and elastic or interface-energy anisotropies. To overcome limitations to small systems, a coarse-grained formulation focusing on slowly varying complex amplitudes of the microscopic density field has been devised. This amplitude-PFC (APFC) model describes well elasticity and dislocations while approximating microscopic features and being limited in describing large-angle grain boundaries. We present here seminal concepts for a hybrid multiscale PFC-APFC framework that combines the coarse-grained description of the APFC model in bulk-like crystallites while exploiting PFC resolution at dislocations, grain boundaries, and interfaces or surfaces. This is achieved by coupling the two models via an advanced discretization based on the Fourier spectral method and allowing for local solution updates. This discretization also generalizes the description of boundary conditions for PFC models. We showcase the framework capabilities through two-dimensional benchmark simulations. We also show that the proposed formulation allows for overcoming the limitations of the APFC model in describing large-angle grain boundaries.
2407.17283v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决相场晶体（PFC）模型在大尺度系统模拟中的计算效率问题，以及振幅相场晶体（APFC）模型在描述大角度晶界方面的精度不足问题。传统PFC模型能够准确描述位错、晶界等微观结构，但计算成本高，限制了系统尺寸；而APFC模型虽然计算效率高，但在处理大角度晶界时存在精度损失。该工作的创新点在于提出混合多尺度PFC-APFC框架，在晶体内部使用粗粒化的APFC描述，在位错、晶界等关键区域使用高精度的PFC描述。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用混合相场晶体（Hybrid-PFC）模型，将传统PFC模型与其振幅方程形式APFC模型耦合。控制方程基于Cahn-Hilliard类型的扩散动力学方程，通过周期性微观密度场描述晶体结构。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型，需查阅全文。边界条件设置采用基于傅里叶谱方法的先进离散化方案，允许局部解更新和边界条件的广义描述。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、网格规模、时间步长等数值参数，需查阅全文。该方法通过傅里叶谱方法实现两种模型的耦合，在晶体内部区域使用APFC的粗粒化描述，在位错、晶界和界面等关键区域切换到PFC的全分辨率描述。摘要未提及使用的具体软件平台，需查阅全文。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

论文通过二维基准模拟验证了混合框架的有效性，成功克服了APFC模型在描述大角度晶界方面的局限性。摘要未提及具体的数值结果，如应力值、缺陷密度或精度对比数据，需查阅全文获取定量结论。该方法实现了在保持微观结构描述精度的同时提高计算效率的目标，特别是在处理包含大角度晶界的复杂晶体结构时表现出优势。摘要未提及与实验或其他模拟结果的具体对比情况，需查阅全文。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该混合PFC-APFC框架对我的多物理耦合场模拟和相场晶体模型（XPFC）研究具有重要参考价值，特别是在处理多尺度问题时的模型耦合策略。傅里叶谱方法的先进离散化方案和局部解更新技术可以直接应用于我的XPFC模型中，提高计算效率。该框架在晶界和位错区域的高精度描述方法对我的金属疲劳模拟研究具有直接启发，可以用于准确捕捉疲劳裂纹萌生和扩展过程中的微观机制。边界条件的广义描述方法可以为我的拉伸变形模拟提供更灵活的边界条件设计思路。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了方法的基本框架，但缺少关键的数值参数、具体的离散化细节和验证案例的定量结果，需要查阅全文获取完整的实现细节。建议重点精读方法部分关于傅里叶谱方法离散化的章节，以及二维基准模拟的具体实现和结果分析部分，这些内容对理解和复现该混合框架至关重要。

2312.08154v2.title: Gradient elasticity in Swift-Hohenberg and phase-field crystal models
2312.08154v2.summary: The Swift-Hohenberg (SH) and Phase-Field Crystal (PFC) models are minimal yet powerful approaches for studying phenomena such as pattern formation, collective order, and defects via smooth order parameters. They are based on a free-energy functional that inherently includes elasticity effects. This study addresses how gradient elasticity (GE), a theory that accounts for elasticity effects at microscopic scales by introducing additional characteristic lengths, is incorporated into SH and PFC models. After presenting the fundamentals of these theories and models, we first calculate the characteristic lengths for various lattice symmetries in an approximated setting. We then discuss numerical simulations of stress fields at dislocations and comparisons with analytic solutions within first and second strain-gradient elasticity. Effective GE characteristic lengths for the elastic fields induced by dislocations are found to depend on the free-energy parameters in the same manner as the phase correlation length, thus unveiling how they change with the quenching depth. The findings presented in this study enable a thorough discussion and analysis of small-scale elasticity effects in pattern formation and crystalline systems using SH and PFC models and, importantly, complete the elasticity analysis therein. Additionally, we provide a microscopic foundation for GE in the context of order-disorder phase transitions.
2312.08154v2.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决了Swift-Hohenberg（SH）和相场晶体（PFC）模型中梯度弹性理论的融合问题，特别是如何在这些模型中准确描述微观尺度的弹性效应。现有的SH和PFC模型虽然包含弹性效应，但缺乏对微观特征长度的系统性描述，无法准确捕捉小尺度弹性行为。该工作的创新点在于建立了梯度弹性理论与SH/PFC模型的理论桥梁，为微观弹性效应提供了定量描述框架。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究基于Swift-Hohenberg和相场晶体模型的自由能泛函理论，结合一阶和二阶应变梯度弹性理论进行分析。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型和数值模拟软件平台，需查阅全文获取详细信息。研究采用解析计算方法推导不同晶格对称性下的特征长度，并通过数值模拟验证位错周围应力场的分布规律。边界条件设置、模拟尺寸、原子数等关键参数在摘要中未明确提及，需查阅全文。该工作主要通过理论推导和数值验证相结合的方式，建立了梯度弹性特征长度与自由能参数之间的定量关系。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现梯度弹性特征长度与相关长度具有相同的自由能参数依赖性，揭示了特征长度随淬火深度的变化规律。通过位错应力场的数值模拟与解析解对比，验证了一阶和二阶应变梯度弹性理论在SH/PFC模型中的适用性。摘要未提供具体的应力值、温度范围或缺陷密度等定量数据，需查阅全文获取详细数值结果。该研究为梯度弹性理论在有序-无序相变体系中提供了微观理论基础。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文建立的梯度弹性-PFC耦合理论框架可直接应用于我的XPFC模型研究中，特别是在处理位错等缺陷的弹性场计算时。论文中推导的特征长度与自由能参数的关系式可用于我的多物理耦合场模拟中的参数标定和模型验证。位错应力场的数值模拟方法和解析解对比策略为我的金属疲劳模拟提供了重要的验证手段。该工作揭示的小尺度弹性效应处理方法对我的拉伸变形模拟中的应变梯度效应建模具有直接指导意义。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了理论框架的基本信息，但缺少数值模拟的具体参数设置、软件平台选择和定量结果数据，需查阅全文获取完整的可复现信息。建议重点精读理论推导部分和数值验证章节，特别关注梯度弹性特征长度的计算方法和位错应力场的模拟细节。

Introduction Gradient elasticity (GE) is a theoretical framework that extends c lassical continuum mechanics with additional higher-order derivatives to capture the eﬀects of small length scales [ 1–7]. It incorporates additional characteristic lengths accounting fo r internal material structure and discreteness, thereby allowing t he description of size eﬀects relevant at the nano- and micro-scale. Such a theory has b een tested and exploited in diﬀerent frameworks, e.g., classical mechanics and disloc ation dynamics, and applied in contexts such as ﬂexoelectricity and biomechanics [ 8–14]. It has also been extended to describe strain-gradient plasticity [ 15–18]. Parameters entering the theory have been connected to interatomic potentials and, in g eneral, can be determined by atomistic methods [ 19–21]. A key feature of GE is that it overcomes some limitations of continuum elasticity theory, such as nonphysical singu larities emerging from approximated descriptions of small scales. This leads, for inst ance, to regularized elastic ﬁelds at the dislocation core [ 22–26], which are instead singular in classic linear elasticity [ 27]. 2301.04917v2.title: Amplitude expansion of the phase-field crystal model for complex crystal structures
2301.04917v2.summary: The phase-field crystal (PFC) model describes crystal lattices at diffusive timescales. Its amplitude expansion (APFC) can be applied to the investigation of relatively large systems under some approximations. However, crystal symmetries accessible within the APFC model are limited to basic ones, namely triangular and square in two dimensions, and body-centered cubic and face-centered cubic in three dimensions. In this work, we propose a general, amplitudes-based description of virtually any lattice symmetry. To fully exploit the advantages of this model, featuring slowly varying quantities in bulk and localized significant variations at dislocations and interfaces, we consider formulations suitable for real-space numerical methods supporting adaptive spatial discretization. We explore approaches originally proposed for the PFC model which allow for symmetries beyond basic ones through extended parametrizations. Moreover, we tackle the modeling of non-Bravais lattices by introducing an amplitude expansion for lattices with a basis and further generalizations. We study and discuss the stability of selected, prototypical lattice symmetries. As pivotal examples, we show that the proposed approach allows for a coarse-grained description of the kagome lattice, exotic square arrangements, and the diamond lattice, as bulk crystals and, importantly, hosting dislocations.
2301.04917v2.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决相场晶体模型（PFC）在复杂晶体结构描述方面的局限性问题，传统PFC模型只能处理基本对称性结构。现有振幅展开相场晶体模型（APFC）仅限于二维的三角和正方晶格，以及三维的体心立方和面心立方结构，无法描述更复杂的晶体对称性。该工作的创新点在于提出了一个通用的基于振幅的描述方法，能够处理几乎任意的晶格对称性，包括非布拉维晶格和具有基底的复杂结构。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究使用扩展的振幅相场晶体（APFC）模型，通过引入广义振幅展开来描述复杂晶体结构。核心理论框架基于PFC模型的振幅展开，但扩展了参数化方案以支持超越基本对称性的结构。摘要未提及具体的控制方程形式，需查阅全文获取详细数学表达式。模型采用适合实空间数值方法的表述，支持自适应空间离散化以充分利用体相中缓慢变化量和位错界面处局域显著变化的特点。摘要未提及具体的边界条件设置、模拟尺寸、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文。该研究特别针对非布拉维晶格引入了带基底晶格的振幅展开方法，并进行了进一步的广义化处理。摘要未明确提及使用的具体软件平台。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该方法成功实现了对kagome晶格、特殊正方排列和金刚石晶格的粗粒化描述，既能处理体晶体也能描述含位错的结构。研究验证了所选典型晶格对称性的稳定性，证明了扩展模型的有效性。摘要未提供具体的数值结果、应力值或缺陷密度等定量数据，需查阅全文获取详细的对比验证结果。该方法显著扩展了APFC模型的适用范围，从基本的4种晶体结构扩展到几乎任意复杂的晶格对称性。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的广义振幅展开方法可以直接应用于我的相场晶体模型（XPFC）研究中，特别是在处理复杂晶体结构和非布拉维晶格时。扩展的参数化方案和带基底晶格的振幅展开技术可以为我的多物理耦合场模拟提供更强的结构描述能力。该方法支持自适应空间离散化的特点对我的数值实现具有重要参考价值，特别是在处理位错和界面等局域变化显著区域时。论文中对kagome晶格和金刚石结构的处理方法可以为我在金属疲劳模拟中涉及复杂晶体结构时提供建模思路。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了方法的总体框架但缺少关键的数学表达式、具体参数设置和数值实现细节，需要查阅全文获取完整的模型公式和计算参数。建议重点精读方法部分以获取扩展振幅展开的具体数学形式，以及结果部分中kagome晶格和金刚石结构的具体实现案例。

2405.07507v2.title: A frequency-domain enhanced multi-view network for metal fatigue life prediction
2405.07507v2.summary: Fatigue damages and failure widely exist in engineering structures. However, predicting fatigue life for various structural materials subjected to multiaxial loading paths remains a challenging problem. A novel multi-view deep learning model incorporating frequency-domain analysis for fatigue life prediction is proposed. The model consists of two main analytical components: one for analyzing multiaxial fatigue loading paths and the other for examining the mechanical properties of materials and specimen geometrical characteristics. In the module analyzing multiaxial fatigue loading paths, convolutional neural network (CNN), long short-term memory network (LSTM), and FNet are connected in parallel to extract features individually. Features of materials and specimens are extracted through fully connected neural networks (FCNNs). Subsequently, the features from these two parts are thoroughly integrated based on attention mechanisms, and connected to multiple FCNNs to accomplish fatigue life prediction. We anticipate that the multi-view approach, along with its accuracy and applicability, can provide an unparalleled alternative for researchers in the field of engineering fatigue and beyond.

2601.09660v1.title: Constitutive parameter inference using physics-based data-driven modeling in full volume datasets of intact and torn rotator cuff tendons
2601.09660v1.summary: In this work, we characterized the material properties of an animal model of the rotator cuff tendon using full volume datasets of both its intact and injured states by capturing internal strain behavior throughout the tendon. Our experimental setup, involving tension along the fiber direction, activated volumetric, tensile, and shear mechanisms due to the tendon's complex geometry. We implemented an approach to model inference that we refer to as variational system identification (VSI) to solve the weak form of the stress equilibrium equation using these full volume displacements. Three constitutive models were used for parameter inference: a neo-Hookean model, a modified Holzapfel-Gasser-Ogden (HGO) model with higher-order terms in the first and second invariants, and a reduced polynomial model consisting of terms based on the first, second, and fiber-related invariants. Inferred parameters were further refined using an adjoint-based partial differential equation (PDE)-constrained optimization framework. Our results show that the modified HGO model captures the tendon's deformation mechanisms with reasonable accuracy, while the neo-Hookean model fails to reproduce key internal features, particularly the shear behavior in the injured tendon. Surprisingly, the simplified polynomial model performed comparably to the modified HGO formulation using only three terms. These findings suggest that while current constitutive models do not fully replicate the complex internal mechanics of the tendon, they are capable of capturing key trends in both intact and damaged tissue, using a homogeneous modeling approach. Continued model development is needed to bridge this gap and enable clinical-grade, predictive simulations of tendon injury and repair.

1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决肩袖肌腱在完整和撕裂状态下的材料本构参数推断问题，针对肌腱复杂几何结构导致的体积、拉伸和剪切变形机制耦合难题。现有本构模型无法准确描述肌腱内部复杂力学行为，特别是损伤组织的剪切变形特征，限制了临床级预测仿真的实现。该工作创新性地采用变分系统识别方法结合全体积位移数据进行参数推断，并通过伴随偏微分方程约束优化框架进一步精化参数。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

采用变分系统识别方法求解应力平衡方程的弱形式，基于全体积位移场数据进行本构参数推断。使用三种本构模型：neo-Hookean模型、修正Holzapfel-Gasser-Ogden模型（包含第一和第二不变量的高阶项）、以及基于第一、第二和纤维相关不变量的简化多项式模型。实验设置为沿纤维方向的单轴拉伸加载，激活了由肌腱复杂几何引起的体积、拉伸和剪切变形机制。采用伴随偏微分方程约束优化框架对推断参数进行进一步精化。摘要未提及具体的边界条件设置、加载应变率、模拟尺寸、网格规模和软件平台等关键参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。

修正HGO模型能够以合理精度捕获肌腱的变形机制，而neo-Hookean模型无法重现关键内部特征，特别是损伤肌腱的剪切行为。简化多项式模型仅使用三个项就达到了与修正HGO模型相当的性能表现。研究表明现有本构模型虽不能完全复制肌腱复杂内部力学行为，但能够使用均匀化建模方法捕获完整和损伤组织的关键趋势。摘要未提及具体的应力值、应变范围或定量精度指标，需查阅全文获取详细数值结果。

2512.00581v1.title: Thermomechanical investigation of silicon wafer dynamics within the melting regime driven by picosecond laser pulses for surface structuring
2512.00581v1.summary: Laser-induced periodic surface structures (LIPSS) on silicon, generated by ultrashort pulsed lasers, provide an efficient means to tailor surface functionality. This work presents a multiphysics finite element study on the thermomechanical dynamics of silicon wafers irradiated by picosecond laser pulses, focusing on the melting regime where thermomechanical and hydrodynamic effects dominate. To illustrate the sequential nature of laser scanning, single-pulse irradiation models are developed as thermomechanical analogues of double-pulse interactions. By positioning the laser focus near reflective boundaries and corners of the target, these models reproduce the stress-wave interference that would occur between successive pulses in scanning. The results show that periodic surface structures originate from mechanical standing wave interference within the molten layer, forming ripples with near-wavelength periodicity. The penetration depth (PD) is identified as a key factor controlling the duration and stability of these ripples: shallow PDs (75-150 nm) yield distinct, persistent patterns, while deeper PDs (app. 2.5 micrometers) lead to extended melting and hydrodynamic smoothing. Simulations of sequential double-pulse irradiation confirm that residual stresses and strains from the first pulse amplify deformation during the second, enhancing ripple amplitude and uniformity. Controlled excitation of mechanical standing waves governed by PD, boundary geometry, and pulse sequencing - thus represents a fundamental mechanism for deterministic LIPSS formation on silicon.

1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决硅晶圆在皮秒激光脉冲作用下的热机械动力学问题，特别关注熔化区域内激光诱导周期性表面结构（LIPSS）的形成机制。现有LIPSS形成理论主要基于电磁场干涉，但无法充分解释熔化区域内的结构形成过程，特别是热机械效应和流体动力学效应的耦合作用机制。该工作创新性地提出了基于机械驻波干涉的LIPSS形成机制，通过多物理场有限元模拟揭示了熔融层内应力波干涉对表面周期结构形成的控制作用。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

采用多物理场有限元方法（FEM）建立硅晶圆的热机械耦合模型，耦合求解热传导方程、弹性力学方程和流体动力学方程。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型和软件平台，需查阅全文获取详细信息。边界条件设计巧妙地将激光焦点定位在反射边界和目标角落附近，通过单脉冲照射模型模拟双脉冲扫描过程中的应力波干涉效应。关键控制参数为穿透深度（PD），分别设置75-150纳米的浅穿透和约2.5微米的深穿透两种工况。模拟采用皮秒激光脉冲加载，重点分析熔化区域内的热机械响应和流体动力学行为。通过序列双脉冲照射模拟验证了残余应力和应变对后续变形的放大效应。

2502.13864v1.title: Elastically Buckled Film-Substrate System as a Two-dimensional Crystal
2502.13864v1.summary: Compressive mechanical stress exceeding a critical value leads to the formation of periodic surface buckling patterns in film-substrate systems. A comprehensive understanding of this buckling phenomenon is desired in applications where the surface topologies are modulated to achieve multifunctionalities. Here we reformulate the finite-deformation elastic theory of a film-substrate system by treating the compliant substrate as a nonlinear elastic solid. The resulting elastic free energy functional of the deflection field is shown to be equivalent to a minimal density functional of phase-field crystal theory plus a Gaussian curvature-related term. The proposed elastic model constructs a phase diagram based on free energy minimization, quantitatively agreeing with the buckling transitions observed in former experiments. The emerging hexagonal buckling system is shown to be equivalent to a two-dimensional crystal with proper scalings. We further conducted simulations of repeated buckling under cyclic stress to demonstrate a dynamically modulated structural adhesive, which resembles the physical process of repeated crystallization and melting near a critical temperature.
2502.13864v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决薄膜-基底系统在压缩应力作用下的弹性屈曲现象，特别是周期性表面屈曲图案的形成机理。现有的薄膜屈曲理论主要基于线性弹性假设，无法准确描述大变形条件下的复杂屈曲行为和相变过程。该工作的创新点在于将柔性基底视为非线性弹性固体，建立了与相场晶体理论等价的弹性自由能泛函。这种新的理论框架能够定量预测屈曲转变，并揭示了六角形屈曲系统与二维晶体的等价性。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用有限变形弹性理论重新构建薄膜-基底系统的力学模型，将柔性基底处理为非线性弹性固体。核心理论框架基于挠度场的弹性自由能泛函，该泛函被证明等价于相场晶体理论的最小密度泛函加上高斯曲率相关项。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置和模拟参数。加载方式为循环压缩应力，用于研究重复屈曲行为。摘要未提及具体的模拟软件平台、原子数规模、时间步长等关键技术参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。该模型通过自由能最小化构建相图，并进行了循环应力下的重复屈曲模拟。

研究发现六角形屈曲系统在适当标度下等价于二维晶体结构。建立的相图能够定量预测屈曲转变，与先前实验观察到的屈曲转变定量吻合。循环应力下的重复屈曲模拟展示了动态调制的结构粘附行为，类似于临界温度附近的重复结晶和熔化物理过程。摘要未提及具体的应力临界值、温度范围、变形量等定量数据，需查阅全文获取精确数值。模型的精度通过与实验结果的定量对比得到验证。

2603.28726v1.title: Pentagonal PdTe2 Monolayer for Sustainable Solar-driven Hydrogen Production
2603.28726v1.summary: This investigation demonstrates that the pentagonal PdTe2 (penta-PdTe2) monolayer is a highly tunable two-dimensional (2D) photocatalyst, characterized by the bandgap of 1.75 eV and high hole mobility. Using density functional theory calculations with the HSE06 functional, we show that tensile strain engineering (particularly at +2% and +3%) is essential for enabling spontaneous water splitting. At these strain values, the valence-band maximum and conduction-band maximum straddle the water redox potentials (H+/H2 and O2/H2O) in both acidic (pH=0) and neutral (pH=7) conditions. The monolayer's low hole effective mass facilitates rapid charge extraction, mitigating recombination and driving the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) more effectively than many hexagonal and pentagonal counterparts. The Gibbs free energy (ΔG) pathways indicate that overpotentials for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and OER are highly sensitive to mechanical deformation, specifically biaxial strain, through which +3% tensile strain, yielding an optimized balance of overpotentials of ηHER = 0.70 V and ηOER = 0.72 V at pH=7. Finally, integrating optical absorption with thermodynamic driving forces results in a Solar-to-Hydrogen (STH) efficiency of 20.40% at pH 7. This exceeds the performance of several previously reported 2D catalysts, positioning penta-PdTe2 as a superior candidate for sustainable, solar-driven hydrogen production.
2603.28726v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决的是二维材料在太阳能驱动水分解制氢中的光催化效率问题，特别是针对五边形PdTe2单分子层材料的应变调控机制。现有二维光催化材料普遍存在带隙不匹配、载流子复合严重、过电位过高等问题，限制了其在水分解反应中的实际应用效率。该工作的创新点在于通过应变工程精确调控五边形PdTe2的电子结构，实现带边位置与水氧化还原电位的最佳匹配。研究发现该材料具有1.75 eV的带隙和高空穴迁移率，为设计高效二维光催化剂提供了新思路。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用密度泛函理论(DFT)计算方法，使用HSE06杂化泛函进行电子结构计算以获得准确的带隙值。摘要未提及具体的计算软件平台，需查阅全文确认是否使用VASP或其他DFT软件包。应变工程通过施加双轴拉伸应变实现，关键应变值为+2%和+3%，这些应变条件下材料的价带顶和导带底能够跨越水的氧化还原电位。计算涵盖了酸性(pH=0)和中性(pH=7)两种环境条件下的能带对齐分析。吉布斯自由能路径计算用于评估氢析出反应(HER)和氧析出反应(OER)的过电位，其中+3%拉伸应变下在pH=7条件下获得最优的过电位平衡。摘要未提及具体的原子数、超胞尺寸、k点网格密度等关键计算参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现五边形PdTe2单分子层在+3%双轴拉伸应变下表现出最佳的光催化性能，HER过电位为0.70 V，OER过电位为0.72 V(pH=7条件)。该材料的太阳能制氢(STH)效率达到20.40%(pH=7)，显著超越了多种已报道的二维催化材料。材料的低空穴有效质量促进了快速电荷提取，有效抑制了载流子复合过程。摘要未提及与实验数据的具体对比情况，需查阅全文了解模型预测的验证情况。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的应变工程方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟和拉伸变形模拟研究具有重要参考价值，特别是+2%和+3%的关键应变值可以作为我在相场晶体模型(XPFC)中设置变形边界条件的参考。双轴拉伸应变的加载方式和应变-性能关系的定量分析方法可以直接应用于我的金属疲劳模拟中的应变控制策略。该研究中通过应变调控电子结构和反应过电位的机制分析，为我在分子动力学模拟中研究应变对材料性能影响提供了理论指导。吉布斯自由能路径计算方法也可以借鉴用于我的多尺度模拟中的热力学分析部分。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了关键的应变值(+2%, +3%)、过电位数据(ηHER = 0.70 V, ηOER = 0.72 V)和STH效率(20.40%)等核心参数，但缺少DFT计算的具体设置参数如截断能、k点网格、收敛标准等关键信息。建议重点精读方法学部分了解详细的计算参数设置，以及结果与讨论部分中应变-性能关系的定量分析和机理解释。

2603.27152v1.title: Single-material 4D-printed shape-morphing structures via spatially patterned strain trapping
2603.27152v1.summary: A single-step, single-material 4D printing method is developed for programmable structures featuring spatially patterned strain trapping for one-way actuation. This approach enables fabrication on desktop fused filament fabrication 3D printers through a recently developed shape-memory strain programming method, Programming via Printing (PvP), which eliminates the need for secondary post-fabrication programming. Large (up to 50%) and spatially controlled trapped tensile strain programming is achieved by PvP model design, geometric coding, and printing parameter optimization. While contraction naturally arises from printing-induced trapped strain, expansion is introduced via architected lattice designs with patterned strain-enabling a full range of deformation modes. These capabilities, validated at the unit-cell level, are further integrated into larger proof-of-concept structures to demonstrate scalability and practical implementation. This strategy provides an accessible, low-cost, and easily adoptable additive manufacturing approach for diverse functional-material applications.
2603.27152v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决的是4D打印中形状变形结构的单材料制造问题，特别是如何在桌面级熔融沉积成型3D打印机上实现可编程的形状记忆功能。现有4D打印方法通常需要多材料或复杂的后处理工序来实现形状记忆效应，成本高且工艺复杂。该工作的创新点在于开发了一种通过打印过程直接编程（Programming via Printing, PvP）的单步骤、单材料4D打印方法，通过空间图案化的应变捕获实现单向驱动。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用了基于形状记忆聚合物的4D打印技术，核心是Programming via Printing（PvP）方法，通过打印参数优化和几何编码实现应变编程。摘要未提及具体的数值模拟方法、控制方程或势函数类型，需查阅全文。打印平台使用桌面级熔融沉积成型（FFF）3D打印机，通过优化打印参数实现高达50%的空间可控捕获拉伸应变。边界条件和加载方式为通过几何设计和打印参数控制实现应变图案化，摘要未提及具体的模拟软件、网格规模、时间步长等参数。变形模式包括收缩（由打印诱导的捕获应变自然产生）和膨胀（通过架构化晶格设计实现），覆盖了完整的变形模式范围。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

主要发现是成功实现了高达50%的大幅度空间可控捕获拉伸应变编程，通过PvP模型设计、几何编码和打印参数优化得以实现。该方法在单元胞层面得到验证，并成功集成到更大的概念验证结构中，证明了可扩展性和实际应用潜力。摘要未提及与已有实验或模拟结果的具体数值对比，也未给出应力值、温度范围等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细数据。该方法提供了一种可访问、低成本且易于采用的增材制造途径。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的PvP方法和空间应变图案化技术可以直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟和拉伸变形模拟研究中，特别是在研究材料的非均匀变形行为时。50%的大应变范围为我的分子动力学和相场晶体模型（XPFC）提供了重要的变形参数参考，可用于验证模型在大变形条件下的准确性。该研究中的几何编码和应变控制策略对我在金属疲劳模拟中设计复杂加载条件和边界条件具有重要启发意义。单元胞到宏观结构的多尺度集成方法与我的多尺度模拟研究方向高度契合，可为跨尺度建模提供实验验证基础。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议
