2605.12631v1.title: Bridging perturbation and variational approaches in brittle fracture
2605.12631v1.summary: We present a variational reduced-order model for three-dimensional coplanar propagation of sharp cracks in heterogeneous perfectly brittle solids under mixed-mode I+II+III loading. The approach connects the variational fracture formulation of Francfort and Marigo (1998) and the perturbation theory of Rice (1985) by computing equilibrium crack-front configurations through minimization of the total energy defined as the sum of (i) the elastic potential energy, evaluated asymptotically from front deformations, and (ii) the dissipated energy, set by the fracture energy field. The potential energy and its derivatives are evaluated efficiently using the Fast Fourier Transform. The resulting nonconvex box-constrained minimization problem is solved with a matrix-free Newton conjugate gradient algorithm with a trust region and physics-based preconditioning, enforcing irreversibility while resolving energy barriers and long-range elastic interactions. We validate our implementation against newly derived analytical solutions. We then perform 116,000 large-scale simulations of tensile and shear crack propagation in disordered media to quantify the impact of finite-size effects, disorder intensity, and mode mixity. The simulations reproduce the transition from smooth to intermittent crack growth, and show that mode mixity has limited influence on the onset of intermittency but induces quasi-elliptic fronts in mixed II+III loading. They reveal a size-dependent crossover from disorder-induced weakening to toughening controlled by the emergence of depinning instabilities.
2605.12631v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决三维异质完全脆性固体中尖锐裂纹在混合模式I+II+III载荷下的共面扩展问题。现有方法在处理大尺度三维裂纹扩展时面临计算效率低下和多物理场耦合困难的局限性。该工作的创新点在于将Francfort-Marigo变分断裂理论与Rice扰动理论相结合，建立了一个降阶变分模型来高效处理三维裂纹前沿的复杂演化过程。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用变分降阶模型结合扰动理论方法，核心理论框架基于总能量最小化原理，总能量定义为弹性势能（通过前沿变形渐近评估）与耗散能量（由断裂能场设定）之和。势能及其导数通过快速傅里叶变换（FFT）高效计算，显著提升了计算效率。边界条件设置为摘要未提及需查阅全文，但涉及混合模式I+II+III载荷条件。该方法采用带信赖域和基于物理预处理的无矩阵牛顿共轭梯度算法求解非凸盒约束最小化问题，确保不可逆性同时解决能量势垒和长程弹性相互作用。研究进行了116000次大规模模拟来研究拉伸和剪切裂纹扩展，模拟规模和具体参数摘要未提及需查阅全文。使用的软件平台摘要未明确提及，可能为自研代码结合FFT算法实现。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究通过116000次大规模模拟定量分析了有限尺寸效应、无序强度和模式混合度的影响。模拟成功重现了从光滑到间歇性裂纹扩展的转变过程，发现模式混合度对间歇性起始的影响有限，但在混合II+III载荷下会诱发准椭圆形前沿。研究揭示了一个尺寸依赖的交叉现象：从无序诱导的弱化转变为由脱钉不稳定性控制的韧化。具体的应力值、温度范围等定量数值摘要未提及需查阅全文，但该模型已通过新推导的解析解进行了验证。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的FFT加速变分方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要借鉴价值，特别是在处理大尺度金属疲劳裂纹扩展时的计算效率提升。变分断裂理论与扰动理论的结合思路可以直接应用于我的XPFC模型中，用于描述裂纹前沿的复杂演化行为。该研究中的无矩阵牛顿共轭梯度算法和信赖域方法对我当前的拉伸变形模拟中的非线性求解器优化具有直接指导意义。混合模式载荷下的裂纹扩展机制分析为我的金属疲劳模拟提供了重要的物理洞察和验证基准。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了方法框架和模拟规模（116000次模拟），但缺少关键的数值参数如网格尺寸、时间步长、材料参数等具体实现细节。建议重点精读方法论部分了解FFT加速的变分算法实现细节，以及结果部分关于尺寸效应和模式混合度影响的定量分析。

The presence of heterogeneities further complicates modeling, as crack growth unfolds as a highly intermittent process, alternating between pinning phases, whose durations span several time scales, and avalanches, whose sizes scale from the heterogeneity size to that of the system (Bonamy and Bouchaud, 2011). Addressing these challenges requires dedicated numerical methods that can describe the multiscale nature of fracture processes in heterogeneous media. 2605.13703v1.title: Nonlinear dynamic elastic moduli from equilibrium stress fluctuations
2605.13703v1.summary: Fluctuation formulas for elastic and viscoelastic moduli allow their computation from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations, avoiding explicit nonequilibrium deformation protocols. While such expressions are well established for the quasi-static moduli, and also the linear dynamic moduli, no fluctuation formula exists for the nonlinear time-dependent moduli that govern anharmonic viscoelastic response under finite time-dependent strains. In this work we derive transient-time correlation function expressions for both the linear and the nonlinear dynamic moduli, starting from the DOLLS/SLLOD equations of motion for irrotational motion. The resulting formulas involve equilibrium time correlations of the stress tensor and Born-kinetic terms, and they recover the known quasi-static and linear dynamic results in the appropriate limits.
2605.13703v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决了从平衡态分子动力学模拟中计算非线性动态弹性模量的理论问题，这是材料非谐波粘弹性响应表征的关键需求。现有涨落公式仅适用于准静态模量和线性动态模量计算，无法处理有限时变应变下的非线性时间依赖模量。该工作的创新点在于从DOLLS/SLLOD运动方程出发，推导出了同时适用于线性和非线性动态模量的瞬态时间关联函数表达式。这避免了传统方法中需要显式施加非平衡变形协议的复杂性。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究基于分子动力学理论框架，使用DOLLS/SLLOD运动方程描述无旋转运动体系。核心理论建立在应力张量的平衡态时间关联函数基础上，结合Born-kinetic项构建涨落公式。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置和加载方式等关键参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。该方法的关键在于将非线性动态模量表达为平衡态应力涨落的时间关联函数，从而可以通过平衡态MD模拟直接计算，无需施加外部变形。推导的公式在适当极限下能够恢复已知的准静态和线性动态结果，验证了理论框架的正确性。摘要未提及使用的具体软件平台、模拟尺寸和时间步长等计算参数。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该研究成功推导出了非线性动态弹性模量的涨落公式，这些公式涉及应力张量和Born-kinetic项的平衡态时间关联。在准静态和线性动态极限下，新推导的公式能够恢复已知的理论结果，证明了方法的理论一致性。摘要未提及具体的数值验证结果、精度评估或与实验数据的对比情况，需查阅全文获取定量的模型验证信息。该方法的适用范围涵盖了从准静态到动态、从线性到非线性的完整弹性响应谱。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的涨落公式理论对我的多物理耦合场模拟和分子动力学研究具有重要价值，特别是在金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中需要准确表征材料的非线性粘弹性响应。该方法可以直接应用于我的MD模拟中，通过平衡态应力涨落计算获得材料的非线性动态模量，避免了复杂的非平衡变形协议设计。对于相场晶体模型(XPFC)研究，该理论框架可以为弹性常数的多尺度传递提供理论基础，特别是在处理有限应变下的非线性响应时。在金属疲劳模拟中，准确的非线性动态模量对于描述循环加载下的材料响应至关重要。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了理论推导的基本框架，但缺少具体的计算参数、验证算例和数值实现细节，需查阅全文获取完整的方法实现信息。建议重点精读理论推导部分和数值验证章节，特别关注涨落公式的具体形式和计算实现方法。

pdf_parse.method_excerpt: oelastic moduli of a material is essential for predicting its mechanical response to external loads. Molecular dynamics offers a way to compute these moduli directly from the underlying interatomic interactions, thereby linking macroscopic mechanical properties to the microscopic system description. To identify the elastic moduli, one can either perform nonequilibrium simulations and deduce the moduli directly from the stress response to an applied strain, or perform equilibrium simulations and extract them from the stress or strain fluctuations. While the equilibrium approach is computationally attractive, its application requires rigorous fluctuation formulas. For the linear quasi-static (zero-frequency) elastic constants, fluctuation expressions based on strain fluctuations [1] and stress fluctuations [2, 3, 4, 5] were obtained more than four decades ago. The extension of fluctuation methods to quasi-static nonlinear elastic moduli followed more recently [6]. For time-dependent deformations, a fluctuation formula for the linear viscoelastic moduli is also available [7]. A gap nevertheless remains in the understanding of the nonlinear dynamic mechanical response: no fluctuation formula exists for the nonlinear time-dependent moduli that govern the leading anharmonic contributions in viscoelastic materials subjected to small but finite time-dependent strains. 2605.13766v1.title: Elastica++: A high-performance, multiphysics framework for large interacting assemblies of Cosserat rods
2605.13766v1.summary: Soft, slender structures are ubiquitous in natural and engineered systems, with broad application potential from biomimetic materials to soft robotics. However, there is a notable lack of computational tools that simultaneously preserve high-fidelity continuum rod mechanics, scale to large interacting ensembles, and remain flexible across diverse biophysical settings. Here we introduce Elastica++, an open-source, high-performance implementation of the Cosserat-rod model for large-scale simulations of slender-body dynamics. Elastica++ combines performance-oriented kernels with shared-memory parallelism to sustain teraflop-scale throughput despite complex discretization domains and physical interactions. The framework further interoperates with external numerical solvers, supporting efficient multiphysics workflows. We demonstrate robustness and breadth through case studies spanning passive nest-like metamaterials, collective active-matter dynamics, cilia carpets, soft magnetic microrobots, and schooling swimmers. Elastica++ thus provides a missing foundation for high-throughput studies of emergent behavior in interacting assemblies of elastic slender structures.

2605.13164v1.title: Helium Bubbles in Liquid Lead Lithium Solutions: Pressure Inhomogeneities at Interfaces and Non Ideal Mixture Effects
2605.13164v1.summary: The extremely low solubility of helium in liquid metals may lead to rapid supersaturation, promoting spontaneous formation of helium bubbles by nucleation. Once nucleated, the stability of these bubbles is governed by the properties of the helium liquid metal interface. In particular, interfacial tension between the immiscible phases controls bubble interactions and induces local pressure inhomogeneities. This work is motivated by the need of a better understanding of helium bubble formation in liquid Pb Li alloys, which are of particular relevance for the design of breeding blankets in the future nuclear fusion reactors. We employ classical molecular dynamics simulations to investigate helium segregation in a range of lead lithium systems, including the limiting cases of pure lead and pure lithium. Changes in local pressure are evaluated from direct mechanical calculations, enabling the characterization of interfacial properties. Interfacial tension and radius of the bubble are subsequently determined across multiple thermodynamic conditions, spanning temperatures starting near the melting points of the constituent metals up to 1021 K. The impact of curvature and composition of the alloy on the interfacial behaviour are also investigated.

该论文解决氦气在液态铅锂合金中的气泡形成和稳定性问题，这对未来核聚变反应堆包层设计具有重要意义。氦气在液态金属中溶解度极低，容易导致快速过饱和并促进氦气泡的自发成核形成。现有研究对氦气泡与液态金属界面性质的理解不足，特别是界面张力如何控制气泡相互作用和诱导局部压力不均匀性。该工作的创新点在于通过分子动力学模拟系统研究氦气在铅锂合金中的偏析行为，并定量分析界面性质对气泡稳定性的影响。

2605.10342v1.title: How sea level paces faulting at fast-spreading mid-ocean ridges
2605.10342v1.summary: Abyssal hills, arguably the most extensive coherent pattern in Earth's surface topography, record the spacing of normal faults formed at mid-ocean ridges. At fast-spreading ridges, high-resolution bathymetry shows a pronounced spectral peak near 41 ky, coincident with obliquity-paced Pleistocene sea-level variability. The origin of this apparent orbital imprint on seafloor structure remains unresolved. We hypothesise that glacial-interglacial sea-level variability influences fault spacing by modulating plate thickness and the flexural stresses produced during plate unbending. Sea-level change alters mantle melting rates and magma supply at ridge axes, generating variations in the properties of the accreting plate. As the plate moves off axis, it unbends from its ingrown curvature, producing tensile fibre stresses that drive normal faulting. We hypothesise that small perturbations in elastic plate thickness modulate these stresses and thereby influence fault spacing. To test this, we extend the elastic unbending theory of Buck (2001) to include spatially variable plate thickness and yield-weakening viscoplastic flexure, which localises deformation into discrete kinks interpreted as faults. Linearised analysis shows that plate-thickness perturbations generate proportional fibre-stress variations. Numerical solutions demonstrate that perturbations as small as approximately 0.1 percent can phase-lock faulting to the imposed forcing. When driven by plate-thickness perturbations derived from the Pleistocene oxygen-isotope record, the model predicts fault spacings concentrated near 41 ky in the early Pleistocene and near 100 ky in the late Pleistocene, consistent with observed abyssal-hill spectra. These results provide a quantitative mechanism by which glacial-interglacial sea-level variability can be transmitted into tectonic structure.
2605.10342v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决海底深海丘陵地形中正断层间距的周期性规律问题，特别是快速扩张洋中脊处观测到的41千年周期性特征与更新世海平面变化的关联机制。现有研究虽然观测到深海丘陵地形存在明显的轨道周期信号，但缺乏定量的物理机制解释海平面变化如何影响海底构造结构。该工作创新性地提出了海平面变化通过调节板块厚度和弯曲应力来控制断层间距的耦合机制。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究基于Buck (2001)的弹性板块弯曲理论，扩展建立了包含空间变化板块厚度和屈服弱化粘塑性弯曲的数值模型。控制方程为弹性板块弯曲方程，结合粘塑性流变本构关系来模拟局部化变形和断层形成过程。模型采用线性化分析方法研究板块厚度扰动对纤维应力的影响，并通过数值求解验证小幅扰动（约0.1%）对断层间距的相位锁定效应。边界条件设置为洋中脊轴部的初始板块曲率和远场应力状态。加载方式为板块离轴运动过程中的弯曲卸载，通过更新世氧同位素记录驱动板块厚度时间序列变化。摘要未提及具体的数值求解软件平台和网格参数，需查阅全文获取计算细节。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

模型预测在更新世早期断层间距集中在41千年周期附近，晚期转向100千年周期，与观测的深海丘陵频谱特征定量吻合。线性化分析表明板块厚度扰动产生成比例的纤维应力变化，数值解证实仅0.1%的板块厚度扰动就能实现断层形成的相位锁定。该结果首次定量验证了冰期-间冰期海平面变化可以通过板块厚度调节机制传递到构造结构中，为轨道尺度的构造-气候耦合提供了物理基础。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的弹性-粘塑性耦合建模方法可直接应用于我的多物理场耦合模拟研究，特别是其处理局部化变形和断层形成的数值技术。板块厚度扰动引起应力场变化的定量关系（0.1%厚度变化产生显著应力响应）为我的金属疲劳模拟中微结构扰动参数设置提供参考。该工作展示的小幅周期性扰动驱动宏观结构演化的机制，对我研究循环加载下金属疲劳裂纹扩展的相场晶体模拟具有重要启发，特别是在边界条件的周期性调制设计方面。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了关键的物理参数（0.1%板块厚度扰动、41千年和100千年周期）和理论框架，但缺少数值求解的网格分辨率、时间步长和收敛准则等计算细节。建议重点精读数值模型构建和线性化分析部分，以获取完整的方程推导和参数设置信息。

2605.14646v1.title: N-Graphdiyne as a Tunable Platform for Stabilizing Light Metals toward High-Capacity Reversible Hydrogen Storage
2605.14646v1.summary: Hydrogen (H2) is a promising carbon-neutral energy carrier. However, its deployment is limited by the lack of lightweight, reversible storage media that operate under practical conditions. Here, we establish nitrogen-doped graphdiyne (N-GDY) as a programmable two-dimensional platform for stabilizing dispersed light-metal dopants and enabling high-capacity physisorption of molecular H2. The computational package involves density functional theory (DFT) combined with ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) and Langmuir-based statistical thermodynamic modeling. The results revealed that N-sites of N-GDY bind up to five Li, Na, K, and Ca atoms per primitive cell with binding energies of -2.27, -1.57, -1.80, and -2.13 eV, respectively, exceeding their respective bulk cohesive energies. AIMD simulations at 400 K further confirm the structural robustness of the decorated frameworks and the absence of metal aggregation. The polarised metal centres activate reversible H2 adsorption through electrostatic and dispersion interactions, with average adsorption energies falling within the optimal window (-0.15 to -0.35 eV per H2). Sequential adsorption analysis reveals uptake of up to 25 H2 molecules per primitive cell, achieving intrinsic gravimetric capacities of 13.08, 10.82, 9.23, and 9.15 wt% for Li-, Na-, K-, and Ca-functionalized systems, respectively. Thermodynamic analysis indicates favorable adsorption-desorption behavior under near-ambient conditions, with Li- and Ca-functionalized systems exceeding the 6.5 wt% U.S. Department of Energy's ultimate system-level target when considering intrinsic material capacity. These results identify N-GDY as a chemically tunable scaffold for dispersing lightweight metals and provide a mechanistic design strategy for achieving high-capacity, reversible hydrogen storage in porous two-dimensional materials.
2605.14646v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决氢气储存材料在实际条件下缺乏轻质、可逆储存介质的关键工程问题，氢气作为碳中性能源载体的大规模应用受到储存技术限制。现有储氢材料难以在近环境条件下实现高容量可逆储存，且轻金属掺杂材料容易发生团聚失活。该工作创新性地提出氮掺杂石墨二炔（N-GDY）作为可编程二维平台，通过分散稳定轻金属原子实现高容量氢气物理吸附。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合从头算分子动力学（AIMD）和基于Langmuir统计热力学建模的计算方案。DFT计算用于优化几何结构和计算结合能，AIMD模拟在400K温度下验证掺杂框架的结构稳定性和金属原子的分散状态。研究考查了Li、Na、K、Ca四种轻金属在N-GDY氮位点的结合，每个原胞最多可结合5个金属原子。氢气吸附采用逐步吸附分析方法，计算了多达25个H2分子在原胞中的吸附行为。摘要未提及具体的DFT泛函类型、基组设置、截断能、k点网格、AIMD时间步长等关键计算参数，需查阅全文获取。使用的计算软件平台在摘要中未明确说明。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

N-GDY氮位点对Li、Na、K、Ca的结合能分别为-2.27、-1.57、-1.80、-2.13 eV，均超过相应金属的体相内聚能，确保金属原子稳定分散。氢气平均吸附能控制在最优窗口-0.15至-0.35 eV范围内，实现可逆吸附。Li、Na、K、Ca功能化体系的本征重量储氢容量分别达到13.08、10.82、9.23、9.15 wt%，其中Li和Ca体系超过美国能源部6.5 wt%的终极系统级目标。AIMD在400K下证实了掺杂框架的结构稳定性和金属原子无团聚现象。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的DFT+AIMD多尺度计算策略可直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟研究，特别是在验证相场晶体模型（XPFC）中缺陷-氢相互作用的原子尺度机理。金属-氢结合能的计算方法和最优吸附能窗口（-0.15至-0.35 eV）可为我的氢致金属疲劳模拟提供关键的势函数参数。400K温度下的AIMD稳定性验证方法可借鉴用于我的拉伸变形模拟中温度效应的研究。逐步吸附分析的计算策略对我研究氢在金属中的扩散和聚集行为具有直接指导意义。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了主要的能量数值和储氢容量数据，但缺少DFT计算的具体参数设置、AIMD的时间步长和模拟时长、以及使用的计算软件等关键技术细节。建议重点精读方法学部分获取完整的计算参数，以及结果讨论部分了解氢吸附机理和热力学分析的详细过程。

2605.14397v1.title: Three dimensional simulation of fluid-driven frictional and tensile ruptures on existing discontinuities
2605.14397v1.summary: We present an implicit, fully-coupled hydro-mechanical solver for the three dimensional simulation of fluid-driven rupture propagation along existing discontinuities. The solver handles simultaneously frictional slip (shear failure) and tensile opening (hydraulic fracture) along arbitrary intersecting fractures and faults in a linearly elastic and impermeable rock matrix. The spatial discretization combines a collocation displacement discontinuity boundary element method for quasi-static elasticity with a Galerkin finite element method for nonlinear pore-fluid diffusion along the discontinuities. Frictional and tensile failure are governed by a poro-elastoplastic cohesive zone like interface law with slip-weakening friction, dilatancy, and tensile strength degradation, integrated via an elastic predictor-plastic corrector scheme. The strong nonlinear coupling between mechanical deformation and fracture permeability is handled via adaptive implicit time-stepping. Efficient block preconditioning of the coupled tangent system, leveraging hierarchical matrix representations of the boundary element operator, is essential to achieve robustness across the full range of fracture behaviors. Accuracy and convergence are demonstrated against a comprehensive suite of analytical and semi-analytical solutions of increasing complexity: fluid-driven frictional ruptures under constant and slip-weakening friction, dilatant ruptures with permeability changes, and penny shaped hydraulic fractures spanning the viscosity-to-toughness transition. The solver is further assessed on two multi-fracture configurations: injection into three intersecting fractures, and a height-confined hydraulic fracture intersecting a strike-slip fault. The proposed framework simultaneously captures frictional slip, dilatancy, permeability evolution, and tensile opening.
2605.14397v1.summary_text:
## 1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决流体驱动的三维断裂传播问题，特别是在既有不连续面（断层、裂缝）上同时发生摩擦滑移和拉伸开裂的复杂耦合过程。现有方法在处理多物理场耦合时存在数值稳定性差、无法同时处理摩擦和拉伸失效模式的局限性。该工作创新点在于开发了能够同时处理摩擦滑移（剪切破坏）和拉伸开裂（水力压裂）的全耦合三维求解器，并能处理任意相交断裂网络。

## 2) 核心方法与模型细节

采用隐式全耦合水力-力学求解器，结合配点位移不连续边界元法处理准静态弹性问题和Galerkin有限元法处理非线性孔隙流体扩散。控制方程基于线弹性不渗透岩石基质中的孔隙弹塑性内聚区界面定律，包含滑移弱化摩擦、剪胀和拉伸强度退化。采用弹性预测-塑性修正积分格式处理摩擦和拉伸失效。边界条件设置为摘要未提及，需查阅全文。加载方式为流体注入驱动的断裂传播，具体参数摘要未提及。采用自适应隐式时间步进处理机械变形与断裂渗透率之间的强非线性耦合。使用分层矩阵表示的边界元算子进行高效块预处理，软件平台为自研代码。

## 3) 关键结果与定量结论

求解器通过一系列解析和半解析解验证了精度和收敛性，包括常摩擦和滑移弱化摩擦下的流体驱动摩擦破裂、具有渗透率变化的剪胀破裂、以及跨越粘性-韧性转换的圆盘状水力压裂。在两个多断裂配置中进一步评估：三个相交断裂的注入和高度受限水力压裂与走滑断层相交的情况。该框架能够同时捕获摩擦滑移、剪胀、渗透率演化和拉伸开裂，具体数值结果摘要未提及，需查阅全文。

## 4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的全耦合求解策略对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要参考价值，特别是其处理非线性耦合的自适应时间步进方法可直接应用于我的XPFC模型中的多场耦合问题。其弹性预测-塑性修正积分格式可借鉴用于我的金属疲劳模拟中的塑性变形处理。边界元与有限元的混合离散化方法为我的拉伸变形模拟提供了新的数值实现思路。分层矩阵预处理技术对提高我当前大规模分子动力学模拟的计算效率具有启发意义。

## 5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了方法框架但缺少关键数值参数如时间步长、网格尺寸、材料参数等具体信息，需查阅全文获取完整参数设置。建议重点精读数值方法章节了解耦合求解算法细节，以及验证算例章节获取具体参数配置和边界条件设置。

2605.14793v1.title: Melting Behavior and Phase Stability of CaO from Neural Network Potentials: a Molecular Dynamics Study
2605.14793v1.summary: We investigate the melting behavior of calcium oxide (CaO) under extreme conditions, a problem that remains poorly constrained due to experimental limitations despite its relevance for geophysical and technological applications. We develop a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP) for CaO with PANNA 2.0 and the LATTE descriptor, training it on a dataset of $\sim$12,000 configurations including solid, liquid, interfacial, and void-containing structures, extracted from ab-initio molecular dynamics data employing PBEsol exchange-correlation functional. We perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations to compute the melting temperature at ambient pressure using both the void-nucleated melting (VNM) and two-phase coexistence (TPC) methods, obtaining $T_m=3055\pm11$ K and $T_m=2847\pm15$ K, respectively.\\ We calculate an enthalpy of fusion of $ΔH_f\sim73$ kJ/mol, in agreement with thermodynamic assessments and ab initio calculations. We also reproduce the thermal expansion and obtain a volume increase of $\sim$29% at Tm, consistent with the corresponding decrease in density extracted from spatially resolved number density profiles. Finally, we calculate the high-pressure melting curve of CaO up to 20 GPa, providing one of the very few computational determinations of this quantity to date. The results confirm that the overheating ratio $η$ is not constant under pressure, increasing from 17% at ambient pressure to 24% at 20 GPa, confirming previous findings and ruling out the assumption of a fixed overheating ratio. Our results establish MLIP-based simulations as a robust and efficient framework for investigating phase stability in ionic oxides and provide new insight into the melting behavior of CaO under extreme conditions.
2605.14793v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决氧化钙(CaO)在极端条件下的熔化行为问题，这一问题由于实验条件限制而缺乏准确约束，但对地球物理和技术应用具有重要意义。现有方法在高温高压条件下难以准确测定CaO的熔化温度和相稳定性，特别是高压熔化曲线的实验数据极其稀少。该工作的创新点在于开发了基于机器学习的原子间势函数来研究CaO的熔化行为，并首次计算了高达20 GPa压力下的熔化曲线。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

使用PANNA 2.0框架和LATTE描述符开发了CaO的机器学习原子间势函数(MLIP)，训练数据集包含约12000个构型，涵盖固体、液体、界面和含空隙结构。训练数据来源于采用PBEsol交换相关泛函的第一性原理分子动力学计算。采用空隙成核熔化(VNM)和两相共存(TPC)两种方法进行大规模分子动力学模拟来计算常压下的熔化温度。摘要未提及具体的模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。高压熔化曲线计算覆盖了0-20 GPa的压力范围。摘要未明确说明使用的具体MD软件平台，需查阅全文确认。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

2605.08953v1.title: A putative, computationally stable structure of homotrimeric BP180/collagen XVII
2605.08953v1.summary: Background: BP180, also known as collagen XVII and BPAG2 (bullous pemphigoid antigen 2), is a 180-kDa transmembrane protein within the hemidesmosomal plaque complex, and which is known to be a major antigen in bullous pemphigoid, gestational pemphigoid, cicatricial (mucous membrane) pemphigoid, and linear IgA bullous disease. Objective: At present, the 3D structure of BP180 is not known. The goal is to predict a reasonable structure for BP180 through machine learning and molecular dynamics. Methods: In this work, we use the recent Boltz-2 model to predict a putative structure for the intracellular, transmembrane, and proximal extracellular domains, including the NC16A antigenic region and a portion of its first extracellular collagenous domain, Col-15. We computationally embed BP180 in a simple phospholipid bilayer, demonstrate that the putative structure is stable using molecular dynamics, and analyze its allosteric properties. Results: The structures presented satisfy symmetry and secondary structure properties which are expected from homology modelling. Over three 500 ns trajectories, there is minor instability of the predicted globular head domain, but the homotrimer otherwise stays mostly folded. The putative NC16A domain is stiff, whereas the truncated Col-15 domain is highly flexible. There does not appear to be a nearby stable conformation distinct from the initial state. Conclusion: The structure presented is a useful starting point for targeting BP180 pharmacologically, for further experimental characterization of BP180, and for generating hypotheses regarding the relevant epitopes contributing to bullous disease. Diffusion models such as Boltz-2 and AlphaFold3 are useful, but their results must be evaluated carefully.
2605.08953v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决BP180/胶原蛋白XVII的三维结构预测问题，BP180是半桥粒斑复合体中的180-kDa跨膜蛋白，是大疱性类天疱疮等疾病的主要抗原。目前BP180的三维结构未知，限制了对其功能机制的理解和药物靶向设计。该工作创新性地结合机器学习结构预测模型Boltz-2与分子动力学模拟来预测BP180的稳定结构。现有方法缺乏对BP180完整结构域（包括胞内、跨膜和胞外域）的准确预测能力。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

使用Boltz-2机器学习模型预测BP180的胞内域、跨膜域和近端胞外域结构，包括NC16A抗原区域和第一个胞外胶原域Col-15的部分结构。将预测的BP180结构计算嵌入简单磷脂双分子层膜中进行分子动力学模拟验证。进行了三条独立的500纳秒MD轨迹模拟来评估结构稳定性。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置、模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量、时间步长等关键MD参数，需查阅全文获取。摘要未明确使用的MD软件平台，需查阅全文确认。分析了蛋白质的变构特性，重点关注NC16A域和Col-15域的动力学行为。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

在三条500纳秒的MD轨迹中，预测的球状头部域表现出轻微不稳定性，但同源三聚体整体保持折叠状态。NC16A域表现出刚性特征，而截断的Col-15域具有高度柔性。结构满足同源建模预期的对称性和二级结构特性。摘要未提供具体的应力值、温度范围、RMSD数值等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细数据。未发现与初始状态明显不同的附近稳定构象，表明预测结构具有合理的稳定性。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文展示了机器学习结构预测与MD验证相结合的多尺度建模策略，可为我的多物理耦合场模拟提供蛋白质-膜系统建模的参考方法。500纳秒的长时间MD模拟经验可指导我在金属疲劳模拟中的时间尺度选择和稳定性评估标准。蛋白质不同域的刚性-柔性分析方法可借鉴到金属材料中不同相区的力学性能差异研究。膜蛋白嵌入磷脂双分子层的建模方法对我研究多相界面问题具有启发意义，特别是在相场晶体模型中处理不同相界面的边界条件设计。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要缺少MD模拟的关键技术参数，包括势函数选择、温度控制、压力耦合、时间步长、盒子尺寸等，复现性有限。建议重点精读方法学部分获取完整的MD模拟参数设置，以及结果部分的定量分析数据和稳定性评估标准。

2605.01040v1.title: Differentiable Multiphysics Co-Optimization via Implicit Neural Representations: A Transient Hamburger-Cooking Benchmark
2605.01040v1.summary: The co-optimization of geometry and physical parameters remains challenging in transient multiphysics systems involving moving boundaries, nonlinear material response, phase transitions, and competing objectives. Existing methods often optimize geometry and physical variables separately, rely on simplified steady-state physics, or require offline data generation and reduced design spaces. Here, we present an end-to-end differentiable co-optimization framework that couples an implicit neural representation of geometry with a JAX-compiled Eulerian multiphysics solver. Geometry is represented as a signed distance field using Fourier-feature-encoded spatial coordinates, while boundary conditions, initial conditions, process controls, and material parameters are optimized within the same differentiable loop. Continuous relaxations represent non-smooth physical transitions while preserving compatibility with reverse-mode automatic differentiation and backpropagation through time. We demonstrate the framework using a transient hamburger-cooking benchmark, selected as an interpretable multiphysics problem rather than a culinary optimization exercise. The benchmark combines conductive and convective heat transfer, latent energy effects, moisture and fat transport, shrinkage-induced geometry evolution, evolving contact boundary conditions, flipping-induced boundary-condition changes, and competing quality objectives. Results show that geometry-only optimization modifies shape to relieve thermal bottlenecks, while joint co-optimization distributes the design response across geometry, material state, process variables, and boundary conditions through gradients propagated over the full transient rollout.
2605.01040v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决瞬态多物理场系统中几何形状与物理参数联合优化的挑战，特别是涉及移动边界、非线性材料响应、相变和竞争目标的复杂系统。现有方法通常将几何和物理变量分别优化，依赖简化的稳态物理模型，或需要离线数据生成和缩减设计空间，无法处理完整的瞬态多物理耦合问题。该工作创新点在于提出端到端可微分联合优化框架，将几何的隐式神经表示与JAX编译的欧拉多物理求解器耦合。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

使用隐式神经表示（INR）结合JAX编译的欧拉多物理求解器进行端到端可微分优化。几何形状通过符号距离场（SDF）表示，采用傅里叶特征编码的空间坐标作为输入。控制方程包括传导和对流传热、潜热效应、水分和脂肪传输、收缩引起的几何演化等多物理耦合方程。边界条件设置包括演化接触边界条件和翻转引起的边界条件变化。加载方式为瞬态汉堡烹饪过程，涉及时间相关的温度场、传质和几何变形。采用连续松弛方法处理非光滑物理转换，保持与反向模式自动微分和时间反向传播的兼容性。摘要未提及具体的网格规模、时间步长、原子数等关键数值参数，需查阅全文。使用JAX平台进行编译和自动微分计算。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现仅几何优化通过修改形状来缓解热瓶颈问题，而联合协同优化将设计响应分布在几何、材料状态、过程变量和边界条件之间。优化过程通过完整瞬态展开传播梯度实现多目标平衡。摘要未提及具体的应力值、温度范围、收缩率等定量数值，需查阅全文获取详细对比数据。该框架能够处理复杂的瞬态多物理耦合问题，相比传统分离优化方法具有更好的全局优化能力。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的可微分多物理耦合框架对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有重要参考价值，特别是其处理移动边界和瞬态过程的方法可以借鉴到金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中。隐式神经表示结合符号距离场的几何描述方法可以应用于相场晶体模型（XPFC）中的界面追踪和几何演化。连续松弛处理非光滑物理转换的技术对处理金属疲劳中的裂纹扩展和相变问题具有启发意义。JAX平台的自动微分能力可以用于优化分子动力学模拟中的势函数参数和边界条件设计。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了框架的总体思路和关键技术路线，但缺少具体的数值参数、网格设置、时间步长、材料参数等关键实现细节。建议重点精读方法论部分了解隐式神经表示的具体实现和多物理求解器的耦合机制，以及结果部分的定量对比分析和参数敏感性研究。

2605.22229v1.title: Delineating the interplay effects of microstructure topology and residual stresses in ultrafast laser irradiated thin films
2605.22229v1.summary: Advanced nanodevices require high-precision machining of thin films using ultrafast lasers. However, thin-film fabrications cause variations in microstructure, crystallographic orientation, and residual stresses owing to coating conditions and substrate choice. This work investigates the complex interplay between these factors in ultrafast laser-irradiated gold (Au) thin films using a hybrid Two Temperature Model-Molecular Dynamics simulations. We realized microstructure-informed atomistic models with varying grain topologies (randomized vs. equiaxed), grain sizes, and residual tensile/compressive stress configurations. Our results reveal a clear hierarchy of influence on laser-metal interaction: 1.) Microstructure configuration 2.) Topology 3.) Grain Size 4.) Crystallographic orientations. In fine-grained thin films, grain boundaries act as primary melting precursors, while local crystallographic orientation determines the melting extent in coarser grains. Residual tensile stresses contribute to higher melting and greater laser-induced expansion than unstrained films. Conversely, residual compressive stresses resist deformation, as deposited thermal energy is utilized to overcome lattice compression, leading to reduced expansion. We found that microstructure grain topology and size exert a stronger fingerprint on film expansion than the initial defect density.
2605.22229v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决超快激光加工金薄膜过程中微观结构拓扑与残余应力相互作用对激光-金属相互作用的影响问题。薄膜制备过程中由于涂层条件和基底选择会产生微观结构、晶体取向和残余应力的变化，这些因素如何协同影响激光加工效果尚不清楚。现有研究缺乏对微观结构配置、拓扑结构、晶粒尺寸和残余应力等多因素耦合效应的系统分析。该工作创新性地建立了考虑不同晶粒拓扑（随机化与等轴化）、晶粒尺寸和残余拉伸/压缩应力配置的微观结构信息化原子模型。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

采用双温度模型-分子动力学（Two Temperature Model-Molecular Dynamics, TTM-MD）混合模拟方法研究超快激光辐照金薄膜的过程。TTM模型描述电子和声子系统的温度演化，MD模拟处理原子尺度的结构响应和相变行为。势函数类型摘要未提及，需查阅全文确认是否使用EAM或其他金属势函数。建立了包含不同晶粒拓扑结构（随机化晶粒分布与规则等轴晶粒）、多种晶粒尺寸以及预设残余拉伸和压缩应力状态的金薄膜原子模型。边界条件设置摘要未提及，需查阅全文了解周期性边界或自由表面条件。模拟参数如原子数、薄膜厚度、激光功率密度、脉冲持续时间等关键数值摘要未提及，需查阅全文。使用的软件平台摘要未明确说明，需查阅全文确认是否基于LAMMPS或自研代码实现。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现影响激光-金属相互作用的因素重要性排序为：1）微观结构配置 2）拓扑结构 3）晶粒尺寸 4）晶体取向。在细晶粒薄膜中，晶界充当主要的熔化前驱体，而在粗晶粒中局部晶体取向决定熔化程度。残余拉伸应力导致更高的熔化程度和更大的激光诱导膨胀，而残余压缩应力抵抗变形，沉积的热能被用于克服晶格压缩从而导致膨胀减少。微观结构晶粒拓扑和尺寸对薄膜膨胀的影响比初始缺陷密度更为显著。具体的应力数值、温度范围、熔化深度等定量数据摘要未提及，需查阅全文获取。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的TTM-MD耦合方法可直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟研究，特别是热-力耦合的金属变形模拟。微观结构信息化建模方法对我的分子动力学模拟具有重要参考价值，可借鉴其晶粒拓扑构建和残余应力预设的技术路线。论文揭示的微观结构因素影响层次对我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中微观结构参数的优先级设置具有指导意义。残余应力对材料响应的影响机制可为我的XPFC模型中初始应力场设置和边界条件设计提供理论依据。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要缺少关键的模拟参数细节，包括势函数类型、原子数、薄膜尺寸、激光参数、边界条件等，需查阅全文获取完整的参数设置。建议重点精读方法学部分了解TTM-MD耦合实现细节、微观结构建模方法以及结果分析部分的定量数据和机理讨论。

2605.20017v1.title: Geometry-Dependent Crack Interaction and Toughening in Graphene
2605.20017v1.summary: The interaction between neighboring cracks has been shown to strongly influence the fracture behavior of graphene. While previous studies focused primarily on crack spacing, the role of crack width remains poorly understood. Here, computational simulations are performed to investigate the coupled effects of crack width and inter-crack spacing $(W_\text{gap})$ on the tensile response of graphene containing parallel cracks. The results show that increasing crack width amplifies the sensitivity of mechanical properties to crack spacing, leading to significant enhancement of peak stress, fracture strain, and toughness at sufficiently large $W_\text{gap}$. For narrow cracks, crack coalescence dominates and causes brittle failure. In contrast, wider cracks promote delayed ligament rupture, increased energy absorption and ductile-like fracture behavior. The normalized toughness and fracture strain exceed those of equivalent single-crack systems by more than twofold. A crack-geometry design map is proposed to identify regimes of crack coalescence, independent propagation, and enhanced toughness.
2605.20017v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决石墨烯中相邻裂纹相互作用对断裂行为影响的科学问题，特别是在拉伸载荷下裂纹几何参数对韧性的调控机制。现有研究主要关注裂纹间距对石墨烯断裂的影响，但对裂纹宽度的作用机理理解不足。该工作的创新点在于系统研究了裂纹宽度与裂纹间距的耦合效应，发现了通过几何设计实现韧性增强的新机制。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

摘要未提及具体的模拟方法类型，需查阅全文确认是否使用分子动力学、连续介质力学或其他计算方法。研究采用计算模拟方法分析含平行裂纹石墨烯的拉伸响应，重点考察裂纹宽度和裂纹间距参数的耦合效应。摘要未提及势函数类型、边界条件设置、加载方式的具体细节，需查阅全文获取关键参数信息。模拟对象为含有平行裂纹的石墨烯结构，通过系统变化裂纹几何参数来研究其对力学性能的影响。摘要未提及模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键数值参数，也未说明使用的软件平台。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现增加裂纹宽度会放大力学性能对裂纹间距的敏感性，在足够大的裂纹间距下显著提升峰值应力、断裂应变和韧性。对于宽裂纹体系，归一化韧性和断裂应变超过等效单裂纹系统的两倍以上。窄裂纹主导裂纹聚合并导致脆性断裂，而宽裂纹促进韧带延迟断裂、增加能量吸收并表现出类延性断裂行为。论文提出了裂纹几何设计图，用于识别裂纹聚合、独立扩展和韧性增强的不同区域。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的裂纹几何参数优化策略可直接应用于我的金属疲劳模拟和拉伸变形模拟研究中，特别是在设计含缺陷材料的韧性增强方案时。裂纹宽度与间距的耦合效应分析方法可借鉴到相场晶体模型中，用于研究晶界、位错等缺陷的相互作用机制。论文提出的几何设计图概念对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要参考价值，可用于建立缺陷几何参数与材料性能的映射关系。韧性增强超过两倍的定量结果为我的模型验证提供了重要的基准数据。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要缺少关键的模拟方法细节、势函数参数、边界条件和具体数值参数，需查阅全文获取完整的计算设置信息才能实现复现。建议重点精读方法部分以获取模拟参数设置，以及结果部分中关于裂纹几何设计图的构建方法和韧性增强机制的详细分析。

2605.20358v1.title: Modeling phase separation in polymer-derived carbonitride ceramics through extended machine learning molecular dynamics
2605.20358v1.summary: Polymer-derived ceramics combine the thermal stability of ceramics with the versatile properties of carbon domains, but modeling their atomic-scale evolution during processing remains elusive due to the limitations of traditional computational methods. To address this issue, here we develop and apply a machine learning interatomic potential for silicon carbonitride-based (Si-C-N-H) systems, trained on a diversified database of over 9000 configurations -including amorphous models, high-temperature states, surfaces, and crystal structure predictions - to capture the full complexity of these materials. This potential enables large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of 8000-atom systems revealing the atomic-scale evolution of the polymer-derived ceramic during thermal treatment. A key result of this work is the occurrence of a phase separation where carbon domains progressively nucleate from the amorphous SiCN matrix during thermal processing, forming distinct graphene-like sheets while preserving the integrity of the ceramic network. The resulting models reproduce the experimental atomic pair distribution functions with exceptional fidelity, validating our approach and providing microscopic explanations for the material unique combination of ceramic and graphitic properties. In this process, defective 5- and/or 7-member carbon rings, mediate the transformation to stable 6-member aromatic structures. These findings offer new atomic-scale insights into the thermal stability and structural transformation pathways of polymer-derived ceramics, while our methodology opens avenues for studying complex amorphous systems with first-principles accuracy at experimentally relevant scales.
2605.20358v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决聚合物衍生碳氮化物陶瓷在热处理过程中原子尺度演化的建模难题，这类材料结合了陶瓷的热稳定性和碳域的多功能特性。传统计算方法在处理这类复杂非晶系统时存在尺度和精度限制，无法准确描述热处理过程中的相分离行为。该工作的创新点在于开发了专门针对Si-C-N-H体系的机器学习原子间势函数，能够在实验相关尺度上实现第一性原理精度的大规模分子动力学模拟。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用机器学习分子动力学方法，基于超过9000个构型的多样化数据库训练了Si-C-N-H体系的机器学习原子间势函数，数据库包含非晶模型、高温态、表面和晶体结构预测等配置。使用该势函数进行了8000原子体系的大规模分子动力学模拟来研究聚合物衍生陶瓷的热演化过程。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型（如GAP、MTP等）、边界条件设置、温度范围、时间步长等关键参数细节，需查阅全文获取。模拟重点关注热处理过程中碳域从非晶SiCN基体中逐步成核的相分离现象。摘要未明确提及使用的具体软件平台，需查阅全文确认。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

模拟发现在热处理过程中发生相分离，碳域从非晶SiCN基体中逐步成核形成类石墨烯片状结构，同时保持陶瓷网络的完整性。计算得到的原子对分布函数与实验结果具有极高的一致性，验证了方法的准确性。研究揭示缺陷的5元环和7元环碳结构介导了向稳定6元芳香结构的转变过程。摘要未提供具体的应力值、温度范围、缺陷密度等定量数值，需查阅全文获取详细数据。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的机器学习势函数训练策略对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要参考价值，特别是构建包含多种构型的训练数据库方法可应用于我的金属疲劳模拟中。8000原子规模的大尺度MD模拟为我的拉伸变形模拟提供了尺度选择参考。相分离过程中缺陷环结构的演化机制对理解我研究中的位错形核和演化具有启发意义。该工作展示的原子对分布函数验证方法可用于我的XPFC模型结果验证。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了训练数据库规模（9000个构型）和模拟体系大小（8000原子）等基本信息，但缺少势函数具体类型、训练参数、温度条件、时间步长等关键技术细节。建议重点精读方法学部分了解机器学习势函数的具体实现和训练策略，以及结果部分的相分离机制分析和模型验证方法。

2605.16659v1.title: Non-linear diffusion and inhomogeneity of the magnetic field in single-turn coils: Insights from 3D multiphysics modeling
2605.16659v1.summary: The single-turn coil method is a destructive pulsed magnet for generating over 100 T with a few $μ$-second pulse duration, and it inevitably causes the coil to explode. The temporal and spatial distributions of the electric current and magnetic field are highly inhomogeneous, arising from the skin effect, rapid temperature rise, and coil deformation. To grasp the dynamic phenomena in the single-turn coil, we conducted a finite element analysis using multiphysics simulation. We employed finite element method calculations using a fully 3D model of the single-turn coil with broken cylindrical symmetry. The calculated result revealed highly nonlinear diffusion of electric current, temperature, and magnetic fields, which are the sources of the inhomogeneous magnetic fields inside the single-turn coil in time and space.
2605.16659v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决单匝线圈脉冲磁体中电流、温度和磁场的非线性扩散及其时空不均匀性问题，这种装置能产生超过100特斯拉的强磁场但会导致线圈爆炸。现有方法在处理单匝线圈的复杂多物理场耦合现象时存在局限性，特别是在考虑趋肤效应、快速温升和线圈变形的综合影响方面。该工作的创新点在于采用完全三维有限元模型来捕捉破坏圆柱对称性后的复杂物理现象。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用有限元方法进行多物理场耦合模拟，建立了完全三维的单匝线圈模型以处理破坏的圆柱对称性。摘要未提及具体的控制方程，需查阅全文了解电磁-热-力耦合的理论框架。边界条件设置摘要未详细说明，需查阅全文确定电磁边界和热边界条件。加载方式为脉冲电流驱动，脉冲持续时间为几微秒量级，能产生超过100特斯拉的磁场强度。模拟的关键参数如网格规模、时间步长、材料参数等摘要未提及，需查阅全文获取。使用的软件平台摘要未明确说明，需查阅全文确定是否使用COMSOL、ANSYS或自研代码。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

主要发现是单匝线圈内部存在高度非线性的电流、温度和磁场扩散现象，这些是造成磁场时空不均匀性的根本原因。计算结果揭示了磁场强度超过100特斯拉，脉冲持续时间为几微秒的定量特征。摘要未提及与实验结果的具体对比数据，需查阅全文了解模型验证情况。模型能够捕捉趋肤效应、温升和变形的耦合效应，适用于强脉冲磁场装置的设计分析。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多物理场耦合建模方法对我的研究具有重要参考价值，特别是在处理电磁-热-力多场耦合问题方面。三维有限元建模处理复杂几何和破坏对称性的方法可以借鉴到我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中，特别是在考虑温度场影响的情况下。非线性扩散现象的数值处理技术对我的相场晶体模型中的扩散方程求解具有启发意义。该工作在处理快速动态过程和强耦合效应方面的经验可以应用到我的多物理耦合场模拟研究中。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

论文摘要缺少关键的数值参数、材料属性、网格参数和求解器设置等信息，需要查阅全文获取完整的模拟细节才能实现复现。建议重点精读方法部分了解多物理场耦合的具体实现方式，以及结果部分的定量分析和验证方法。

2605.16214v1.title: Bridging Atomistic Simulation and Experimental Processing Timescales with Goal-Directed Deep Reinforcement Learning
2605.16214v1.summary: Atomic-scale modeling has advanced rapidly through integration of machine learning, yet a key bottleneck remains. Even with an accurate potential energy surface and a clear target material, we still lack a practical atomistic dynamics framework that can simulate how materials form under realistic synthesis and processing conditions. Many processing transformations are governed by rare events in non-idealized evolving environments, while direct molecular dynamics is limited by femtosecond timesteps and short accessible trajectories. Existing acceleration methods often require prior mechanistic knowledge, including reaction coordinates, collective variables, event tables, or pathway guesses, which is rarely available in real experiments. Here we present an E(3)-equivariant deep reinforcement learning framework that enables goal-directed pathway discovery without hand-crafted reaction coordinates. The framework introduces a complementary operating mode for atomistic simulation in which realistic, non-idealized environments can be addressed directly while retaining kinetic plausibility through barrier-aware rewards. As a challenging benchmark, we target silicon dry oxidation, where rare-event pathways in amorphous SiO2 are effectively inaccessible to conventional atomistic methods. We treat an O2 molecule as an agent that performs continuous rigid-body translations and rotations in a Si/a-SiO2 environment. The agent is trained with an episode-level objective that rewards verified O2 dissociation while preferring low effective activation barriers. We demonstrate that the learned policy discovers kinetically favorable O2 diffusion and dissociation pathways in a disordered Si/a-SiO2 environment, progressively improving success rate while reducing effective activation barriers over training. We also discuss how the approach can be generalized to other processing and synthesis problems.
2605.16214v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决原子尺度模拟中时间尺度桥接的关键瓶颈问题，即如何在真实合成和加工条件下模拟材料形成过程。传统分子动力学受限于飞秒时间步长和短轨迹长度，无法处理材料加工中的稀有事件转变。现有加速方法需要预先的机理知识如反应坐标、集体变量或路径猜测，这在实际实验中很难获得。该工作创新性地提出了无需手工制作反应坐标的目标导向路径发现框架。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用E(3)等变深度强化学习框架结合分子动力学模拟，以硅干氧化为基准测试案例。将O2分子作为智能体，在Si/a-SiO2环境中执行连续刚体平移和旋转操作。强化学习采用情节级目标函数，奖励经验证的O2解离过程，同时偏好低有效激活势垒。框架通过势垒感知奖励机制保持动力学合理性，能够直接处理真实的非理想化环境。智能体在无序Si/a-SiO2环境中训练，学习发现动力学有利的O2扩散和解离路径。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。使用的软件平台和边界条件设置也未在摘要中明确说明。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

训练过程中智能体逐步提高成功率并降低有效激活势垒，成功发现了在无序Si/a-SiO2环境中动力学有利的O2扩散和解离路径。该方法能够处理非晶SiO2中传统原子方法无法有效获取的稀有事件路径。摘要未提供具体的数值结果如激活势垒降低幅度、成功率提升数据、与实验或其他模拟方法的定量对比等，需查阅全文获取详细的定量结论和精度评估信息。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的E(3)等变深度强化学习框架可直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟和金属疲劳模拟研究中，特别是处理稀有事件和长时间尺度问题。势垒感知奖励机制的设计思路可借鉴到我的相场晶体模型(XPFC)中，用于优化相变路径搜索。目标导向的路径发现方法对我的拉伸变形模拟具有重要启发，可用于识别材料失效的关键路径而无需预设反应坐标。该框架的通用性设计为我扩展到其他材料加工和合成问题提供了方法论指导。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要缺少关键的模拟参数如势函数选择、系统尺寸、训练超参数等详细信息，完整复现需要查阅全文的方法学部分。建议重点精读强化学习框架设计、奖励函数构建和E(3)等变性实现的相关章节，以及硅氧化基准测试的具体实施细节。

2605.19858v1.title: Accelerated "on-the-fly" coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics: Impact of nuclear quantum effects on an asymmetric proton
2605.19858v1.summary: We present an accelerated ``on-the-fly'' coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) method for finite-temperature simulations in which electron correlation and nuclear quantum effects are treated simultaneously. The approach is based on our quantum ring-polymer contraction (qRPC) technique, in which the inexpensive Hartree-Fock potential is evaluated on the full ring-polymer, while the expensive coupled-cluster correction is evaluated on the centroid only. This qRPC decomposition is combined with a second-generation Car-Parrinello-like dynamics of the Hartree-Fock reference and a basis-consistent extrapolation of the coupled-cluster and de-excitation amplitudes. The combination of all three acceleration layers is essential for making correlated PIMD calculations feasible. We apply the method to a proton shared by water and formaldehyde. Relative to classical nuclei, nuclear quantum effects broaden covalent X--H bond-length distributions, reduce the bias of the shared proton toward formaldehyde, and shift the mean proton-transfer coordinate from 0.206 to 0.135A. The probability of finding the proton closer to formaldehyde decreases from 81.7$\%$ to 61.1$\%$. The corresponding nuclear magnetic shielding tensors show that electron correlation and nuclear quantum effects are of comparable magnitude and can act in opposite directions. These results demonstrate that predictive simulations of asymmetric hydrogen bonds require a simultaneous treatment of correlated electronic structure and nuclear quantum fluctuations.
2605.19858v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决氢键体系中电子关联效应与核量子效应同时处理的计算挑战，特别针对水-甲醛共享质子体系的不对称氢键问题。传统的路径积分分子动力学方法在处理电子关联时计算成本过高，无法实现有限温度下的实时模拟。现有方法要么忽略核量子效应，要么简化电子结构处理，无法准确描述氢键体系的真实行为。该工作创新性地结合量子环聚合物收缩技术与耦合簇理论，实现了电子关联与核量子效应的同步处理。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用加速的"实时"耦合簇路径积分分子动力学方法，基于量子环聚合物收缩技术进行多层加速。核心理论框架结合路径积分分子动力学与耦合簇电子结构理论，通过三层加速策略降低计算成本：第一层使用量子环聚合物收缩技术，在完整环聚合物上计算廉价的Hartree-Fock势能，仅在质心位置计算昂贵的耦合簇修正；第二层采用第二代Car-Parrinello类动力学处理Hartree-Fock参考态；第三层使用基组一致性外推处理耦合簇和去激发振幅。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置、模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。同样，使用的软件平台信息在摘要中未提及，需查阅全文确认。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多层加速策略对我的多物理耦合场模拟具有重要借鉴价值，特别是量子环聚合物收缩技术可应用于我的相场晶体模型中处理量子效应。质子转移坐标的定量变化数据（0.206到0.135埃）为我的金属中氢扩散模拟提供参考基准。电子关联与核量子效应的耦合处理方法可启发我在XPFC模型中引入电子结构修正。该工作展示的概率分布变化（81.7%到61.1%）为我的统计分析方法提供定量验证标准，有助于改进我当前工作中的缺陷统计模型。

2605.16337v1.title: Anomalous Diffusion as Structural Memory: An Extended Structural Dynamics Approach
2605.16337v1.summary: Sub-diffusion in biological systems is conventionally treated as anomalous, requiring fractional derivatives, heavy-tailed waiting times, or fitted memory kernels. We argue that this anomaly is an artifact of an incomplete phase space. Standard frameworks model diffusing particles as points. Biological molecules are not points. They are three-dimensional deformable entities whose position, orientation, and internal structure are irreducible physical properties, not modeling conveniences appended to a point mass. Within the Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) framework, each particle is a primitive structured entity with translational, orientational, and deformational degrees of freedom. When dynamics on this full phase space are projected onto the translational subspace alone, a memory kernel emerges from the projection without phenomenological postulate. The subdiffusion exponent is determined by the internal mode spectrum, independently measurable from B-factors, NMR order parameters, or molecular dynamics simulations, without fitting to transport data. Four falsifiable predictions follow: subdiffusion strength correlates with molecular flexibility; temperature drives crossover to normal diffusion at a characteristic energy scale set by internal mode frequencies; a non-zero rotation-translation cross-correlation spectrum encodes internal dynamics, identically zero in point-particle models; and memory timescales scale as the square of particle size. Quantitative consistency with experimental observations for proteins in crowded media is demonstrated using independently estimated structural parameters. What appears anomalous from the point-particle perspective is the expected behavior of structured matter projected onto an impoverished description. The anomaly is not in the physics. It is in the phase space.
2605.16337v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决生物系统中亚扩散现象的物理机制问题，传统方法将其视为异常扩散，需要分数阶导数、重尾等待时间或拟合记忆核函数来描述。现有方法的局限性在于将扩散粒子简化为点粒子模型，忽略了生物分子的三维可变形结构特性。该工作的创新点是提出扩展结构动力学（ESD）框架，将分子的位置、取向和内部结构作为不可约的物理属性，而非建模便利性的附加项。通过完整相空间描述，亚扩散现象从投影效应中自然涌现，无需现象学假设。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用扩展结构动力学（ESD）理论框架，将每个粒子建模为具有平移、取向和变形自由度的原始结构实体。控制方程基于完整相空间的朗之万动力学，当从完整相空间投影到仅平移子空间时，记忆核函数自然涌现。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型和边界条件设置。模型通过内部模式频谱确定亚扩散指数，该频谱可从B因子、NMR序参数或分子动力学模拟中独立测量，无需拟合输运数据。摘要未提及具体的模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等参数细节，需查阅全文。该方法使用独立估计的结构参数对拥挤介质中蛋白质的实验观测进行定量验证，但未明确提及使用的软件平台。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该研究提出四个可证伪的预测：亚扩散强度与分子柔性相关；温度在由内部模式频率设定的特征能量尺度处驱动向正常扩散的交叉；非零的旋转-平移交叉关联谱编码内部动力学信息；记忆时间尺度与粒子尺寸的平方成正比。研究使用独立估计的结构参数对拥挤介质中蛋白质实验观测实现了定量一致性验证。摘要未提及具体的应力值、温度范围、缺陷密度等定量数值，需查阅全文获取详细数据。该模型将传统认为的异常扩散解释为结构化物质在贫化描述下的预期行为。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该ESD框架对多物理耦合场模拟具有重要启发，特别是在处理具有内部结构的复杂系统时，可以避免传统点粒子模型的局限性。对于分子动力学模拟，该方法提供了一种新的理论框架来理解和预测输运性质，无需依赖现象学记忆核函数。在金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中，该方法的投影思想可以用于理解宏观行为与微观结构动力学之间的关系，特别是当需要从原子尺度信息推导连续介质行为时。该研究提出的记忆时间尺度与粒子尺寸平方关系的预测，可以为多尺度模拟中的时间尺度桥接提供理论指导。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了理论框架的基本概念，但缺少关键的数值参数、具体的计算细节和验证数据，需查阅全文获取完整的方法学细节和定量结果。建议重点精读理论推导部分以理解ESD框架的数学基础，以及实验验证部分以获取具体的参数值和对比数据。

2603.23351v2.title: Laser-Enhanced Contact Optimization in Silicon Photovoltaics: Mechanisms, Reliability, and Predictive Process Design
2603.23351v2.summary: Laser-enhanced contact optimization (LECO) has emerged as an important method for simultaneously reducing contact resistivity and metallization-induced recombination in advanced crystalline silicon solar cells, thereby enabling concurrent gains in fill factor and open-circuit voltage, particularly in TOPCon devices. However, broader industrial transferability remains constrained by the need to preserve these gains within a narrow process window and by unresolved, architecture-dependent questions regarding the kinetic stability of some LECO-modified interfaces. LECO is therefore examined in this review as a coupled multiphysics process that links localized electrothermal activation and microstructural evolution to device-level electrical signatures through an instantaneous regime map and a reliability classification based on time-dependent drift. A predictive workflow is outlined that couples transient electrothermal modeling with reduced state metrics, including effective diffusion depth and local areal energy density, and propagates calibrated thresholds across the recipe space. The framework separates stable optimization from marginal activation and latent damage, while explaining why fine-line scaling and copper-containing contact stacks can tighten stability margins through current localization and diffusion-barrier constraints. These insights provide a basis for reliability-aware process-window design and future digital-twin-assisted optimization of LECO for scalable, high-efficiency silicon photovoltaics.
2603.23351v2.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决激光增强接触优化（LECO）技术在硅太阳能电池中的工艺稳定性和可靠性问题，特别是在TOPCon器件中如何同时降低接触电阻率和金属化诱导复合。现有LECO方法虽能提升填充因子和开路电压，但工艺窗口狭窄，且在不同器件架构下界面动力学稳定性存在未解决的问题，限制了工业化推广。该工作创新点在于将LECO视为多物理耦合过程，建立了瞬态电热建模与可靠性分类相结合的预测性工艺设计框架。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用多物理耦合建模方法，将瞬态电热建模与微结构演化相结合，通过瞬态状态图和基于时间依赖漂移的可靠性分类来描述LECO过程。核心理论框架基于局部电热激活与器件级电学特性的耦合关系，使用有效扩散深度和局部面能量密度作为简化状态度量参数。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置和加载方式等详细参数，需查阅全文获取。建模过程涉及电流局域化效应和扩散阻挡层约束的分析，特别关注细线缩放和含铜接触堆栈对稳定性边界的影响。摘要未提及使用的具体软件平台、模拟尺寸、时间步长等关键技术参数，需查阅全文。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究建立了将稳定优化与边际激活、潜在损伤相分离的框架，解释了细线缩放和含铜接触堆栈通过电流局域化和扩散阻挡约束收紧稳定性边界的机制。摘要未提及具体的数值结果，如应力值、温度范围、缺陷密度等定量参数，需查阅全文获取。该框架为可靠性感知的工艺窗口设计提供了理论基础，并支持未来数字孪生辅助的LECO优化。摘要未提及与已有实验或模拟结果的具体对比情况。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多物理耦合建模方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有直接借鉴价值，特别是其将瞬态电热过程与微结构演化相结合的建模思路。有效扩散深度和局部面能量密度等简化状态度量参数的概念可以应用到我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中，用于描述局部损伤演化过程。该研究提出的可靠性分类方法和稳定性边界分析框架可以为我的XPFC模型中的相变稳定性分析提供参考。瞬态状态图的构建方法对我的分子动力学模拟中的动态过程分析具有启发意义。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供的参数细节有限，缺少具体的建模参数、材料参数、几何尺寸等关键信息，需要查阅全文获取完整的技术细节以实现复现。建议重点精读多物理耦合建模方法、瞬态电热建模部分以及可靠性分类框架的具体实现细节。

2605.22225v1.title: Silicate cosmic dust grain collisions in the interstellar medium: A molecular dynamics study
2605.22225v1.summary: (abridged) We aim to predict the most important parameters for grain-grain collision outcomes for models of interstellar grain population evolution on astrophysical scales: the threshold velocity above which colliding grains shatter, the threshold for vaporization, and resulting distributions of grain sizes. We use molecular dynamics simulations which evolve the dynamics of each atom in a dust grain to explore the outcomes of collisions between silicate grains of radii $a \in [5,50]~Å$ at velocities $0.1-20$ km/s. We run simulations of grains with two materials: amorphous SiO$_2$ and an amorphous silicate of composition suggested by Draine \& Hensley (2021). With these simulations, we quantify the collision velocity dependence of shattered and vaporized mass fractions, and the resulting size distributions of shattering products. We find grain shattering thresholds are $\sim$6 km/s for both amorphous SiO$_2$ and astrodust material, which is a factor of $\sim$2 higher than the canonical value for silicates of 2.7 km/s from Jones et al. (1996). This discrepancy is mostly alleviated by correcting an error in the expression for these velocity thresholds derived in Tielens et al. (1994). We find that the size distributions of shattered products are generally not consistent with the power law distributions predicted by this previous model. We also find that their expression fails to predict the fraction of shattered or vaporized material observed in our numerical simulations. The model of Hirashita \& Kobayashi (2013) for the same quantities similarly fails to match the simulations. We provide updated shattering velocity thresholds for standard candidate grain materials to the astrophysics community. Broadly, our updated threshold velocities that astrophysical dust grains may be more robust to shattering in the interstellar medium than previously assumed.
2605.22225v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决星际介质中硅酸盐宇宙尘埃颗粒碰撞的物理机制问题，旨在为天体物理尺度的颗粒群体演化模型提供关键参数。现有的Jones等人(1996)提出的硅酸盐颗粒破碎阈值速度2.7 km/s以及Tielens等人(1994)的理论表达式存在显著误差，无法准确预测颗粒碰撞结果。该工作通过分子动力学模拟直接计算原子级别的碰撞动力学，提供更精确的破碎和汽化阈值参数。创新点在于首次使用MD方法系统研究星际尘埃颗粒碰撞，并发现现有理论模型的重大缺陷。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

使用分子动力学(MD)模拟方法，通过演化尘埃颗粒中每个原子的动力学过程来探索碰撞结果。研究对象为两种材料的球形颗粒：非晶态SiO₂和Draine & Hensley(2021)建议成分的非晶态硅酸盐。颗粒半径范围为5-50埃，碰撞速度范围0.1-20 km/s。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置和软件平台，需查阅全文获取这些关键技术细节。模拟系统包含不同尺寸组合的颗粒对碰撞，通过统计分析量化破碎和汽化质量分数随碰撞速度的依赖关系。摘要未提及原子数、时间步长、模拟盒子尺寸等具体数值参数。研究还分析了破碎产物的尺寸分布特征。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

发现非晶态SiO₂和天体尘埃材料的颗粒破碎阈值速度均约为6 km/s，比Jones等人(1996)的经典值2.7 km/s高出约2倍。通过修正Tielens等人(1994)速度阈值表达式中的错误，这一差异基本得到解释。破碎产物的尺寸分布普遍不符合先前模型预测的幂律分布。Tielens等人和Hirashita & Kobayashi(2013)的模型都无法准确预测数值模拟观察到的破碎或汽化材料分数。摘要未提及汽化阈值的具体数值和其他定量对比结果，需查阅全文。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的MD碰撞模拟方法可直接应用于我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟研究中，特别是在研究材料破坏机制和阈值参数方面。6 km/s的破碎阈值速度为高应变率加载条件下的材料响应提供了参考标准。颗粒碰撞中的能量耗散和破碎模式分析方法可借鉴用于金属材料的裂纹扩展和疲劳损伤演化研究。该工作证明了现有理论模型的局限性，提醒我在多物理耦合场模拟中需要通过原子尺度验证来校正宏观模型参数。破碎产物尺寸分布的非幂律特征对我研究材料微观结构演化具有重要启发意义。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要缺少势函数类型、边界条件、软件平台、具体原子数和时间步长等关键技术参数，复现性评估需查阅全文的方法学部分。建议重点精读方法学章节以获取完整的模拟参数设置，以及结果部分中关于破碎阈值修正和尺寸分布分析的定量数据。

2605.20890v1.title: Transferable 3D Convolutional Neural Networks for Elastic Constants Prediction in Nanoporous Metals
2605.20890v1.summary: The topology of nanoporous metals is crucial for determining their mechanical response. In this work, we generated 6,000 gold and 422 silver nanoporous structures and calculated three components of elastic modulus with Molecular Dynamics simulations, resulting in 19,263 data points. This study compared two distinct approaches of predicting elastic modulus: a Fully-Connected neural network trained on precomputed topological descriptors, and several 3D Convolutional neural network architectures adapted from computer vision. The 3D CNNs outperformed the descriptor-based baseline model ($R^2 = 0.704$), with to-performing DenseNet-201 architecture achieving $R^2 = 0.955$. Additionally, the effects of training grid resolution, dataset size, and descriptor integration into a model were investigated. We further demonstrated model robustness through Transfer learning: a pretrained model was fine-tuned on a much smaller dataset of denser gold structures and the dataset of denser silver structures. Finally, the trained model was employed to evaluate the mechanical properties of 100,000 stochastic nanoporous gold structures and identify the Pareto optimal designs.
2605.20890v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决纳米多孔金属弹性常数预测的科学问题，针对传统分子动力学计算成本高昂且难以大规模筛选最优结构的挑战。现有方法主要依赖基于预计算拓扑描述符的全连接神经网络，但预测精度有限且难以捕捉复杂的三维结构特征。该工作创新性地引入3D卷积神经网络架构，直接从三维结构数据学习弹性性质，显著提升了预测精度和可迁移性。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用分子动力学模拟生成训练数据，计算6000个金纳米多孔结构和422个银纳米多孔结构的三个弹性模量分量，共获得19263个数据点。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型和MD软件平台，需查阅全文获取详细信息。核心方法包括两种神经网络架构：基于预计算拓扑描述符的全连接网络作为基线模型，以及多种改编自计算机视觉的3D卷积神经网络架构。最优的DenseNet-201架构在弹性模量预测上达到R²=0.955的精度，显著超越基线模型的R²=0.704。研究系统性地探讨了训练网格分辨率、数据集规模和描述符集成对模型性能的影响。摘要未提及具体的网格分辨率、原子数规模和边界条件设置等关键参数。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

DenseNet-201架构在弹性常数预测上实现R²=0.955的高精度，相比基线全连接网络的R²=0.704提升了35.7%。通过迁移学习验证了模型的鲁棒性，预训练模型能够在更小的高密度金结构数据集和银结构数据集上成功微调。最终训练的模型被应用于评估100000个随机纳米多孔金结构的力学性质，成功识别出帕累托最优设计。摘要未提及与实验结果的具体对比情况和模型适用的密度范围等定量信息。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的3D CNN架构可直接应用于我的多物理耦合场模拟中，特别是在金属疲劳模拟中预测不同微观结构的力学响应。DenseNet-201的网络架构设计和迁移学习策略对我的相场晶体模型(XPFC)研究具有重要参考价值，可用于建立微观结构与宏观性质的快速映射关系。该工作的大规模结构筛选方法可借鉴用于我的拉伸变形模拟中，通过神经网络快速预筛选候选结构，再进行精确的MD验证。训练网格分辨率和数据集规模的系统性研究为我的模型参数优化提供了重要指导。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了数据集规模、网络架构类型和关键性能指标，但缺少MD模拟的具体参数设置、势函数选择、网格分辨率等关键技术细节。建议重点精读方法学部分了解3D CNN架构设计细节，以及结果部分关于迁移学习和大规模结构筛选的具体实现方案。

2605.20819v1.title: DynaMate2: Democratization of Agentic AI for Expert-Designed Custom Workflows
2605.20819v1.summary: Scientific workflows in computational chemistry and materials science typically involve multiple interdependent steps, such as model preparation, system construction, simulation execution, and data analysis, that researchers have refined over the years into highly specialized, validated codebases. While large language model (LLM) agent frameworks have demonstrated the potential to automate such workflows, existing systems are built for specific, pre-defined task sequences. Adapting them to new domains or integrating custom expert-developed tools requires substantial programming expertise, which limits their adoption across the broader scientific community. Here we present DynaMate2, a hierarchical agentic framework and open-source template whose central design goal is to lower the barrier for any researcher to convert their existing expert-defined Python functions into AI-callable tools within a supervised multi-agent pipeline. The key design principle is that the LLM is never asked to generate scientific code since all domain logic resides in expert-defined tools. The LLMs sole responsibility is to route tasks, select the appropriate tool, and use outputs to guide subsequent actions. Tools and agents can be registered at runtime from inline code, existing source files, or plain-language descriptions, and all extensions persist automatically across sessions. We demonstrate the framework through an end-to-end molecular dynamics workflow. We provide a Tool Registration Protocol that guides researchers step-by-step through the process of integrating their validated code into the framework. DynaMate2 is released as an open-source reference implementation with a web-based interface and is designed to serve as a reusable template for community-driven extension across arbitrary scientific domains.
2605.20819v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决的是计算化学和材料科学中复杂工作流程自动化的问题，特别是如何让非编程专家也能将其专业代码集成到AI代理框架中。现有的大语言模型代理框架通常为特定任务序列而构建，适应新领域或集成定制专家工具需要大量编程专业知识，这限制了其在科学界的广泛采用。该工作的创新点在于提出了一个分层代理框架，允许研究人员在运行时将现有的Python函数转换为AI可调用工具，降低了技术门槛。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

DynaMate2采用分层代理框架架构，其中大语言模型不负责生成科学代码，而是专门负责任务路由、工具选择和输出引导。摘要未提及具体的分子动力学势函数类型、边界条件设置或加载方式等传统模拟参数。该框架的核心设计原则是所有领域逻辑都驻留在专家定义的工具中，工具和代理可以在运行时从内联代码、现有源文件或纯语言描述中注册。系统提供了工具注册协议，指导研究人员逐步将其验证代码集成到框架中。摘要未提及具体使用的分子动力学软件平台，但提到这是一个开源参考实现，具有基于Web的界面。该框架支持多代理管道中的监督式工作流程，所有扩展都会在会话间自动持久化。

论文通过端到端分子动力学工作流程演示了框架的有效性，但摘要未提及具体的数值结果、应力值、温度范围或缺陷密度等定量数据。摘要未提供与现有实验或模拟结果的对比情况。该框架被设计为可重用模板，支持跨任意科学领域的社区驱动扩展，但具体的精度和适用范围评估需查阅全文。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

对于多物理耦合场模拟、分子动力学、相场晶体模型和金属疲劳模拟研究，该框架的工具注册协议和分层代理架构可以直接借鉴，特别是将现有的XPFC模型代码、疲劳分析函数和拉伸变形模拟脚本集成到自动化工作流程中。该框架的设计理念对当前工作的启发包括：可以将复杂的多尺度模拟流程（从原子尺度MD到连续介质FEM）封装为独立工具，通过AI代理进行智能调度和参数传递。这种方法特别适合处理需要多个软件平台协同工作的复杂材料模拟任务，如LAMMPS-ABAQUS耦合分析。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

论文提供了开源参考实现和工具注册协议，但摘要中缺少具体的技术实现细节、API规范和示例代码结构等关键信息，需查阅全文获取完整的复现信息。建议重点精读工具注册协议章节和分子动力学工作流程演示部分，以了解如何将现有科学代码集成到该框架中。

2605.19747v1.title: Direct Simulation of LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 Transport Properties Using an Efficient and Accurate Machine Learning Potential
2605.19747v1.summary: The rate capability of layered lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC) cathode materials plays a decisive role in high-power applications such as fast charging, necessitating a detailed understanding of lithium-ion diffusion. However, the mechanisms governing lithium-ion transport in NMC remain insufficiently understood, both experimentally and computationally. In this study, we employ an advanced and efficient machine learning potential (MLP) to simulate lithium self-diffusion in LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 (NMC811), enabling direct large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The workflow integrates a fine-tuned MACE (Message Passing Atomic Cluster Expansion) foundation model as a structural generator and leverages an active learning strategy applied to a near-ground-state dataset. This approach enables the construction of a reliable MLP for NMC811 in a data-efficient manner using a limited number of density functional theory (DFT) reference calculations. Based on this potential, we performed MD simulations to predict lithium diffusion coefficients. The MLP-based simulations preserve the accuracy of DFT while overcoming its time and length scale limitations, thereby allowing direct simulation of lithium self-diffusion in NMC811.
authors: Constantijn H. J. A. van de Wetering
2605.19747v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决层状锂镍锰钴氧化物（NMC）正极材料中锂离子扩散机制不明的问题，这直接影响快充等高功率应用中的倍率性能。现有实验和计算方法都无法充分理解NMC材料中锂离子传输机制，传统DFT计算受限于时间和长度尺度，无法进行大规模长时间的扩散模拟。该工作创新点在于开发了高效准确的机器学习势函数，能够在保持DFT精度的同时突破尺度限制，实现NMC811材料中锂离子自扩散的直接大规模分子动力学模拟。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究使用分子动力学（MD）模拟结合机器学习势函数（MLP）方法，核心理论框架基于MACE（Message Passing Atomic Cluster Expansion）基础模型。势函数类型为经过微调的MACE机器学习势，通过主动学习策略应用于近基态数据集构建，使用有限数量的DFT参考计算实现数据高效训练。模拟对象为LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2（NMC811）材料，工作流程整合了MACE基础模型作为结构生成器。摘要未提及具体的边界条件设置、加载方式、模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。同样，使用的具体软件平台信息在摘要中未提及，需查阅全文确认。该MLP方法能够预测锂扩散系数，实现锂离子在NMC811中自扩散的直接模拟。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该研究成功构建了可靠的NMC811机器学习势函数，能够预测锂扩散系数并实现锂离子自扩散的直接模拟。MLP基础的模拟在保持DFT计算精度的同时克服了传统方法的时间和长度尺度限制。摘要未提及具体的扩散系数数值、温度范围、模拟精度等定量结果，需查阅全文获取详细数据。与已有实验或模拟结果的对比情况以及模型适用范围的具体信息在摘要中未详细说明。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的机器学习势函数构建方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟和分子动力学研究具有重要参考价值，特别是MACE基础模型结合主动学习策略的数据高效训练方法可以借鉴到金属材料的势函数开发中。锂离子扩散的MD模拟方法可以为我的拉伸变形模拟中的离子迁移机制研究提供技术路线参考。该工作展示的大规模长时间MD模拟能力对我当前的金属疲劳模拟工作具有启发意义，特别是在处理多尺度时间问题方面。机器学习势函数在保持精度的同时突破尺度限制的策略，可以应用到我的相场晶体模型（XPFC）与MD耦合的多尺度模拟中。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

2605.16957v1.title: An Efficient Approach for Calculating Free Energy in Molecular Dynamics: Demineralization of Hydroxyapatite as a Case Study
2605.16957v1.summary: Despite the strength of Molecular Dynamics simulations in providing insights into the microscopic details of phenomenon in many fields in materials science, physics and biology, the biggest barrier is its limited timescale which is several orders of magnitude lower than the timescale of the real-world processes and phenomena being modeled. Free energy calculations are designed as a remedy to this problem that in theory can overcome this barrier. This is particularly relevant for biomineralisation processes such as tooth mineral formation and dissolution, while reflecting a broader challenge in accurately modelling rare events and long-timescale phenomena across complex molecular systems. However, due to the novelty of the field, a number of questions remain outstanding pertaining to the best practice of applying this method. The non-equilibrium work approach based on the Jarzynski equation is one of the most promising free energy calculation methods. However, the biggest challenge for the broader use of this method is the question of how many simulations are required for an accurate free energy estimation. Comparing the free energy results with very long reversible pulling simulations of atom clusters from the surface, each taking 75 days on the 48-core Intel Xeon Platinum 8268 CPUs, in this study we showed that this question is irrelevant and higher quality and better equilibrated initial structures is the proper approach than simply based on the number of simulations. We designed a new adaptive free energy calculation methodology which combines high quality, high computational cost free energy values with lower quality, lower cost values to build up the entire free energy profile. In the best case scenario this method lowers manifold the computational cost required for the non-equilibrium work free energy calculations compared to both the regular method and the reversible simulation.
2605.16957v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决分子动力学模拟中时间尺度限制的根本问题，特别是在生物矿化过程（如牙齿矿物质形成和溶解）中的应用。现有分子动力学模拟的时间尺度比真实世界过程低几个数量级，严重限制了对长时间尺度现象的准确建模。传统的基于Jarzynski方程的非平衡功方法在自由能计算中面临模拟次数与精度平衡的挑战，缺乏最佳实践指导。该工作创新性地提出了自适应自由能计算方法，通过优化初始结构质量而非单纯增加模拟次数来提高计算效率。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究采用分子动力学模拟结合基于Jarzynski方程的非平衡功方法进行自由能计算。以羟基磷灰石脱矿化过程为案例，通过从表面拉拽原子团簇的方式模拟溶解过程。关键参数包括：使用48核Intel Xeon Platinum 8268 CPU进行长达75天的可逆拉拽模拟作为基准对照。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置、模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量、时间步长等关键技术参数，需查阅全文获取。该研究开发了自适应方法，将高质量高计算成本的自由能值与低质量低成本值相结合，构建完整的自由能分布曲线。使用的软件平台在摘要中未明确提及，需查阅全文确认。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究表明初始结构的高质量和良好平衡比单纯增加模拟次数更重要，这一发现颠覆了传统认知。通过与75天长时间可逆拉拽模拟的对比验证，证明了新方法的准确性。在最佳情况下，该自适应方法相比常规方法和可逆模拟显著降低了非平衡功自由能计算的计算成本，具体的数值降低倍数在摘要中未明确给出，需查阅全文。摘要未提及具体的应力值、温度范围、缺陷密度等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细数值结果。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的自适应自由能计算方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟和金属疲劳模拟具有重要借鉴价值，特别是在处理长时间尺度现象时。初始结构质量优于模拟次数的发现可直接应用于我的分子动力学模拟中，通过优化初始构型来提高计算效率。该方法在金属疲劳模拟中的裂纹扩展和拉伸变形模拟中的相变过程建模方面具有潜在应用价值。结合我的相场晶体模型(XPFC)工作，该自由能计算方法可用于验证相场参数的准确性和优化多尺度耦合策略。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供的技术细节有限，缺少势函数类型、具体模拟参数、边界条件等关键信息，完整复现需查阅全文获取详细的方法学描述。建议重点精读方法学部分了解自适应算法的具体实现细节，以及结果部分的定量对比数据和计算效率分析。

Free energy calculations are designed as a remedy to this problem that in theory can overcome this barrier. This is particularly relevant for biomineralisation processes such as tooth mineral formation and dissolution, while also reflecting a broader challenge in accurately modelling rare events and long-timescale phenomena across complex molecular systems. However, due to the novelty of the field, a number of questions remain outstanding pertaining to the best practice of applying this method. The non-equilibrium work approach based on the Jarzynski equation is one of the most promising free energy calculation methods. However, the biggest challenge for the widespread use of this method is the question of how many simulations are required for an accurate free energy estimation. 2605.22196v1.title: Toward the Rational Design of Molecular Field-Coupled Nanocomputing Candidates
2605.22196v1.summary: Molecular Field-Coupled Nanocomputing (MolFCN) is a promising beyond-CMOS paradigm in which information is propagated electrostatically rather than through charge transport, enabling ultra-low-power logic. Identifying molecules with stable logic states, efficient clock-field switching, and reliable information propagation, however, remains an open challenge. In this Letter, we introduce LUFFY (Layered Unified Framework for MolFCN systematic analYsis), a framework for the rational design and validation of molecular candidates for MolFCN architectures. Starting from 27 synthetically accessible molecules, we combine conformational sampling and electrostatic analysis in neutral and oxidized states to derive robust descriptors of molecular response. In particular, we extract the V${in}$-to-Aggregated-Charge Transcharacteristics (VACTs), capturing the field-induced charge response, and introduce energy-averaged models validated via ab initio molecular dynamics to account for conformational diversity. Finally, we use the resulting molecular responses to evaluate device-level propagation and demonstrate stable information transfer. These results directly link molecular structure to functional information flow, identifying conformationally robust electrostatic response as a key requirement for MolFCN operation. Overall, this work establishes a unified and transferable framework for the identification and validation of MolFCN molecular candidates, bridging molecular design and circuit-level functionality. By unifying previously fragmented approaches into a sustainable methodology, LUFFY enables rational and scalable molecular discovery and establishes a foundation for data-driven design strategies that accelerate the development of ultra-low-power information processing technologies.
2605.22196v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决分子场耦合纳米计算（MolFCN）中分子候选材料的理性设计问题，这是一种超越CMOS的新型计算范式，通过静电场而非电荷传输来传播信息，实现超低功耗逻辑运算。现有方法在识别具有稳定逻辑状态、高效时钟场切换和可靠信息传播的分子方面缺乏系统性框架。该工作的创新点在于建立了统一的LUFFY框架，将分子结构与功能信息流直接关联，实现了从分子设计到电路级功能的桥接。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究使用从头算分子动力学（ab initio molecular dynamics）结合静电分析方法，建立了分层统一框架LUFFY用于MolFCN分子候选材料的系统分析。研究选取了27个可合成分子作为研究对象，通过构象采样和静电分析来研究中性态和氧化态下的分子响应。关键理论框架基于V_in到聚合电荷转移特性（VACTs）的提取，用于捕获场诱导的电荷响应行为。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置、模拟尺寸和时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。该研究引入了能量平均模型来考虑构象多样性，并通过从头算分子动力学进行验证。摘要未明确提及使用的具体软件平台。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究成功建立了分子结构与功能信息流之间的直接关联，识别出构象稳健的静电响应是MolFCN操作的关键要求。通过LUFFY框架评估了器件级传播性能，证明了稳定的信息传输能力。摘要未提供具体的数值结果，如应力值、能量范围或电荷密度等定量数据，需查阅全文获取详细的定量结论。该方法为分子发现提供了理性和可扩展的途径，建立了数据驱动设计策略的基础。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多物理耦合分析方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有重要参考价值，特别是其将静电场与分子动力学结合的思路可以借鉴到我的XPFC模型中。LUFFY框架中的能量平均模型概念可以应用到我的金属疲劳模拟中，用于处理材料微观结构的多样性问题。该研究从分子尺度到器件尺度的多尺度建模思路，为我的拉伸变形模拟提供了跨尺度耦合的方法论指导。构象稳健性分析的概念可以转化为我研究中晶体缺陷稳定性的评估方法。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了研究框架的概念性描述，但缺少关键的技术参数如具体的计算方法、模拟参数设置、分子结构细节等信息，需查阅全文获取完整的方法学细节。建议重点精读方法学部分了解LUFFY框架的具体实现，以及结果部分的VACTs分析和能量平均模型的验证过程。

2605.15554v1.title: Interface Piezoelectric Loss in Superconducting Qubits
2605.15554v1.summary: Dissipation remains a central obstacle to improving superconducting quantum circuits, yet the microscopic origins of loss in widely used materials platforms are not fully understood. Here, we report the observation of interface piezoelectricity-induced dissipation in superconducting qubits fabricated on high-resistivity silicon. Our devices use a transmon qubit with a shunt capacitor that simultaneously serves as an interdigital transducer embedded in a surface acoustic wave resonator. By tuning the qubit transition into resonance with discrete mechanical modes, we observe up to a factor-of-two reduction in qubit lifetime, consistent with energy exchange between the qubit and mechanical modes mediated by piezoelectric coupling at the aluminum-silicon interface. Our findings provide direct evidence for interface piezoelectricity as a distinct loss channel in superconducting qubits. Combined with multiphysics simulations, these findings suggest that interface piezoelectric loss can dominate over loss from two-level systems at sufficiently high frequencies.
2605.15554v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决超导量子比特中耗散机制的微观起源问题，特别是在高阻硅衬底上制备的超导量子电路中的能量损失机制。现有研究对广泛使用材料平台中损耗的微观机理理解不够充分，传统认为二能级系统是主要损耗源。该工作创新性地发现并验证了界面压电效应作为一种独特的损耗通道，通过铝-硅界面的压电耦合介导量子比特与机械模式之间的能量交换。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用多物理耦合模拟方法，结合实验测量验证界面压电损耗机制。实验使用transmon量子比特结构，其分流电容器同时作为嵌入表面声波谐振器中的叉指换能器。器件制备在高阻硅衬底上，通过调节量子比特跃迁频率与离散机械模式共振来观察耦合效应。摘要未提及具体的模拟软件平台、网格规模、边界条件设置等关键参数，需查阅全文获取详细信息。加载方式为频率调谐实现量子比特与机械模式的共振耦合，通过测量量子比特寿命变化来量化损耗效应。多物理模拟用于分析压电耦合机制并预测在足够高频率下界面压电损耗可能主导二能级系统损耗。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

实验观察到当量子比特与机械模式共振时，量子比特寿命降低达2倍，直接证明了铝-硅界面压电耦合介导的能量交换过程。这一结果与理论预期的界面压电损耗机制高度一致，为界面压电效应作为超导量子比特中独特损耗通道提供了直接实验证据。多物理模拟结果表明，在足够高的频率条件下，界面压电损耗可能超过传统二能级系统损耗成为主导机制。摘要未提及具体的频率范围、温度条件、应力值等定量参数，需查阅全文获取详细数值。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的多物理耦合模拟方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有重要参考价值，特别是在处理电-机械耦合问题方面。界面压电效应的发现为我在金属疲劳模拟中考虑界面效应提供了新思路，可以借鉴其界面耦合机制的建模方法。论文中量子比特寿命随频率调谐的变化规律，可为我在拉伸变形模拟中设计加载频率参数提供参考。多物理模拟预测高频下损耗机制转变的方法，对我在相场晶体模型中处理多尺度耦合问题具有启发意义，特别是在确定不同物理机制的主导频率范围方面。

2605.15305v4.title: WorldParticle: Unified World Simulation of Lagrangian Particle Dynamics via Transformer
2605.15305v4.summary: A unified simulator that can model diverse physical phenomena without solver-specific redesign is a long-standing goal across simulation science. We present a learning-based particle simulator built on a single transformer architecture to model cloth, elastic solds, Newtonian and non-Newtonian fluids, granular materials, and molecular dynamics. Our model follows a prediction-correction design on a shared Lagrangian particle representation. An explicit predictor first advances particles under the known external forces, producing an intermediate state that captures externally driven motion but not inter-particle interactions. A learned corrector then predicts the residual position and velocity updates through three stages: a particle tokenizer that encodes local particle-particle, particle-boundary, and topology-guided interactions; a super-token encoder that hierarchically merges particle tokens into a compact set of super tokens via alternating self-attention and token merging; and a super-token decoder that lifts these super tokens back to particle resolution through cross-attention to predict per-particle position and velocity corrections. Progressive token merging reduces the attention cost at successive encoder layers by halving the token count at each level, and the decoder communicates through the compact super-token set rather than full particle-to-particle attention. Across the six dynamics categories, the same architecture generalizes to unseen materials, boundary configurations, initial conditions, and external forces. We further demonstrate downstream interactive control, inverse design, and learning from real-world manipulation data, reducing the need for per-phenomenon solver engineering.
2605.15305v4.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决的核心问题是构建一个统一的物理现象模拟器，能够在不重新设计求解器的情况下模拟布料、弹性固体、牛顿和非牛顿流体、颗粒材料以及分子动力学等多种物理现象。现有方法的局限性在于不同物理现象需要专门的求解器设计，缺乏通用性和可扩展性。该工作的创新点在于基于单一Transformer架构构建学习型粒子模拟器，采用统一的拉格朗日粒子表示来处理多种物理系统。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该方法采用基于Transformer的机器学习模型，使用统一的拉格朗日粒子表示来描述不同物理系统。核心理论框架是预测-校正设计，其中显式预测器首先在已知外力作用下推进粒子运动，产生捕获外部驱动运动但不包含粒子间相互作用的中间状态。学习型校正器通过三个阶段预测残差位置和速度更新：粒子标记器编码局部粒子-粒子、粒子-边界和拓扑引导的相互作用；超级标记编码器通过交替自注意力和标记合并将粒子标记分层合并为紧凑的超级标记集；超级标记解码器通过交叉注意力将超级标记提升回粒子分辨率以预测每个粒子的位置和速度校正。渐进式标记合并通过在每个层级将标记数量减半来降低连续编码器层的注意力成本。摘要未提及具体的势函数类型、边界条件设置、模拟尺寸、原子数、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文。使用的软件平台信息在摘要中未提及，需查阅全文。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该模型在六种动力学类别中展现出对未见材料、边界配置、初始条件和外力的泛化能力。摘要未提及具体的数值结果，如应力值、温度范围、缺陷密度等定量指标，需查阅全文获取详细的性能评估数据。论文进一步展示了下游交互控制、逆向设计和从真实世界操作数据学习的能力，减少了针对特定现象的求解器工程需求。与已有实验/模拟结果的对比情况以及模型精度和适用范围的具体信息在摘要中未详细说明。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的统一拉格朗日粒子表示方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟研究具有重要参考价值，特别是其预测-校正框架可以为我的分子动力学和相场晶体模型(XPFC)提供新的数值求解思路。Transformer架构在处理粒子间长程相互作用方面的优势可以启发我在金属疲劳模拟中对缺陷演化的建模方法。该方法的分层标记合并策略可以为我的大规模拉伸变形模拟提供计算效率优化的参考。论文中的学习型校正器设计思想可以应用于改进我当前工作中的边界条件处理和多尺度耦合策略。

2605.17207v1.title: Structure of Molten FeCl2 and FeCl3
2605.17207v1.summary: Molten iron chlorides are central to emerging energy technologies, including electrochemical iron production and redox flow batteries. Optimizing their electrochemical performance and transport properties requires atomic-scale structural understanding, yet detailed data for molten FeCl2 and its differences from FeCl3 remain scarce. Here, we determined the structures of molten FeCl2 and FeCl3 using High Energy X-ray diffraction (HEXRD), Empirical Potential Structure Refinement (EPSR), and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). HEXRD measurements provided structure factors and total radial distribution functions (RDFs), which were quantitatively reproduced through EPSR refinement directly constrained by experimental data. MD simulations using MACE foundation and fine-tuned models reproduced experimental structure factors as well as total and partial RDFs, capturing key structural differences between the melts. The models resolved the octahedral to tetrahedral coordination transition of Fe upon melting in FeCl3 and predicted a similar transition in FeCl2. Analysis of MD trajectories quantified coordination environments, bridging Cl populations, bond-angle distributions, and connectivity patterns, revealing distinct degrees of polymerization and local geometry. Polymer chain statistics further showed that, contrary to prior reports, both liquids predominantly consist of extended chains containing six or more Fe centers rather than discrete Fe2Cl6 units. Finally, diffusion coefficients of the two melts calculated from the MACE-MD simulations were compared. Together, these results establish atomic-scale structural benchmarks for molten FeCl2 and FeCl3 and demonstrate the reliability of MACE-based MLIPs for predictive modeling of high-temperature molten salts, while providing practical guidance for MLIP development in complex ionic liquids.
2605.17207v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决熔融氯化铁（FeCl2和FeCl3）的原子尺度结构表征问题，这对电化学铁生产和氧化还原液流电池等新兴能源技术至关重要。现有方法缺乏对熔融FeCl2详细结构数据以及其与FeCl3结构差异的深入理解，限制了电化学性能和输运性质的优化。该工作创新性地结合高能X射线衍射实验、经验势结构精修和机器学习分子动力学模拟，建立了可靠的原子尺度结构基准。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

研究采用分子动力学模拟结合机器学习势函数（MACE基础模型和微调模型）对熔融FeCl2和FeCl3进行结构分析。使用高能X射线衍射（HEXRD）测量获得结构因子和总径向分布函数，通过经验势结构精修（EPSR）方法直接约束实验数据进行结构优化。MD模拟使用MACE机器学习势函数，能够准确再现实验结构因子以及总的和偏的径向分布函数。摘要未提及具体的模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量、温度条件、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。边界条件设置和加载方式在摘要中未明确说明。模拟捕获了FeCl3熔化时Fe从八面体到四面体配位的转变，并预测FeCl2中存在类似转变。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

研究发现两种熔融盐主要由包含六个或更多Fe中心的扩展链组成，而非先前报告的离散Fe2Cl6单元。MD轨迹分析量化了配位环境、桥接Cl原子数量、键角分布和连接模式，揭示了不同的聚合度和局部几何结构。MACE-MD模拟计算得到两种熔体的扩散系数并进行了对比。摘要未提及具体的数值结果（如扩散系数数值、配位数、键长等），需查阅全文获取定量数据。实验与模拟结果在结构因子和径向分布函数方面实现了定量一致性。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的MACE机器学习势函数方法对我的多物理耦合场模拟和分子动力学研究具有重要借鉴价值，特别是在处理复杂离子体系的高温行为方面。EPSR方法结合实验数据约束MD模拟的策略可以直接应用于我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中的模型验证。论文中配位环境分析、键角分布统计和连接模式表征的方法可以用于我的相场晶体模型（XPFC）中缺陷结构的定量分析。机器学习势函数在高温条件下的可靠性验证为我开展金属材料高温疲劳模拟提供了方法学指导。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供了主要方法框架但缺少关键的模拟参数细节，如具体温度、模拟盒子尺寸、原子数量、时间步长等信息需查阅全文。建议重点精读方法学部分了解MACE势函数的训练和验证过程，以及结果部分的定量结构分析方法。论文的EPSR-MD结合策略和机器学习势函数应用部分值得深入学习。

2605.22627v1.title: Summarizing Time-Varying Digital Image Correlation Strain Fields Using Sankey Diagrams
2605.22627v1.summary: Digital Image Correlation (DIC) enables dense, time-resolved measurement of surface strain in deforming materials, providing insight into strain localization and failure mechanisms. However, the resulting strain fields are typically explored frame-by-frame through spatial visualizations, making global temporal patterns difficult to discern. We present a visual summarization approach that represents the evolution of high-strain regions as a single Sankey diagram constructed from superlevel sets of the von Mises equivalent strain field. By tracking connected components over time via spatial overlap, the diagram encodes the birth, persistence, merging, and disappearance of strain concentrations. Applied to four tensile test datasets with varying notch geometries, the approach compactly captures differences in deformation regimes and qualitative precursors to failure, complementing traditional spatial strain visualizations with a global temporal overview.
2605.22627v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决数字图像相关（DIC）技术获得的时变应变场数据难以进行全局时间模式分析的问题。传统DIC分析主要依赖逐帧空间可视化，无法有效识别应变局部化和失效机制的时间演化规律。现有方法缺乏对高应变区域时间演化的全局概览能力，该工作创新性地引入桑基图（Sankey diagram）来可视化应变集中区域的产生、持续、合并和消失过程。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该研究基于数字图像相关（DIC）实验数据，采用von Mises等效应变场的超水平集分析方法。核心技术框架是通过空间重叠追踪连通分量随时间的演化，构建桑基图来编码高应变区域的时间演化行为。边界条件设置为单轴拉伸试验，针对四种不同缺口几何形状的试样进行测试。摘要未提及具体的应变率、试样尺寸、时间步长等关键参数，需查阅全文获取。数据处理采用连通分量分析算法，通过空间重叠度量来建立时间序列中应变集中区域的对应关系。摘要未提及使用的具体软件平台和数据处理工具。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

该方法成功应用于四个不同缺口几何的拉伸试验数据集，能够紧凑地捕获不同变形机制的差异和失效的定性前兆。桑基图有效编码了应变集中区域的产生、持续、合并和消失等时间演化行为。摘要未提及具体的应变数值范围、缺口几何的具体尺寸参数、试验的应变率等定量数据，需查阅全文。该方法为传统空间应变可视化提供了全局时间概览的补充分析工具。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的可视化分析方法对我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟研究具有重要参考价值，特别是在应变局部化演化分析方面。桑基图的时间演化追踪思路可以直接应用于我的分子动力学和相场晶体模型（XPFC）模拟结果的后处理分析中，用于追踪缺陷演化、位错运动和损伤累积过程。该方法的连通分量分析和空间重叠度量技术可以借鉴用于我的多物理耦合场模拟中应变集中区域的自动识别和演化追踪。对于疲劳裂纹萌生和扩展的预测分析，该可视化方法能够提供有效的前兆识别工具。

5) 可复现性评估与阅读建议

摘要提供的参数细节不足以完全复现该方法，缺少关键的数值参数如应变阈值设定、连通分量判定标准、空间重叠度量的具体算法等。建议重点精读方法论部分和案例分析章节，特别关注超水平集构建算法、连通分量追踪的具体实现细节和四种缺口几何试样的具体参数设置。

2605.20384v1.title: Dataset-aware entropy-maximized active learning for machine-learned interatomic potentials
2605.20384v1.summary: We present an active learning framework for efficiently generating training data for machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). The method combines local entropy-driven molecular dynamics with global dataset-aware filtering: a per-configuration entropy term biases MD trajectories toward structurally diverse snapshots, while a global entropy measure, the log-determinant of the fingerprint covariance matrix of the entire dataset, selects only those configurations that provide genuinely new information. We employ dual covariance modes (per-atom for disordered structures and per-config for ordered phases) to achieve broad coverage of configuration space. Combined with a pre-trained foundation model (Allegro-OAM-L) and analytical fingerprint gradients from Gaussian overlap matrix eigenvalues, the framework produces high-quality domain-specific potentials with near- or sub-meV/atom accuracy on test data drawn from the same distribution at training-set sizes of order $10^{2}$ to $10^{3}$ entropy-selected DFT-labeled structures. We demonstrate the method on three systems spanning diverse bonding types and pressure-driven phase transitions: carbon (covalent), silicon (covalent/metallic), and NaCl (ionic). In learning curve comparisons against random molecular dynamics sampling at matched training set sizes ($N = 100$ to $800$), evaluated over three independent training-set draws per condition, entropy-driven sampling achieves a factor of approximately $3$ to $10$ lower energy MAE at $N = 800$ on in-distribution holdouts across the three systems, with the magnitude of the gain depending on the bonding type and the size at which the random-MD baseline saturates.
2605.20384v1.summary_text:
1) 研究问题与背景

该论文解决机器学习原子间势函数训练数据生成效率低下的问题，在当前MLIP需要大量高质量DFT标记数据但计算成本昂贵的背景下提出。现有方法多采用随机分子动力学采样，无法有效覆盖构型空间且存在数据冗余问题。该工作创新点在于结合局部熵驱动分子动力学与全局数据集感知过滤，通过双重协方差模式实现高效的主动学习框架。

2) 核心方法与模型细节

该方法基于主动学习框架结合分子动力学模拟，使用预训练的Allegro-OAM-L基础模型作为起点。核心理论框架包含局部熵项偏置MD轨迹向结构多样性快照，以及全局熵测量通过指纹协方差矩阵的对数行列式选择提供新信息的构型。采用双重协方差模式：无序结构使用per-atom模式，有序相使用per-config模式以实现构型空间的广泛覆盖。关键技术包括基于高斯重叠矩阵特征值的解析指纹梯度计算。训练集规模控制在10²到10³个熵选择的DFT标记结构范围内。在三个不同键合类型系统上验证：碳（共价键）、硅（共价/金属键）和NaCl（离子键），涵盖压力驱动的相变过程。

3) 关键结果与定量结论

在训练集大小N=800时，熵驱动采样相比随机分子动力学采样在三个系统的分布内测试集上实现能量平均绝对误差降低约3到10倍。最终训练的领域特定势函数在同分布测试数据上达到接近或低于meV/atom的精度水平。通过三次独立训练集抽取的对比实验验证，性能提升幅度取决于键合类型和随机MD基线的饱和规模。该方法在N=100到800的训练集规模范围内均表现出显著优势。

4) 对我研究的直接价值

该论文的熵驱动采样策略可直接应用于我的金属疲劳和拉伸变形模拟中的MLIP训练数据生成，特别是双重协方差模式概念可用于处理金属材料中有序晶格与缺陷区域的不同采样需求。Allegro-OAM-L基础模型的使用经验和解析指纹梯度计算方法可为我的多物理耦合场模拟提供高效的势函数开发路径。训练集规模控制在10²-10³量级的策略对于我的相场晶体模型验证具有重要参考价值，可显著降低DFT计算成本。全局数据集感知过滤机制可借鉴用于优化我的XPFC模型参数拟合过程中的训练数据选择。
